reviews: ['I am a returning student worse experience,  i had an online class my last psych class DO NOT enroll into sandra lee’s class she gave me a C and i studied very hard she is not supportive or helpful  this teacher has showed me how professors like her are the reasons people are not motivated to go to school but i am a firm believer in karma and she will get hers in the long run', 'The gentleman at Window #1 in the Business Office was incredibly helpful. Truly exceptional service! Even though I needed to go to Admissions, which closes at 1 PM, he went above and beyond to assist me. Thanks to his guidance, I was able to access my account online, reactivate it, and re-register to obtain my unofficial transcripts. His professionalism and willingness to help made a big difference!', 'Went for LAWA conference. Meet some very nice people.', 'Laccd. Service can be a hit or miss depending on who you get. It took months of nagging to get my certificates after I earned them. Choose wisely I would have went to Trade Tech if I only knew.', "I have finished my second dose of corona vaccine! The first time I had to wait a long time, but the second time I didn't have to wait."]

name: Los Angeles Trade Technical College
reviews: ["Very proud to say I'm attending this college. Automotive collision repair to be exact.Lots of positive supportive students and classmates. Was ready to make a positive change in my life and this is where it starts !!!", 'I love the high energy and love I feel whenever I’m on the campus of Los Angeles Trade Technical College. From the President Instructors and frontline staff LATC, it has the feel of a family on purpose to facilitate the development of professional level technical skills. I’ve gone from student to proud parent of a student in the Design and Media school. We attended the Golden Thimble fashion showcase at least three times and each time the designers outdid the previous show. This last time one student designed a full furry costume for the avant- guard theme. We missed Ms Jackson but they sent in an excellent host who was well dressed and  exuded the fashion design spirit. I hope he comes back with Ms Jackson. Many of the schools on campus come together to put on a fabulous fashion show production. I always look forward to the cookies of the culinary arts department. Enjoy the show through my eyes. Until the next one. Our son has been a featured model, coming soon he will be a featured designer: Naheim Yusuf, of the house of Yahsoul.', 'I am currently in the third semester taking the carpentry program. Los Angeles Trade Technical College is a great school. October will be 3 years that I have been attending this college. I also got my GED through Trade Tech.The majority of the professors and staff are very respectful and kind.\n\nUpdate I finished the carpentry program and found a job in the construction field with great pay. I would definitely recommend Los Angeles Trade Tech Technical College to someone that wants to learn a trade or just  take some classes. If you do decide to go put all your effort in your studies it will pay off.', 'The experience of being there is crazy. The people there are so nice and helpful. Now things may look confusing and a bit much but you just gotta ask for help. Love going to the classes (some) 😁', "There are so many programs available here to help students succeed. From financial aid, free food from the Beaver's Lounge, or housing assistance. The staff and professors are awesome."]

name: Los Angeles Valley College
reviews:
['Very nice and clean, the soccer fields are in good shape. The restrooms are very clean after a 2 hour drive to my sons soccer game.', "It takes repeat attempts to get simple things done. In the summer,  the restriction on how many units you can take is ridiculous! Try getting a refund and it's like pulling tooth. They want you to pay on the spot but refund takes months. The admin staff can be more diverse it's very clear who is hiring there as it's one group of people.  My daughter took 3 classes over the summer and they went well. The math teacher showed up to every single class and was VERY good.  She's very chatty,  you can tell she loves to teach and knows her material not just rambling. She responses to messages, she wants you to participate so she knows you understand and get something out of the class. Wish I could take her in ALL my subjects. Professor Juliana Howe. If you can take her for mathematics, take her! She will make sure you learn and keep the class interesting.", 'Great/cheaper place to exercise at the gym through the community center or school, complete general ed & transfer to a 4yr, or learn a skill. Smaller classes for more one on one learning. Friendly students & staff. After graduating & graduating from CSUN, I still come back for the community center gym class & easy-going school atmosphere.', 'Clean campus. I took classes a decade-plus ago, look completely different. There are areas of the lawn that brings back memories.', "Los Angeles Valley College (LAVC) offers an exceptional learning environment that truly stands out. From the moment you step onto the campus, you are greeted by a positive atmosphere that is both welcoming and inspiring. The well-maintained facilities and vibrant campus life create an environment where you feel motivated to study and succeed.

What truly sets LAVC apart is the feeling of enthusiasm and eagerness to learn that permeates the campus. Whether in classrooms, study areas, or even common spaces, there's a palpable energy that encourages students to engage deeply with their studies. It's a place where academic goals feel within reach, and personal growth is nurtured every step of the way.

LAVC is more than just an educational institution; it's a place where students are inspired to learn and achieve their full potential. The supportive atmosphere, coupled with excellent faculty and resources, makes it an ideal choice for anyone looking to further their education."]

name: The Master's University and Seminary
reviews:
["Summary: THE BEST UNIVERSITY IN CALIFORNIA RIGHT NOW, HANDS DOWN!

Update: Just visited again! This place has an incredible atmosphere, absolutely great professors, and wonderful staff. I am incredibly excited to attend this school! There’s a reason it basically has the #1 satisfaction rate among alumni.

Initial Post: I visited this place a month ago and am enrolled (online) here, and it was one of the coolest places, and definitely colleges, that I have ever seen. Regarding COVID-19, they treat everyone's convictions with respect, but never seems to force anything onto anybody. Their doctrine is rock solid, and the leadership conviction is unwavering. The school is the perfect size, and is high quality in everything they do. Their admissions staff is incredible, their chapel on the Bible are terrific (check them out on YouTube), and they are some of the most God-fearing and loving people that I have ever seen. I am definitely planning to go here, and I would strongly encourage you to as well.

Go Mustangs!", 'We recieved a tour of the campus from a friend.  Looks like a wonderful, well maintained, campus with lots of amenities.  Staff is approachable, empathetic, and Christ-centered.  Education is top notch, and the community appears to be close and supportive.  Our friend is having a life-changing experience at TMU and speaks very highly of the school.', 'Nice campus. The legacy room was well fitted to our needs and handsome. The staff in the Administration building was super helpful and went out of their way to make sure we got what we needed and even what was just nice to have.', 'I enjoyed my years at TMU and graduated with a degree in business.  I try to make it back to campus for sporting events.', "I am an alumni of this fine school.  I would highly  recommend the school.  If you wish to write a bad review please don't.  We don't need to hear you blame others for your life.

I wish I could donate more money.  I pray others will enjoy a time with God as I have here.  I also thank the staff for the support they have given.  Scott '88"]

name: Los Angeles City College
reviews: ["Tremendous college with opportunities. I'm proud to say that, we students have green grass on our campus.", "When I attended LACC I was placed on academic probation, had a sub 2.0 GPA and the only professor that really compelled me to come to class was Prof. Sedghi. When I transferred to a different community college my grades skyrocketed and I made both the President's List and the Dean's List back-to-back. Personally, I think that speaks volumes about the quality of education. LACC is what you make of it but the extent of that is limited by the competence of the administration and the quality of its instructors.", "Excellent college.  There are many good professors who are ready to help you achieve your goals.  I have found many friends here.  I recommend those who are looking for a place to study to consider this college.  Unfortunately, there are some tyrant professors, most likely like in other colleges, whose subject is the only one and you have no alternatives.  They can go too far, it's good that there is an opportunity to quit the class before it's too late.", "career counselor is rude and condescending. if you're looking to see your options and wanted guidance, then i suggest you go elsewhere. instead of having a direction, plan for career exploration, and hope of going back to school; it felt like he was disuading me.i understood what he wanted me to do but there's a way of saying it that doesn't invalidate someone. I had to ask him what career center had for resources because he was stuck on asking me if i googled any of the careers. what an awful experience that was. he was late too. if you're disabled too, then good luck with finding a more patient counselor. i'm so disappointed with the treatment i recieved.", 'It’s a great place. Studied there for many weeks, and had a great experience. Although the dean kept dropping in to our study group to give these creative announcements. Unexpected. All else just great!']

name: Los Angeles Mission College
reviews: ['In-person classes are great. Their online classes are NOT good at all. I had to attend another school to get the units I needed in-person classes.', 'Unfortunately, my experience with this school—specifically for online courses—has been disappointing. I’ve taken classes at two other campuses that were much more accommodating and supportive of student needs. In contrast, this school seems less flexible and makes processes unnecessarily difficult. I live over an hour away, and having to do tasks such as, turn in a paper in person poses a real challenge. While other institutions have worked with me based on my circumstances, this one has not shown the same willingness. I regret having to switch my home campus here. If your major is online and you live far from campus, I would strongly advise against enrolling—unless you’re able to manage the commute regularly. My experience may not be yours. Just a heads up.', "Back in 2015 My high school talked very highly of this college especially for Disable student program but it wasn't even close to what they said. There so called ds program don't even help there students with there messed up instructor. They don't even care about the disabilities students have, well especially for me that is. The multimedia department is a joke. To that teacher your are a disappointment.", "Counseling office is honestly a mess. You have to call a week in advance during certain hours to set up an appointment with a counselor. They do walk-ins but they're so pointless when they end up dismissing you because they can't help you with much since its just a walk in. I wish they would improve by creating a system where you're able to meet with counselors easily. They don't seem to care for students needs or give excellent service. Some of the receptionists can be so unhelpful too. If you find them in a good mood or they seem to like you, its unbelievable how easily they're able to get things done. I really hope this school hears back on the many complains and hires new staff and counselors that care to help and will do their job.", 'Every single semester, it doesn’t fail!!  Administration, registration and counseling are so unorganized.  I’m convinced the administration at LA Mission College is purposely set up to deter students from enrolling.  From searching for a class online, to calling in registration and counseling for assistance or questions.  It’s an excruciating process that just leaves you drained.  If you’re a new student or part-time student, just hang in there!!! Don’t let this college’s mismanagement get to you, pursue your education!  No matter how many unnecessary obstacles are put in your way.  LAMC you disappoint me every single semester!!!!   I wish i had time to enroll at another college like Glendale Community College or College of the Canyons.']

name: Los Medanos College
reviews:
['The experience of getting an "Education" at this institution leaves much to be desired. I have gotten my education and quite a bit of experience from this place and in my time I have seen:

-Lazy professors
-Unethical Administrators
-Dean of Equity complaining about how her office isn't big enough
-Terrible education (When a professor makes you watch a 30 year old documentary and calls that an adequate representation of modern happenings, professors simply telling you to use Quizlet, Professors telling you that you are poor now and will always be poor, professors telling the students that she believes they are selfish animals, Professors brining their personal lives into class, Professors being petty, ETC ETC)
-.Abrogating their motto "We Care About Your Success!"  They serve themselves only and work to perpetuate their administration. We are merely statistics for them to use to accomplish their selfish goals.
-People in Student Government having sex in the "Honor Center"
-Students moral being low
-People in Student Government who steal from  the school each other among other illicit activities...
-The School funding silly building projects rather than doing things to materially better the lives of the students.
-Having workers laugh about how they poorly put together gym equipment that costs well over 10 grand
-hearing Professors say they are overwhelmed and can't help you
-Having the Administration Straight up LIE and then Obfuscate any responsibility.
-Student News Paper: When I dealt with them they proved to be self-serving hypocrites.
-The campus police turn a blind eye to the vagrants who pollute the area with their filth and drug paraphernalia: They even burnt down a section of the Lake a while back, because they where living in Marshes. They have since relocated to the bushes on the border of LMC and the Trails
-Trails just outside of the school are an easy route for drugs, crime, and opportunists.

I am glad to be done with this part of my life,  I luckily have taken other college classes in other Universities; thus, I was well suited for the free for all LMC offers its students. With that said i have seen many Good people come into LMC and walk out with nothing to show not because of some fault of theirs but because of the wretched environment and culture perpetuated at LMC by the ADMINISTRATION and its ILK!', 'Love this school. Once you build relationships & focus on education development, then all could form together for the better. There are some improvable moments, this campus was one of the 3 CCCC schools to help me achieve higher education programs/standards. I would consider volunteering for the LMC Marketplace, or joining student clubs like Rotaract or Law Society.', 'Nice place,  there are a artificial lake, you can walk around of the park, enjoy with ducks and fishs.', "I've been coming to this beautiful campus since i was a kid to walk around the pond and later as a student. Most of the professor's are great, generally being helpful and nice. With the campus expanding every year, it's only going to get better.", 'Good instructors and newly remodeled buildings give it a welcome atmosphere. Has a made for fitness lake to walk around and exercise. Also a great place to take kids to feed the ducks and geese']

name: Loyola Marymount University
reviews:
['Very large open space with public access. Very good conservation, little car traffic, ample parking and the few roads open to vehicle traffic, very well organized circulation. Expansive views of the City of Los Angeles. There is tranquility in an atmosphere of respect.', 'Beauty and peace would describe this campus. A very serene environment on the hill overlooking a big part of Los Angeles. Large acres of grass with everything looking like in order and clealiness. Towards sunset you get some incredible pictures of the beachfront. People also seeme very calm and helpful. Starbucks and other food and drink places all around the campus. At the very edge is a beautiful church.', 'Loyola Marymount University (LMU) is a well‑regarded private Jesuit university located in Los Angeles, California, known for its strong academic programs, dynamic campus culture, and emphasis on values‑based education. Academically, LMU offers a wide range of undergraduate and graduate degrees across disciplines such as business, engineering, film and television, liberal arts, and sciences. The university is particularly recognized for blending rigorous academics with a commitment to ethical leadership and social justice. The board of director recently signed an agreement with ODosta Store to serve Microsoft and Partner Network Software license to their Students at the discount price.', 'During my visit to this university, I was genuinely frustrated with how the security team operates. They often seem unaware of what’s happening around them and follow procedures in an overly rigid, almost mechanical way. It’s similar to what some call “Wachter syndrome” — a mindset where someone follows the rules for the sake of the rules, without any understanding of the context, which ends up disrupting things rather than helping. For Americans, the closest comparison would be extreme gatekeeping: rigid control with no practical purpose.

In my opinion, the university should seriously reconsider how its security staff are selected and trained, or think about replacing the contractor responsible for providing these services.', 'Beauty and clean style and good students here
Future bright. Very friendly as well.  A lot fit students healthy life and gym look great architecture God Bless All']

name: College of Marin
reviews:
['Great facility; the building is big, nice, and clean. I was considering coming here to improve my English skills, but today I had my first and last class.
The topic of my lesson was: “How NOT to Treat People.”

I was attended by Melvin J. Rocha Rivera for ESL enrollment information. Unfortunately, this person showed:
•	Lack of social skills
•	0% professionalism
•	0% active listening
•	0% empathy
•	Very arrogant and haughty behavior

All my questions were answered with sarcasm, making me feel completely unwelcome and out of place.

If this is the level of education and attitude from the staff, then what could you possibly teach me?

Better to go somewhere else.
And thank you very much, Melvin, for the “lesson.”

August 27 2025
Around 1:15/ 1:45 pm', "Best college for transfer students or to get your AA/AS. I received two in two years, and successfully transferred to Cal State. Amazing counselors, terrific professors (especially math, physics, and comp science), beautiful campus, free charging stations. You really can't ask for more!", 'Modern,  clean, well maintained, secure. On premises, one unpaved free parking lot in addition to plentiful paved parking spaces that require paid parking permits obtainable from College of Marin.', 'Wonderful Marin County community college. Beautiful campus. New high tech buildings replace old collegiate architecture of yesteryear, but younger students are not nostalgic for what once WAS. Robin Williams was a student here.  Decades of wonderful teachers have taught here. Classes and  programs for a wide variety of learners.  Can be an economical feeder school into University degree programs. ESL, Disabled, and certificate programs also. Senior "Emeritus" classes.', 'I would never want to be a student where professors believe in shame and bullying tactics to teach. Do not take a class from Birdie Winrow.']

name: Mendocino College
reviews:
["Staff were  VERY pleasant and helpful!  However I'm from out of state and not used to the level of red tape involved in signing up for a course. Trying to apply for financial aid and the computer was not cooperating.   Have to ho back next  week.

The campus is really nice and everything is very up to date.", 'Do not pass up the chance to go here! This place is fabulous!  I LOVE MENDOCINO COLLEGE!', "I went to this college until recently. It started out as a lovely experience. Then staff started accusing me of saying terrible things and the financial aid office is petty and refuses to work with you. Some teachers take years to remove your class from canvas, if he ever did. The teachers bring their incredibly ill children to class. The food at most campuses are vending machines stuffed with sugary snacks. I finally gave up and dropped out. I went to register at another school and was told all the untruths financial aid told me. Clubs are a joke and if you happen to join one they ignore the club and it's not attended to.

If this isn't enough, look at the way people spell and punctuate their replies. They still seem uneducated.", "I enjoy being a student here. I especially enjoy Helen's law & ethics class. She makes learning fun & understanding.", 'The people who work here are student focused and go to great lengths to help students succeed in and out of the classroom!']

name: Menlo College
reviews: ['Menlo College campus is a beautiful space close to the heart of downtown Menlo Park. Featuring plenty of outdoor areas for sports, walking, or even outdoor workshops, it’s a gem of the SF Bay Area Peninsula. We rent it for our Technology Venture Launch Programs to host entrepreneurs from around the world for a Silicon Valley innovation experience.', 'Cafeteria is closed all of June, no drinking water and power keeps going out. This college needs better basic infrastructure. Avoid it if you are trying to stay in the dorms in Summer', 'My parents run a yearbook camp here every year. The staff is great to us and the campus is really amazing. Small college in a great city, would have been a great place to go to school. Dorms are decent.', 'Great liberal arts school that focuses on Business. Gained a ton of tangible skills and loved the group oriented focus. Their approach to small interactive classes has a lot of strong overlap with working in cross functional groups (in the real world).\n\nThis place is a hidden gem in the bay area and most of the alumni I stay in touch with have been successful.', 'Menlo College is a simple-minded organization with no structure. The administration is a disaster, critique and comments are not just welcomed-they are punished! I told a female student to watch her eating style, as she was just throwing in pizza and junk food, and the administration accused me of "verbal harassment", which included disciplinary hearings and multiple meetings. Students are friendly, but everything is immediately seen as "discrimination" and "harassment". WAY TO EXPENSIVE for its value, just completely overpriced. Food is a disaster, inexperienced students are preparing the meals (they do as best as they can do), so what could you possibly expect. I am a freshman and will transfer after my first semester, as Menlo College is an embarrassment for the American Education System.']

name: Merced College
reviews: ['I love the good old MC! Has many new additions to the campus. I enjoyed all my professors while attending there.', 'As a proud Blue Devil alumni, it is with great honor to recommend this community college to anyone and everyone. This place helped me in so many ways. I would proudly return to complete more A.A. degrees. I would definitely return to be an employee here. The professors and other staff are amazing and go above and beyond to assist students. Love the community involvement. Great location.', "So far this college has been pleasant to deal with. No problems with staff or professors. They keep the campus pretty clean. Staff parking should not be right by all the front doors. Those spots should be for students. Staff should have their own dedicated lot. And it seems there's an awful lot of spots for staff as it is.", 'I love Merced College! Compared to Madera College, it’s a lot bigger than the College in Madera. Some of the staff is rude, others are not. I love a lot of the proffesors that teach here, some just don’t care and aren’t helpful. The programs are great and they have many resources to help you succeed in the school. The parking is ridiculous, the staff have all the good parking spots. They should leave the good parking spots for students. It’s hard to find a parking spot! The campus is very clean, and I love the vibe I get, going into campus. In all, it’s been a great place to learn and to succeed in your dreams. I’ve had a good experience here, I know some have not. But, everyone has their own opinions, I’m just sharing mine.', 'Collage campus was nice and well kept but the environment is affected by poor mannered people.']

name: Merritt College
reviews:
["​Merritt College is truly a hidden gem nestled beautifully in the Oakland hills. From the moment you arrive, you're greeted by a breathtaking campus that offers stunning panoramic views of the surrounding area. It's not just the scenery that's impressive; the college itself is a vibrant hub of learning, offering a wide array of classes to suit diverse interests and academic goals.
​What immediately strikes you about Merritt is its picturesque location. Studying or even just walking between classes here feels inspiring, with the natural beauty of the hills creating a serene and uplifting atmosphere. It’s a wonderful environment that makes learning feel less like a chore and more like an experience.
​Beyond its aesthetic appeal, Merritt College is commendably accessible. Its convenient location is made even better by easy access via AC Transit, which is a huge plus for students relying on public transportation. This accessibility ensures that more people can experience all that this beautiful institution has to offer.
​Whether you're looking to start a new career, transfer to a four-year university, or simply explore a new subject, Merritt College provides a supportive and beautiful setting to achieve your goals. It's definitely a place that combines academic opportunity with an unforgettable landscape.
​---", 'Merritt College has been a great experience for me. The teachers are really down to earth and easy to talk to, which makes learning feel a lot more comfortable. I’ve appreciated how approachable everyone is and how willing they are to help. It’s a solid place to study, and I’m glad I chose to come here.', 'Merritt College is wonderful place to attend school. Situated on a hill with an amazing view of the Bay  Area. Merritt College is the where students Huey P. Newton, & Bobby Seale founded/stared the organization known as the "Black Panthers".', "As far ask going to college merritt is one of the best places you can go. It's very diverse and you can meet other people from all over the place, it's like a big melting pot.
Different cultures, different religions.
It represents the Bay area to the fullest.", 'This school is a gem, the teachers are all experts in their field with real world experience; their Horticulture Program is phenomenal and the new campus is a real treat to be in.']

name: Northeastern University Oakland
reviews:
["I would strongly caution any family considering any form of education through Northeastern, be it post-secondary, continuing education, or post-graduate not to proceed.

Northeastern is closing their nationally-prominent and historically-significant laboratory elementary school on their Oakland, California campus after its 100th year of operation. This decision was taken with no demonstrated regard or respect for process, transparency, or accountability to stakeholders, including dedicated educators and administrators, families who have paid the school hundreds of thousands of dollars over the course of their children's education, and most importantly their youngest and most vulnerable community members: small children.

I cannot recommend putting trust in an institution that majorly and manifestly acts against the interest of the emotional, social and physical security of children. Nor can I advise trust in Northeastern’s leadership, whose management has been characterized by a total absence of care or competent stewardship for the primary academic values of respect, responsibility and honesty.", 'High star reviews are for Mills College, which it is no longer, and does not even come close to the same recognition that is now lost. Rebranding has wiped out the community and programs are completely different.', "Great location for photos. If you're a professional photographer. The Avenue of trees is perfect for you and your subject. Along with the quad.", 'I’ve gone to several concert events at this Bay Area landmark. Mills College has an amazing history of new and interesting music. I posted exterior and an interior photos of one of their fine concert venues.', 'I’m an alum, back in the day when it was a college for women, and I’m sad to report that its new owner (Northeastern) has decided to scrub any reference to social justice or equity from its website, in deference to the second Trump administration. So buyer beware!']

name: MiraCosta College
reviews: ['The epitome of what a community college is suppose to be. All around great environment.', 'I didn’t realize how lucky I was to have so many professors who used canvas and were well organized until I got to UCSD. They also have such kind and helpful disability services. I remember the first time I got off the phone with them I cried because no school had ever been so kind or helpful with accommodations before. I miss it.', "The customer service at the actual veterans service center was great, but when I was given information about the work force education center at TCI mira Costa and spoke with Carisa it was a little off putting. Felt a little discriminated against because we are a active duty family with a busy schedule. Carisa was more focused on their numbers rather then try to help work around what obstacles a military family are faced with. Was curious about their certificate programs something that could help me in my current field and all I got was a response about my time and benefits and whether or not its fits their agenda. Im not against working after a program as long as it works around our current situation. The whole conversation felt like i wouldn't be a good fit for any program because of our military situation.", 'I attended here for a semester or two and it was a very good school. The faculty was very good and the campus was clean and well-\nmaintained. The school of fine arts has a very nice theater and they perform plays and musicals there, and the performances are top notch.', 'Amazing school, great value for learning at all ages: Undergrad, graduate, business, AI, or lifelong learning. Great for veterans.']

name: Mission College
reviews: ['I attended classes here over 30 years ago and park in their lot when other jobs require us to. It is nice to visit and observe, while we are here.', 'I am a graduate of Mission College!  I can say it was a great experience.  Instructors were great and helpful.  The location of the campus was good and the environment was conductive to learning!  I highly suggest this college for the first-time college student!', 'Very nice community college campus with great facilities and amenities. Study spaces are large and there are many spaces for students to grow. The campus is located near a shopping center which makes it even more convenient for students to get food from the nearby restaurants, or even from the locations on campus. Mission College has a variety of choices when it comes to food and drinks. There are smaller cafes all throughout campus, and a large cafe with many varieties of food, and even a smoothie making robot. Overall, the school is very nice and the staff and professors are very nice and welcoming to new students. I would highly recommend people to go to Mission College for community college and to get associates degrees, or transfer credits to help them excel. The student resources are plenty and include things such as the counseling center, tutoring center, MESA, UMOJA, MSA, and other clubs that help\nstudents build a sense of community while engaging with other students with interests that are similar, and students from all over the world with their own personal experiences and lives. Overall a great school.', 'Very nice and modern campus. Professors are great and classrooms have a nice atmosphere. The cafeteria is amazing as well. A huge selection of food and drinks at a nice price too', '2nd Harvest Food Drive. Organized, well run and volunteers were very personable and spirited. Thank you so much for hosting this. There is a great need for it in Santa Clara.']

name: Modesto Junior College
reviews:
['DO NOT GO HERE!!! Teachers and most of the staff have been some of the greatest people I’ve met. But I am on my 3rd and going to be 4th year trying to transfer out because these counselors have no clue what they are doing and don’t know what classes you need to take to transfer out! You will be urged to take 1000 un transferable courses and then be slapped in this face with “oh you can’t transfer out quite yet” due to their incompetence in helping students. I thought saving money here was a good idea but good lord was I wrong, I’ve wasted now almost 4 full years at this awful college due to counselors inability to HELP. US. TRANSFER. OUT. Shame on this “college” (if you even want to call it that) and I regret every penny I spent here. If you want to transfer out to a 4 year, PLEASE do NOT go to MJC to start that process. If I can prevent one more student enrolling then I am stratified. BEWARE!!!', 'Scammer college that just wants your money. I had to move and drop my classes and they still sent me checks and bills. I had FAFSA submitted and qualified but they still charged me 100s of dollars. Watch out they really want to report you to the federal bureau.', "This BAD review is for EOP&S. When I went to apply for EOP&S, I told to first go apply to DSPS since I couldn't take 12 units and then go back to EOP&S, which I did. Then I I was told to wait for the approval & then go back to EOP&S, to which I did as well. They asked for an accommodation form and I told them that they haven't given it to me since my first appointment with a DSPS counselor is today (9/9/25) and that's when they will fill out the form and give it to me, to which, I was told by the EOP&S staff that I have to wait until my appointment. I asked him, can I just apply and then bring the for, or can you call and confirm that I was accepted and when I get the form I can bring it to you; I was told no and that I had to wait for my appointment with the DSPS staff in order to apply. The result of all this running back & forth is that now, even with the accommodation for EOP&S will not take me in since the applications deadline already closed and supposedly then, they cannot do anything about it. Thanks to that worker, that purposely caused this to me, I now have to borrow more money to buy the books and pay to enroll in a homework application because I can't afford it. This is well over $200. This worker won't pay for this, and he doesn't care. I enrolled in school because I don't have money, and these programs were created to help people, like me, who can't afford an education.", "We live across the street from MJC so my older dog who is 12 1/2 years old has literally grown up going to MJC daily to play ball or frisbee in one of the little fields they have. We go at 5 am and then again after night classes are out to play ball and go on a small walk through campus before bed. Campus security are all very nice and don't have a problem with people bringing their dogs as long as they are leashed. If you have them off leash, you must be considerate of others and don't let your dog just run up to anyone or any other dogs. If you can't control your dog off leash, keep them on the leash!.

Also, any responsible dog owner would respect the fact that the college allows us to bring our dogs to THEIR campus. Don't be irresponsible and disrespectful by not cleaning up your dog's poop! If you can't, then stay away as to not ruin it for the rest of us who are considerate, respectful and responsible.

Over all, MJC has been the biggest blessing to me and my dogs. We've spent years of daily trips and hundreds of hours playing there. Some of our best memories were made there!

Since we live in a 1 bedroom apartment and I have a cattle dog and also a 5 month old Belgian Malinios, MJC is nothing less than a lifeline for my sanity! It truly is our backyard.", 'Great community college. Excellent vocational classes and pathways to UC or CSUs.']

name: Monterey Peninsula College
reviews: ['This is a great community college. Good administrative staff and instructors. The library has an awesome view of the Monterey Bay.', 'Had such a horrible experience with admissions and records. I tried signing up my mom for the SUMMER term (in May by the way) which started June 3rd and they’re just now sending me her ID to sign up to classes. What a waste of time.', "It was great to be back again at the CHOMP Cancer SURVIVIORS Day Celebration! This is to be an annual event where doctors cook the traditional hamburgers & mingle w/ those they treat, have treated or haven't seen in months/ years bcuz they're still doing great.  It's a time where other survivors can come together & see one another for support &  paint thier hands.", 'Love being here at this school, it has a nice campus close to many places like Alvarado st. and the Del Monte Shopping Center. The teachers are nice but the food is not that great in the cafeteria. Also parking needs to be expanded because, if you do not get here early you will not find parking near your classes and have to park at the other side of school.', "Beautiful campus, and a great deal of educational offerings. I took several classes here and it really has the university buzz instead of just another community college. Only thing I didn't care for was the parking here. Its hard to find a spot at peak hours and you will get ticketed for parking in staff spaces which always seems abudant with open parking spaces."]

name: Moorpark College
reviews:
["I enjoy attending this college a lot. Most of the professors are dedicated to their subject and students; it's always worth checking their reviews because I have had a few negative experiences with mine. The student store is well stocked with super nice staff. Facilities are clean and only short walks to reach the buildings. The hill is a climb for everyone though. I recommend taking the elevator in the Academic Center to combat that.", "This is probable the nicest of the three campuses. It is large, beautiful, and full of student activity, so if you're into that kind of stuff, then you should make this your main campus.

Getting ahold of counselors can be quite difficult because there are so many students and not enough staff. The are good and bad professors, and the food is the same thing as other campuses.

Overall, this is a nice campus that gets quite crowded.

Ps. Parking can be a mountain to climb sometimes.", "Terrible counselors, it feels to me as if they're only here for a paycheck. The student-counselors/helpers are great on the other hand. Professors and classes are good as well. Do not rely on a professional counselor to help you with an ed-plan, you really do have to do it yourself.", 'Very, very large compared to Oxnard College and Ventura College. Lots of options, friendly staff and students. There’s even a zoo here and some available bachelors degree programs', 'There’s a zoo in this place and they have all kinds of animals. They had tigers, lions, hyenas, birds, monkeys and many other animals.

It is inexpensive to get in and you can go through the whole park in less than an hour but it is worth it. You will get a great close view and really appreciate their size. The lioness was magnificent.']

name: Mt San Antonio College
reviews:
['Love this place. Really great welding department and professors. The pictures are from when there was motorcycle training in Lot F, November 2025, which I think is offered through the college of continuing education.', "I have been for two in person and have absolutely loved it. The library is such a chill place where you can study or search from a vast array of books. The Student Store is also very extensive with lots of merchandise, snacks, and textbooks for every class you can think of. Because the textbooks are all for sale, I am even interested in buying books for classes I don't even take just for a good read. Lastly, the Audio Arts program, which I am enrolled in, is very good, so far at least. They have an extensive library of tools like microphones, stands, preamplifiers, DI boxes, and plenty of other equipment for other majors available to be checked out respectively. This Community College deserves every star, especially the 5th one for it's beautiful campus.", 'As an architectural and landscape aficionado, I’ve been attracted by the art of design. Here at Mt. San Antonio College, buildings have modern interiors, typically visible at most any college campus. Outside, cool looking designs echo college campus trends of the last fifty years. Courtyard exteriors are accented by soft concrete edges of new-age attributes and natural gardening and rock.
I can also appreciate the emphasis on sports, not only within the school curriculum, but also with regional events of visiting team competitions!
This community junior college appears clean and well maintained, tho some of the common area landscaping seemed to be a bit sparse with irrigation. In times of drought, that may be understandable.
There’s over 400 degreed and certificate programs. My favorite subjects are available here, including horticulture, science and technology. There’s even an observatory and planetarium!
I visited here as part of the sports complex of events and was impressed by what I’ve seen, notwithstanding the overall student experience as mentioned by others. So I’ll keep positive on the visual and leave the inside scoop to those who are able to describe it, as they’ve seen it.
For a quick nature walk, I’d recommend seeing the Mt. SAC Wildlife Sanctuary, it’s at the southwest side of the campus, just south of West Temple Av.', "Parking is horrible for those who are going back, really long walks, some professors/ teachers are good and others are rude  especially the one teacher lady telling me to quit/drop off on computer class and a the picture class teacher was rude because im wearing flip flops on the day but i was wearing shoes and in the final semester test he was behind the wall and looking at me to think I was cheating which i never did but he doesn't like I'm in he's class. And the counselors could be tiredness by having new every year and not having your original counselor and one of the counselor woman was rude and even offensive in few years ago she telling me to go to west covina to get a job career not taking and helping what class should I take for my future. but really nice feet and flip flops for college folks.", 'Visited the theatre for a performance. Some event staff were kind & helpful. Others made rude comments under their breath & seemed annoyed by folks presence to support their children. The theatre itself was beautiful & the show was amazing. Hoping our next visit is better.']

name: Mount Saint Mary's University
reviews: ["Such a very beautiful campus! Staff and the students we met are very nice and helpful. I'm such a proud mom that my daughter is choosing to attend this Mount St. Mary's University. If you get the chance to go make sure to visit the National Shrine Grotto of Our  Lady of Lourdes, it's a very beautiful place. You can walk through a outdoor Sanctionary and it is connected to the campus or you can take a short drive up.", "Graduated from there in 1989. Transitioned from College to University while I was there and also jumped to D1 athletics.  The campus is beautiful and yes, its in the middle of nowhere (and not far from everywhere) but the school is what you make of it.  Don't regret going there at all.", 'Beautiful & stunning school ! My daughter got accepted 👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻🎉🎉🎉🎉🎉🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰💯💯💯💯💯\nStaff & students are so nice & the school always very clean !  Beautiful cathedral just the whole campus is amazing 😉', 'Love the the scenic view. The grotto chapel where Sunday service mass packed with people the time we were there.\nNice place to pray and feel the peaceful sanctuary of the Holy place of the mountain.', "The Grotto is a small spot of heaven here on earth, and it is full of saints and artwork.  The glass chapel is breathtaking, and everything is reverent as it should be. It's one of my favorite spots on earth. I have been coming here for 25 years."]

name: Mt San Jacinto Community College District
reviews:
['MSJC Cares! This community college is a great pathway to achieving a career and ensuring you get a quality education at an affordable price. Before heading to a university, I went to MSJC and they were awesome! I love that MSJC is community-based and is welcoming to all walks of life. I recommend their history and English department! The counselors are on top of things and they try to get you into a class asap. The campus is pretty clean and they have great breakfast burritos at the cafe! I would also suggest going to the library, I love the tutoring center!, it was so helpful!', 'Boys tennis is amazing. So competitive & respectful.', 'Our son a Summa Cum Laude graduate enrolled in Analytic Geometry/Calculus II online with Nizam Kazi, the professor at Mt. San Jacinto College.

He sought clarification, but instead of receiving help, he was met with sarcastic remarks from  Nizam Kazi, dismissing his mistake rather than offering guidance.

This experience left our son feeling unsupported rather than positively challenged.

We demand Nizam Kazi adopt an improved constructive approach when interacting with students in the future.', "I go to school here and so far all the teachers I have gotten have been amazing. They are really patient and kind. The best part about classes at msjc is that they have tons of classes that are online so even If you don't have time to go in person you can study online any time. The only slight problem is that they don't have enough full time in person classes. The ones that they do have get filled quickly. Leaving only hybrid and online classes. Other than that this place would be one of the schools I would recommend, really getting the best deal for your money. MSJC is always trying to improve as of this review it is under construction to add new buildings. There is sufficient parking and parking for people with disabilities. They have a Cafe that is small but gets the job done and the food is great. They also have a theater that is a decent size have plays once on a while.I was also fortunate enough to meet the dean and he was an extraordinary figure. This is a school that I would choose over and over again if I got the chance.", "There is a professor Mrs. Gold something she's an older woman  organic chemistry teacher, that is totally rude and strict one student was really sick and she literally was throwing up and even told her she was throwing up and she said oh just push throw it.. even though this professor would take a day off or two for class. Which is highly hypocritical. The poor student barely made it to the bathroom to throw up. Also the school fails on safety for the chemical labs. And can cause a serious health hazard."]

name: Musicians Institute
reviews: ["We had the pleasure to meet with Eddie from the administration office. Great tour, a prime location, and offers all you can possibly dream of as a musician/student. No parking but there's plenty of other types of transportation. There's a $100 application fee for applying to the school.", "I've been a student at M.I. since October and I'm having the time of my life. I just hope they reopen the Hollywood Blvd entrance soon so I'll stop getting harassed by the Scientologists whenever I walk past the Church of Scientology on my way to my car.", 'Patience, patience, patience. I went here in 2017 for the independent artist program. This is when I first started getting into producing my own music. Yes, I thought I would come here and would immediately get my songs on movies and TV. This was not the case. However, this school will give you what you put into it! I learned very much from here, spent almost 10 years grinding, not getting any traction. But finally, within the last two years, I finally am getting placements on major streaming services (my goal going into the school). My advice is STAY in LA, after you graduate! They aren\'t nessisarly gonna "hand out" contracts and all that. But if you DON\'T GIVE UP you got thisss!!!!', 'lots of famous rock musicians including John Frusciante and Chad Smith went to this school. I wish I could have been one of them!', 'I am so disappointed I wasted my GI bill at this school. The registration staff is rude and unprofessional, the instructors don’t seem to want to be there. There’s a lack of accountability from the staff and instructors. Think twice if this is where you want to spend your money. The value isn’t there. It’s a shame because they have lots of potential. The musicians that work there are truly amazing; They just don’t seem to have the support they need, and your success as a student is not in their interest. The school just wants your money and it’s very noticeable.\nVery disappointing.']

name: Napa Valley College
reviews:
["This community college really helped me get back on my feet, and I couldn’t be more grateful. Compared to the other local colleges I’ve attended, this one stands out in every way. The faculty are passionate about their subjects and genuinely care about their students' success. Most of the professor I’ve had has been not only knowledgeable but also approachable and kind.

The campus atmosphere is peaceful and quiet—perfect for focusing on your studies. The dorms are clean and comfortable, although, like much of California, the cost of living is on the higher side. That said, the sense of community here more than makes up for it. Whether it’s the staff, professors, or fellow students, everyone is respectful, supportive, and easy to get along with.

If you're looking for a college with a welcoming environment, quality education, and a calm place to grow, this is definitely worth considering.", 'Great local college with lots of affordable options. If you’re continuing student, they make it very easy. Or if you’re just somebody in the community Who wants to take a few classes for fun and enrichment. They also help you with that process. Ive been taking a few ceramic classes here and have thoroughly enjoyed it. I feel like it’s a very good space with great resources, and just a delight. I recommend this class for lots of people and the school.', 'I came to this college feeling empty but when I left after years of studying and tutoring, I was full of knowledge.  I had my confidence again. I had help from everyone; the English center worked tirelessly with me to correct my essays and the tutors in the math center with their big support for me to understand my statistics assessments.....this is just to name a few. In this college, when you are dedicated, you will get all that you need because they have all the right people to help you.', 'I came in to see if I could see a counselor about upcoming classes in the spring although it seemed like computers and self-service was the main offering. I did however get to speak briefly with the counselor that was on the computer that offered to help so I’m hopeful that I can get my questions answered although their website had many 404 error so there’s definitely, some room for improvement', 'We have amazing emotional ties to this college it really is one of the best places of learning for those embarking in new directions preparing for new careers in business the arts public service or preparing for university if they so choose it’s a great stable foundation for higher education with an amazing staff and counseling staff  there for you at every turn to advance your goals. I am honored to have been subjected to such an amazing beautiful campus and so proud to be able to say that my wife is also helping those who are envisioning a better future through education.']
