name: North Georgia Technical College
reviews:
['I went here and got my certificate of hair design. I do not recommend going here for many reasons.

If you are wanting to go to hair school here, I would recommend going somewhere else. I’m not even sure where to begin with it but main thing you need to know before going there is that if you have health issues, you’re gonna have a much higher chance of failing then everyone else. They may tell you that their way of handling things is policy of cosmetology state board that is completely not the case. One of the leaders of the cosmetology program was once out for like 3-4 months and we lost a LOT of class time because of it. But when I went to the hospital every time I got points taken off for attendance.

I honestly ended up being very stressed throughout my time at NGTC and the more I failed the more I failed. That’s on me. But they took points off for me as much as they could. They also BARLEY gave me clients because the system of giving clients is entirely up to what student is at the desk. No one liked me so literally I had 10 clients. I had to change from cosmetology to hair design because of it. They actually literally gave me one client the 10 weeks I was taking skin and nail clients. I was destined to fail. Every time I did a State Board Practicum test I failed. They took off points for actually ridiculous things that state board doesn’t count off for.

I managed to SCRAPE by through school. I felt honestly like I had failed.

Then I went and passed my written and practical state board with a matching score of 84 on the first try.

I finished everything but I don’t believe I’ll go on with hair because I no longer find joy in it and I won’t lie I’m not good at it. But, these people will make you feel like you aren’t good at anything but don’t let others belittle you into believing you are destined to fail.

The administration is also not great. I wont name names but I have witnessed a lot of discrimination. Once an administrator referred to a friend of mine as “He, she, it, whatever” and a narcissist for speaking out about something.

It’s a low cost school but if you want to REALLY learn certain things it may be best to go somewhere else.', 'I have attended here several times for various degrees and certificates. Instructors are always top notch. The facilities are modern and clean. Parking is convenient to classes.', 'Bathrooms were always clean and the lower-level staff were genuinely super kind and helpful. They really made the place feel welcoming.

Upper management was a completely different story. I'm honestly surprised no reviews have brought this up. I ended up transferring after just one semester because it honestly felt like harassment at times.

It definitely seemed like "certain" types of people were watched more closer than others if you catch my drift. I received an uncomfortable comment from one of the main admin, and the fact I couldn't do anything about it has been eating away at me for a few months.

The school is affordable, and none of the buildings I went in felt trashy. If you do decide to go here, I’d recommend just going to class and heading straight home. Keep to yourself. And if any of the top 3 managing staff approach you, be polite, but don’t engage more than you have to.', 'Anna Johnston went here it has to be a good school. Amber Johnston is the all knowing.', 'I attended North Ga. Tech. and Vocational school in 1974. I played basketball for Coach Elrod and I was one of the top players in Junior college. Also, I concentrated in Welding where I received my diploma. The environment was great and the student body got along really well.
I definitely enjoyed the environment and the fresh air each morning that I got out and went to my class!!. Also, I worked in the dining hall to receive a check every 2 weeks. Luckily, I didn’t have to pay any money to attend NGT. Enjoyed my stay on the campus..']

name: Oglethorpe University
reviews:
['Between the endless begging alumnus for money, tossing an unholy amount of money into ostentatious buildings, and lowering their flag for a far right podcaster for over a joking week they’ve earned these 2 stars.

Why not one? I do have some fond memories there. But for sure my degree is about as useful as a roll of quilted northern in income generation.

Oh and someone tell them the last two flags on hermance are about one stiff breeze from breaking away from the pole (three have already bit it you’d think they’d be on top of that as you know that faces Peachtree but I guess marketing/admin is pretending that’s not a thing)', 'The show was enjoyable. The drones with their colors and patterns corresponding with the dancers and their moods told the story so passionately! It was truly felt inward! Great job! 👏🏼', 'Outrageous tuition costs and insufficient aid available to combat yearly tuition and fee increases', 'Called ahead to see if I could use an ebook because I’m not a student they said yes and then I went in and they told me no. Would have be super easy I needed to read a 50 page play drove 20 miles', "Forever grateful for my education here. Small classes with personalized attention, liberal arts education, focus on service, combined with access to Atlanta's large city resources all create an incredible educational experience. They are also generous with financial aid."]

name: Paine College
reviews: ['The STAFF is horrible, provides wrong information. We went for admission day staff was very rude. No one’s calls back after leaving message, ask for refund for dorms they sent it back without my child first name just middle and last. Been callin no one has yet to call back.  No seems like they can answer my questions just keep passing me to someone else I’m glad my son didn’t attend with me living in New York, now we have to wait till next semester to find another school', 'I am not a student here, however I hope the school administration see this review on their students. Some of Paine College Students are nice polite and show much reflection from their school standards and teachings. I cannot say the same for all of them. Their mouths are filled with vulgar language and filth. They are rude, impatient and don’t reflect their college in a positive light.  I just couldn’t get over the nasty language. My interaction with some of them was at a family orientated arcade. Also, half of the male students smelled like marijuana. Beware if you are looking to attend and coexist with this students. So much for being a Christian College.', 'This College loves to come in really big groups to restaurants, and leave out without tipping their waitress. Not to mention, they all came in as a Not to mention, they all came in as a big group 10 minutes before closing Big group 10 Minutes before closing.And the coaches were with them as well. They should be ashamed of themselves. So if you work at a restaurant and see them coming, be prepared to work very hard for them with no tip.', 'Very clean campus. Friendly atmosphere!', 'Currently attending Paine College and love it, I\'m still proud to have been a returning student despite all of the personal issues w/ the school. Make no mistake the controversy is not an overall representation of the school or the students, we all are hoping that it will just be "the past" at some point.(2015)']

name: Piedmont University
reviews: ["The music conservatory at Piedmont is exceptional in the performances.  Well worth the drive and maybe a ticket, although most of the performances I've attended were free and open to the public.   The Chapel has such great acoustics  and the PIPE ORGAN - Lovely!!", "I read about this school years ago was almost closed for lack of students. Now it's bustling and beautiful and briming with happy students getting a quality education while enjoying campus life in the Applacian foothills.", 'Seems like they care about the quality of work and construction I would imagine they value the students highly', "As a parent of a Piedmont student I highly recommend this school. She had all the support and opportunity you could ask for.  Everyone I've met on campus over the past three years have gone out of their way to make us feel more than welcome. Like family! Top notch education! Thank you Piedmont!", "All but one dorm hall is run down or dirty with no plans to renovate. Professors won't help you succeed, instead they will just fail you and tell you to figure it out. Campus Police is full of rejects from other departments across the state and will only harass you and try to make themselves feel better. All in all, I would strongly recommend against this school!"]

name: Miami Ad School-Atlanta
reviews: ['This is an excellent school, that will give you real world skills that will pay off in the marketplace. It is also a tough two year (or more) program where I had many all nighters to get my work done. The culture is a competitive one and also one where you will learn excellence. Not sure who was more talented the teachers or the students. Anyway if you are serious about working in one of the fields of study that they offer then it is worth going for! It paid off for me and I feel it has turned out to be one of the better life decisions I have made. If I could do it all over I would have had a four year degree completed before going there. Because I was so busy after graduation, it was difficult to return to school to pursue a degree but I did manage to go back and get an Associates Degree. It may be worthwhile to ask to see a copy of the job lists that they provide their graduates and also reach out to graduates in the field you want to pursue via social media or LinkedIn to find out about their careers.', 'I’m extremely glad I came here and I learned so much about myself. But, as an autistic student, it was terrible. I had to work at least twice as hard as my fellow students. When I expressed I was having a hard time to the higher ups, they suggested I worked harder. The other students were allowed to bully me incessantly, which was brought to the attention of the staff, they did nothing. There’s no help for students with learning differences. While trying to get clarification, I had multiple teachers yell at me and refuse to explain things differently; they felt repeating the same instruction louder was sufficient. This school is hard enough without a brain that sees the world differently. Also, there is no elevator and no accessibility for anyone who is disabled. Those of us who are disabled and have divergent thinking, deserve equal education, too. Especially when it’s $5000+ a quarter.', 'Greatest thing to happen to the visual arts since paint', 'Best life choice I have ever made.']

name: Reinhardt University
reviews: ['Prices are better then in Canton and Jasper GA. Local since I live in Waleska. Shop is always clean a d the staff is always friendly.', "Awesome visit also I get to watch them play. Let's go Eagles!", 'Nehal and the rest of the workers are always very kind and accommodating! Great selections of liquor as well. Highly recommend', 'Had dinner at Gordy Dining Hall. Everyone enjoyed the meal.', 'Love playing the disc golf course and greatly appreciate having a couple of the buildings left open to use the restrooms. I lost a disc because the grass was very high.']

name: Savannah Technical College
reviews:
["I had the pleasure of having Dan, Tripp and James teach me through my CDL A course and I will say it's the best experience I've ever had in a learning setting acquiring a new skill. They were very attentive and detailed in any questions or concerns myself or any class mates had during the course. They taught us everything we needed to be successful in our future careers on the road. Larry was a wonderful test taker he was very informative on areas I was lacking in and parts I may have missed. Leaving the school is giving a bitter sweet feeling because I will say I enjoyed waking up every morning to meet up with the teachers and classmates to push toward our success and the daily banter of everyone.", 'Overall the staff has an attitude problem when you ask questions or ask for updates (after waiting months). Little to no real help enrolling. Task that should take 1-2 days took 4-6 weeks. My advice is find a better school that is mentally and physically invested in you + your future.', 'My experience as an advanced aged learner was awesome. I will never be able to thank my advisor, Ms. Joyce Johnson enough, she was most helpful during my two years, up to and including the graduation process. My department chair in Criminal Justice, Dr. Anthony Nixon, PhD, was truly instrumental in the completion of my degree. These two people were the reason that I was able to hang in there and get the paper(degree/diploma). My only frustration was, I could only register on the first day of class; age 60 and above students are eligible to have their tuition covered by the state, but you are responsible for the cost of your  fees and  your books. You run the risk of not receiving your first choice of classes and might have to wait until the next semester for a given class. However, I was able to complete my two year program one  semester early.', 'Starting an electrical course with Savannah Tech in January semester, from the UK. I am rather shocked (in an amazing way) how smoothly the process went. I received my I-20 much quicker than I ever anticipated. I want to give a massive thank you to the staff at Savannah Technical College - in particular Dr. Tristam, who has been a great help throughout this entire process. I sincerely look forward to my studies in the upcoming months!

Thanks again.

Adam', 'Feel like a scam!!
I submitted my application for Fall semester 2025 in April. Paid the fee and all that. Ended up with nothing! Didn’t hear anything from them at all even though I emailed and called almost every day asking for assistance with the student portal where I can’t upload any required documents.Oh and I even emailed them those documents to the emails listed on their website.. Still NOTHING!
This school is a joke!']

name: Savannah College of Art and Design
reviews:
["OK I went to SCAD back in the olden days...  Was it expensive even back then? YES! BUT the teaching & training you receive is top notch. When I graduated people were giving me interviews just because I went to SCAD! If people saw me wearing a SCAD shirt they would say did you go there????? like I was wearing a Harvard or Yale shirt. So did it open doors? Yes! Did they help me get a job after graduation? No. But I'm a Graphic Designer & have never been out of work much in the (many years) since graduation. Now I own a very successful Printing & Marketing company In the Tampa, FL area. I LOVE SCAD!", 'I've been to a public community college, as well as a public 4-year university prior to attending here online. This has been by far the WORST experience I have ever had trying to pursue my education. I had been accepted during the add/drop week, and the financial aid office told me to "wait" till after the add/drop period to see my balance go down. It never happened, and I was stuck in an insanely expensive quarter. I had accepted my lost, finished and passed the quarter, and began to work on paying what I owed. I set up a payment plan and was in contact with the supervisor over collections. I followed up, asking for help as the online payment system was NOT working, to never receive a response. My bill got sent to collections with a fee despite my good faith and having contacted all I could. I followed up multiple times till I finally got a response (Juliette Denmark), got the fee removed from collections, and eventually got them to stop reporting to credit agencies. I had to follow up with her multiple times to even get a response however, even going through the presidents office.

I will never suggest SCAD, I will never attend here again, and I am thoroughly disappointed that a school wish such a high-regarded name, could perform like this. Not to mention, during my quarter AI was heavily used as a teaching component. A majority of my peers, including myself, mentioned how uncomfortable we were using mandatory AI for assignments in a college of art and design. Don't go here.', 'Love and Savanah College of Art Design in Fashion show and Fashion clothes Fashion style in Fashion stylist and Fashion model in Fashion Dress and Fashion magazine in cover Girl and Fashion Design in Fashion week and Fashion jewelry in Fashion business and computer in write and paper in copy machine and print in Folder and My own office in organize and Manger in business woman', 'When I called, the representative I spoke with was exceptionally courteous and professional, which I truly appreciated. However, our experience with the advisor has been quite disappointing. He scheduled a Zoom meeting, but this is now the second time he has failed to attend, leaving my daughter waiting alone in the meeting. This lack of follow-through is unacceptable and reflects poorly on the level of service we were expecting.', 'Don’t waste your time at this college — it’s a waste of money, especially in the architecture faculty.
The professors are not objective and show favoritism, there’s a lack of empathy.']

name: Savannah State University
reviews: ['This has to be one of the worst colleges ever. My daughter’s experiences has been traumatizing since the first day she has attended. The rooms are always flooding, there are shootings on the\ncampus, and the paraprofessionals never return your phone calls or emails.', 'I wish I could give no stars. I started off trying to reach a medical clinic. Not one phone was picked up by a real person. Sometimes it was a fax, sometimes a "leave a message", then there was the no one is at this extention then lastly, after five rings, the call disconnects.\nEven admissions says we are either away from the desk or on another call. Ridiculous!', 'Do not apply! Their application process is the worst that I have ever experienced. They do not follow up with the required information to assist the applicant with the process. I have made calls on a continuous basis, and it seems that you are a burden if you ask for assistance. Now, they are stating that I have to reapply by paying the application fee again and resubmitting everything again. No, thank you. I expected more and will not take part in anything that deals with this HBCU.', "Does anyone ever respond to emails or return phone calls? We have been trying to access our child's email since 4/25/25, put in a ticket with IT help desk on 4/28/25 and as of today no response. I have called and emailed on several occassions since and still no response. We're constantly receiving emails about applying for housing, financial aid award letter to confirm but how can we? We still can't access anything without our credentials?", 'My son transferred to SSU mid-Spring 2025. There was a delay in processing his application because my son did not submit all of his documents timely prior to Thanksgiving Break 2024 (e.g., transcripts from his dual enrollment college, images of front and back license for verification of lawful presence, did not periodically check admission status and follow-up). After his emails to his counselor went unanswered for a week or so, he learned he was assigned a new counselor/advisor. After he made several calls to SSU admissions, one lady went out of her way to view his email transmissions, collect his last document (while on the call), and gave him his new counslor\'s name, email, and phone number. The "admit lady" told him to expect a call from the counselor within 48 hours; if not, call her (admit lady) back in Admissions. For my son, lesson learned. He stayed home during the Spring, took classes online during the last minimester (earned two A\'s), and is taking classes now in Summer school (I expect another set of A\'s). He is back on track academically and will move on campus in the Fall. He looks forward to the SSU experience and earning his bachelor\'s and master\'s degrees. A special thanks to SSU Admissions and Counseling.']

name: Shorter University
reviews:
['A wonderful institution that prepared me for graduate school at Johns Hopkins. Their science department is growing, and the faculty at Ware Hall is unprecedented. I wish they focused more on the arts and sciences, and not just their sports. As a conservative, I wish they were more open to liberal opinions as well, to be completely honest. Nonetheless, Shorter is an amazing place to attend for undergrad. Some of my best years were on the Hill!', 'What a wonderful dinner and Darryl Strawberry was amazing, great testimony and story. To God be the Glory ❣So thankful to see so many student athletics hear his witness.🙏❤🙏', 'ZERO POINT ZERO ZERO on a breathalyzer.
ZERO bac on a blood test.
ZERO drugs in his system. NOT even aspirin.

Yet this college threatened to kick a 19 year old off of the sports team because rome cops falsely arrested the kid.

Charges were dropped but now you have a young adult that hates cops and college', 'My daughter has had a wonderful first semester at Shorter. It has been a safe and affirming school for her even in the midst of COVID. The school has adapted and sought to make life as normal as possible all the while keeping the students from getting sick. I am grateful!', "I went to Shorter for a year. The school is really expensive for no reason at all. The freshmen dorm was outdated. The cafeteria was once the school church. It looks nice but the food was awful. I got food poisoning twice. Also I was apart of the track and field team. If you're going to run for the school your teammates are going to want to get into your personal life. They're going to tell you your going to hell if you are not religious at all. Also expected hypocritical actions. One minute they are you friend and the next they hate you for being an individual. The only good thing about this place were my roommates and some friends. The small to medium class environment was great."]

name: South Georgia Technical College
reviews: ["I have been going to South Georgia tech my whole entire life since I was a kid. They had an awesome aviation school and they also do a lot of other awesome classes for a multitude of different things. Today is the first time I went there in about 20 years. But it wasn't for school or class it was for a job that I'm working construction on. It was still when I remember from 20 years ago. Awesome! :-) I love you all and shalom", "I went there around 6 years ago to go to the CDL program.  Best choice I have ever made. Thamk y'all!", 'Why should I pay my hard earned money to attend classes here? All that seems to happen is a person stands in front of the class, gives you handouts to complete,  but FAILS to actually teaches you anything. If you are going to hire someone to instruct a class make sure they can actually help people in the classroom! I am watching many people in my class struggle due. The instructor also seems to have an issue staying on task and bounces around causing more confusion.  This place seems to be a complete waste of time. I will be looking for another school that can actually teach me.', "So far, I got my son set to start the 2025 summer semester. We visited the school and it was welcoming and although it's a technical school, the energy is good and optimistic. Everyone from emissions, financial aid, housing, teachers and all were polite and welcoming. i will give another review after we get down the road.", "Hello,  I graduated from South Georgia Technical School in 1981, I loved every day of school.  I had three great instructors, two Jack's  and one Big E AKA The Eliminator, so you did your assignments.  I road a 1980 Honda 750F 4 into 1 header no baffling. 93.7 average Diesel Mechanic, Earl the Pearl the greatest in the world."]

name: Spelman College
reviews: ['I’ve been trying to contact Spelman for nearly a month to request a syllabus for a class I took while attending years ago. My current university needs it to evaluate whether the credits can be transferred, and I was directed to the English department for assistance. Despite multiple follow-ups, I haven’t received a single response.\n\nIt’s extremely disappointing to experience such a lack of communication and support from an institution that prides itself on academic excellence and sisterhood. As an alumna, I expected at least a basic level of responsiveness and professionalism. I truly hope Spelman improves its communication process for former students who are simply trying to continue their education.', 'Class of 2019. Spelman not only provided me the best education but also a family environment. Thoroughly grateful.', 'Spelman college provided me with many fond memories, even as I attended Morehouse! I actually took a few classes there -- the professors are very dedicated to teaching and your education. As a former student of their neighboring school, I can also say they throw some pretty awesome events!', "Spelman is just as amazing as the first time I entered her gates, decades ago. It's a magical place.... A lot of Black girl magic is bred and molded there. Thank you for your contribution to society!", 'Best time ever enjoying family weekend.']

name: Thomas University
reviews: ["I have applied to Thomas university and the high school I attended sent my transcripts to Thomas university VIA email 2 times and by USPS one time. I have been in contact with them several times and was planning on starting this fall. I have called numerous times and the staff member that was working on my application said he had dropped it and had to reopen it. I have no idea why they dropped it in the first place. He said he would call me back so we could get financial aid and a schedule to start. It has been 2 months dealing with this and still haven't heard from anyone. It seems they have all the students they can handle since they can't answer phones or follow through with enrolling new students.", 'Thomas University locally was known as Birdwood college. Local land owners loved this Red Hills district of Southeastern United States', 'Do not bother with this company, if you are attempting any CON 091 or other FAC level 1 courses. Enroll in Management Concepts. The exams are not graded correctly, horrible online course, no wonder the students in my course did not pass or stay engaged over a long extended period. I had correct answers but exam app graded as wrong. Save time, money, and energy elsewhere! What a waste of time.', 'My daughter attends TU and plays softball. Her entire experience at the school has been challenging but positive.  I appreciate all TU professors due to insure success. Thank you!', "The worst the EDU grad program has some good professors but the school is so disorganized it was awful. The cohort I was in must have been the test group when I say my frustration level was at a 10 I am being kind. TU came to the district I work in and made it sound as if they would work for working students this was not the case  it was as if they had no clue we were teachers. There selling point was we understand the life of a teacher well they do not. I do not want to participate in graduation I am just glad it's over. I will not be participating in any of the commencement activities at all but I have already paid for my room therefore I will go. I will be walking and as soon as it is over getting in my car to drive back to Atlanta!!"]

name: Toccoa Falls College
reviews:
['Toccoa Falls Bible College!!! 🌎World Missions Department and tons of degrees offered. I graduated in 2007 and now our oldest will attend.

Absolutely amazing experience. We lived in the city of Toccoa and absolutely loved our time here. Such a great college holding two traditional values.  “ where character is developed with intellect” true to the word as listed on the sign as you pull onto the campus. 🔥🎚️🔥

A wonderful place to visit if you’re passing through and an especially blessed place to attend if you’re looking to grow in Christian education and potentially serve in ministry or various other fields. ⚓️ Jesus is King 👑', 'Lovely grounds and public access to a lovely waterfall. Easy walk on a flat, short pathway.', 'Unfortunately, the experience with this basketball program did not meet expectations. The senior athletes showed NO maturity for a collegiate team especially for incoming freshmen and the overall program lacked professionalism. Greater emphasis on player development, discipline, and competitive preparation would benefit the program greatly. Campus was okay. Cafeteria food disgusting!!! Staff and professors not helpful. I would not recommend this college to ANYONE!!!', 'My wife went to college here over 30 years ago and we still keep coming by to visit the beautiful campus. Two of our children are considering coming here after they graduate high school. The professors here are distinct in their fields.', 'Beautiful campus… and that’s the only positive thing I can say about this school. Terrible experience for me; rude and judgmental people, terrible social life, and the feeling of being stuck at a Christian summer camp 24/7.']

name: Truett McConnell University
reviews: ['A lot of walking, but a very nice campus, with some beautiful views!', "Really great university with helpful and caring professors and staff - including cafeteria, library, and security or janitorial/grounds staff. I'm proud to have graduated from this school. The grounds are beautiful. Some of the buildings are older than others, and you can tell, but in general if anything is ever truly broken, the school will repair it. Beautiful campus with stunning views! And a small enough number of students that you really feel cozy and at home here. Definitely not a party school, but it is absolutely a Christian school. It isn't perfect, but it's wonderful, and everyone really does try their best to make it so. I highly recommend it. I will never forget my experiences here.", "Went tonight for the Ukrainian dinner. It was very good. Dinner was only $10. If you haven't been to Carol Ann's at Truett you need too.", 'Went to Preview Days and all went well. All our questions were answered and our daughter is considering this school as her number one option! We are praying and considering all our options!', 'Best kept secret in Cleveland. Great atmosphere on the Truett McConnell University campus. It is refreshing to be surrounded by great students, unlike most other colleges. Big picture windows across the back for a beautiful mountain scene. Great food, salad bar, breakfast bar, handmade burgers/omeletes depending in the day, (the menu varies) and the best fried chicken around.']

name: Wiregrass Georgia Technical College
reviews: ['Never can get in touch with anyone via email or by calling the campus.', 'This school is actually pretty great. I can see why it has such high reviews. At first I had problems with uploading my documentation and I got pretty frustrated, didn’t get any responses from anyone to help resolve the issue, had to wait weeks just to get an email back, but at the end of the day what really counted was that I got a reply and with that reply came absolute great service. So honestly I can’t stay mad. Thank you Wiregrass and especially thank you to Mr. Warren. 😘', "Great junior college for those who want an affordable education and for those just starting out.\nAlso great for those trying to specialize in a particular field.\nThe professors are very friendly. They'll make time to be sure you know the concepts that they're teaching.", "This school fosters a sense of success not only with their students, but also with their staff. I've never experienced a business with a greater sense of community than Wiregrass. I highly recommend it to any potential students.", 'I just got the most amazing face-lift in my whole entire life! Thanks Violet Young Avedissian for all your wonderful help and amazing treatments.  The oxygen face treatment gave me results right away. I just ended looking 10 years younger! 😁💋❤']

name: Valdosta State University
reviews:
['A disgrace for a higher institution of learning.
I do NOT advise anyone to attend VSU. You pay all the fees that are required of you and they still charge you some more fees down the road like you never paid in full. Scam!
You would call the admin office till the cows come home. When you do get a response it will be a dead end.
As student here, you are just a paycheck to them. There have also been accusations of discrimination and racism and poor advising of students. Students do not receive enough counseling from their advisors nor do they receive the support they need from my experience.
At orientation they will show you a nice face until you actually settle in and see this institution for what it is- a sorry excuse for a higher institution of learning! I would not attend or send my child to this school!', 'I have a daughter and son in school at VSU.  Very nice campus and curriculum.  Hopefully my other 2 children will keep VSU as a family tradition.', 'Beautiful campus!  Received my BFA here and still enjoy visiting the campus for portrait shoots!', 'I did a tour here, did not end up applying but was because of a change of plans. No issues with the university. Their student leaders were very helpful in answering my questions and the campus is very well maintained inside and out.', 'We loved it. Pretty campus and nice people.']

name: Wesleyan College
reviews: ['Very interesting Van Vleck  observatory is open to the public for hands on tour every Wednesday evening. 8- 9 pm  (Be sure to check the website first ).Located next to the Olin library on Wesleyan campus Middletown CT. Fun visit ☺️', 'My 50th reunion was great. Remains a challenging and exciting place.', 'Would I sell my soul to get admitted here? Yes.\nUpdate: I GOT IN WOOHOO!!!!', 'Beautiful campus. Great atmosphere. Nice town', 'Excellent liberal arts college in CT']

name: University of West Georgia
reviews: ['The University of West Georgia, centered at 1601 Maple St in Carrollton, is frequently celebrated in my professional and social circles as a premier "destination university" that masterfully balances a sophisticated research agenda with a deeply personal, student-focused atmosphere. From numerous substantive discussions with local entrepreneurs and alumni, a clear consensus emerges that UWG operates with a merytorical depth that transforms the "Go West" mantra into a tangible reality of career success and intellectual growth. My colleagues often highlight the Richards College of Business and the university’s top-tier education programs as evidence of a curriculum that is both academically rigorous and profoundly attuned to the shifting demands of the modern workforce. In frequent conversations about the Georgia educational landscape, the public sentiment consistently praises the institution for its beautiful, walk-friendly campus and its unique ability to foster a vibrant "Wolf" community spirit that lasts well beyond graduation. I am particularly struck by the faculty\'s unwavering commitment to mentorship, a sentiment echoed by many families I know whose children have thrived under the university’s sophisticated guidance and hands-on research opportunities. It is evident from the collective feedback of those I trust that the administration operates with a transparent, forward-thinking vision, ensuring the university remains a prestigious and dependable choice for those seeking to make a tangible difference in their fields. Reflecting on these consistently positive testimonials, I view the University of West Georgia as a distinguished institution that executes its mission with undeniable class, academic moxie, and a deep respect for the potential of every individual.', 'My Granddaughter goes here. We went to takehere out to eat for her 19th Birthday. She is doing good so far. It her 1st. Year. The Campus looks safe I worry but also Pray the kids be okay. 🙏', 'Today is admitted students orientation day. It is a beautiful campus.', 'Be prepared to run behind every department and triple check to make sure what you need is actually being done.\nThe staff in certain departments is also passive aggressive.\nIf you’re not having to choose based on affordability, don’t come here.', "I didn't go to school there, but the campus has so much natural beauty."]

name: Young Harris College
reviews:
["10.04.25 encountered a van on the highway with this college's logo all over it.  Clearly like an athlete transport van.

Driver was camped out in the left lane & refused to let drivers pass on the right.  (PS, this was in NC -- they were headed from the direction of Asheville back to GA.)  Law here is if you're not actively passing anyone, you need to be in the right lane.

Driver was going below the speed limit so I moved over to (illegally, I know) pass in the right lane.  Driver went from doing 45MPH to nearly 80MPH just to prevent me from passing him.  Driver then began driving aggressively down a windy mountain highway.

I did pass him & stayed in the right lane to which he then rode my bumper for a while, made aggressive lane changes around other vehicles & then sped up again to an improper speed before dropping WAY back speed wise & exiting towards GA.

Perhaps not the best move in a vehicle with your college's logo & # all over it.  Just saying.", 'very nice staff and pretty area', "Great! Their athletics department and fields are amazing. I was there listening to my son, Spencer, do PA announcing for the Women's Soccer game. He is a Communicstions Major there. Go YHC!", 'Beautiful campus with amazing views year round. My daughter attends the college and loves it.', "Very pleasant place to visit. All the kids on campus seem nice and friendly.  If you don't  know where a certain building is, they are willing to help get you there."]

name: Chaminade University of Honolulu
reviews:
["Chaminade is a wonderful University. The sticker price may look high, but over 90% of our students get financial aid. It's a picturesque campus with world-class faculty and a low student-to-teacher ratio. You'll never be a nameless student in a sea of faces! With an average class size of 16, you'll get plenty of individual attention.", 'I used to be in a mentoring program for Nursing students at the university. I learned that the program is well organized and that the classes are engaging. The four students I know who are in the program now are doing well. I also know a few people who have graduated and are working in the nursing field. They speak favorably of the program.', 'Love this school.  Beginning my Masters in Business Administration (MBA) program this week.  Firstly, I started by enrolling in MBA 600; Human Resources online.  Within the first day or two of the course opening up, Dr. Wilson my instructor called to see if I needed help with anything.  Mind blown.  Whoever has the tenacity to do that with students?!  Very excited to have my MBA complete in 21 months.  Chaminade University offers a very scenic setting and personalized service.  I find it preferable to have  a classy private school education here that I can take with me for the rest of my professional life.  Stoked :)', 'We heard about Chaminade University from a friend and when our daughter was accepted to Manoa and Chaminade, we flew out to tour both colleges. Both were beautiful but we were sold at the sheer “like home” feeling Chaminade offered. Everyone was so friendly and the dorms felt like a smaller scale apartment building. Don’t get me wrong Manoa was GORGEOUS and great, but the common bathrooms shared by each floor was a big concern for us.

Chaminade is small enough where the teachers and staff actually know your name and there’s a wonderful support system for their students. Our daughter came from a small private school in LA and we felt leaving the mainland and coming to HI was culture shock enough; so coming to a smaller school
offered  some familiarity and comfort.

She is now in her second semester of her second year and absolutely LOVES it! The island, the school, her 4 Roomate’s, and her new island Ohana have made this her second home, and we feel very safe with her there.

I can not say enough wonderful things about this school. From the way they handled the pandemic, to their small classrooms & fun activities- it’s just amazing all around!', "Went for a meeting on Kalaepohaku Rocks, due to covid and everything were headed towards November/December 2022, St. Louis staff are friendly and personable, like because alumni association makes it possible for any boys to attend Saints. They said in the televise 175th. Anniversary, Whether parents are affluent, middle income or below,every boy that's interested.  Allow St. Louis Administration decide what each boy financial aid will be in order for him to attend  Red, White & Blue Crusaders
Exactly as they said the how upper classmates take cares to the lower classmates as younger brothers.  Boys of Kalaepohaku Ahui hou"]

name: University of Hawaii at Hilo
reviews:
['I had a wonderful experience here; I loved the intimate and personal class size/student-to-professor ratio, which allowed for better, more in-depth learning. Also, I had a smooth experience transferring from my junior college in California to here, and had a lot of faculty help along the way; the college is very organized (answering phones most of the time I call, getting new students set up w/financial aid, etc.). The only thing was that, sometimes, it was hard to get in touch with a few professors, but once I did, they were very accommodating and memorable. I also made friends from my TESOL teaching certification program…I miss it so much sometimes; I may go to grad school here! :)', 'I love UH, however I was recently dropped from Czarski’s class after completing assignments up to week 3, simply because I missed an assignment in the first week. I do not place blame on administration, as my professor submitted the request. However, I believe that it is unfair to have been dropped so late when my professor could have requested that I be unenrolled during week 1, or at least informed me not to continue doing assignments. Be mindful of the classes you take, and do your research on who will be leading your learning!', "It is very anti democratic when it comes to having students a voice on this campus... they don't have a student union... only one that is controlled by the administration... Most of the administration is helpful on getting you in the door but once you have a grievance beware the gossip fest and lateral violence through exclusion. There are some great teachers here but there is one who hates men in the political science department and will do what it takes to give you the lowest grade possible if she does not like you.... beware of the karen!!!", 'As a solo backpacker, I found a spot on the campus wich i could just lie down on the floor and sleep without getting disturbed!', '1.EXTREME LACK of PROFESSIONALISM (ex. JACKIE SALES-IYO)
2. Math Department, FYI - smart people don't always make good teachers,
3. If SUM OF the SO CALLED school staff (COUNSELORS & DPT. HEADS INCLUDED) would stop GOSSIPING & LUSTING after the students MAYBE IT WOULD BE A DECENT SCHOOL, INSTEAD OF A SHALLOW TOURIST SCHOOL.
4.Good teachers don't last there because the "BACK STABBING IMMATURE" STAFFERS TARGET the GOOD TEACHERS making their experience not worth TOLERATING.']

name: University of Hawaii at Manoa
reviews:
['Checked out the campus and was impressed by the staff and the layout.
The tour guide who was also a student and DJ at the school station was very informative and able to answer the groups questions. The tour went quickly but was actually almost 3 hours.', 'The UH engineering at Manoa is superlative. It leads an excellent cutting-edge research project on global computer networking and communication over decades. The renowned Aloha System is the fundamental framework of modern wireless communication and WiFi back to 1970s. It’s a fantastic place for graduate study and advanced research. It’s also one of the most enchanting and beautiful campuses in the world.', 'Amazing professors, great academics, beautiful campus that is very warm and inviting to all students! Extremely impressed! Most Highly recommend for matriculation!', "One of the most beautiful, inclusive, and friendly college campus. I went to record a Youtube campus tour video (find me at College and Career Champion). I had a wonderful time meeting welcoming students and staff. It is clear there is a strong and supportive community.

Bring an umbrella if you're worried about random showers :)", "It's such a beautiful campus. Didn't get to look at everything, but just the entrance, and that had so much history."]

name: Hawaii Pacific University
reviews:
["I had a great experience at HPU and highly recommend it. The smaller class sizes make a big difference and allow for more personal time with professors. They truly care about their students and will go out of their way to meet with you outside of class time to support your success.

The faculty is excellent and the coursework is challenging in a meaningful way. Being located in downtown Honolulu is a huge advantage because you are exposed to many businesses and industries, adding real world experience to your education.

What really sets HPU apart is the island environment and the Aloha spirit. There is a strong sense of community, respect, and support that you feel both on campus and throughout the island. It creates a welcoming and positive atmosphere that makes learning and living here truly special.

I also got involved in clubs and had a great experience connecting with people from all walks of life and from many different countries. The diversity at HPU is incredible and so is the food :-)

Don't hesitate!!!!!!", 'The reasons why I think HPU is a HORRIBLE nursing school:
- Does not help students with their problems if they request help for.
- Students are told to use the chain of command, but no one assists them with the problems brought forward.
-students feel unheard.
- Student careers are jeopardized and threatened by staff despite being disorganized, unprofessional leadership, poor communication, and untimely or unclear requirements and expectations.
-Clinical Professor was 3 hours late with no communication, then students went home. Professor stated if you dont come back to class you wont be-able to take the nursing boards
- Professors are unprofessional and not held accountable.
-student pay $38,000+  in tuition for poor education.
-staff state we are “lucky to be here” when students bring forward problems
-student request professors to support them and they mocking respond - what do you want me to do about it?
- Professors have emotional outbursts, are moody, and treat students differently based on their emotions.
-professor are passive aggressive, disrespectful, aggressive, temperamental
-toxic learning environment
- you go to the professor for a simple question they cut you off
- coordinators do not give the same opportunities across the class (skills, procedures, interventions)
-First semester classes were predominately taught by Nurse Sarah on YouTube videos. We had to watch content on outside sources because the professors failed to properly prepare us.
-Students are set up for failure!
-facilities ran out of locations for medsurg clinical so extra students were placed in geriatric care facilities just to complete/compensate  “hours”. Students are not receiving an equal education or practicing topics learned in lecture. Students in the same semester are learning completely different skill sets.
-Professors dismiss student concerns, are close-minded, and are not receptive to feedback.
- Communication is last minute.
-no communication.
- Emails are sent at 3am telling students where to be at 7am.
- We are told when, but not where or what time.
-Multiple people or sources give different information creating confusion.
-Mental health lecture professor is belittling and demeaning.
-Professors and advisors send untimely emails and respond only partially. Either they do not answer at all or do not answer all questions asked.
-We are assigned many quizzes and tests online (PREPU Lippencott/Kaplan) just to check a box.
-Advising takes weeks-months to respond and months resolve problems.
-Professors show a lack of respect toward students but demand respect in return.
-processors seem lazy.
-We do not have time to truly understand the content because of the number of random assignments on various websites.
-It feels like we are just trying to pass, not actually learn.
-Professors do not encourage critical thinking.
-Classes are death by PowerPoint with no interaction, encouragement or student involvement.
-Professors are no show or arrive hours late without informing students.
-Students are told to figure it out when asking for clarification.
- the staff retaliates when students defend them selves again unjust treatment.
- Unfair due dates
- subjective grading
- using a textbook that is not updated.
-lack of teaching and explanations on tests errors.
- stunts/prevents growth
- does not teach real-world application techniques.
-test and quiz contain questions that are not on the content assigned or on chapters that haven’t been taught.
- never follow the syllabus
-tests are not based on the PowerPoints
-expects the students to teach themselves when we pay to be taught.
-Nursing Professors are not qualified to teach based on their teaching and leadership skills and unprofessionalism
- They answer questions with riddles and indirect answers. Leaving student confused.
-There is a perception that leadership is indifferent and that students are treated as numbers rather than individuals.', 'Pretty bad school overall. Horrible staff and administrators, poor student living situation, and unprofessional staff all around.

NOT worth the amount of money they charge. The school is insanely expensive for a poor experience', "I can't wait to start at HPU. There are so many committed professionals who truly believe in the mission of being student-centered. They live it each and every day.", 'The faculties here at the registrar and business office are undertrained and not professionals at all! I’ve spent over a few months in my last semester getting a private loan and they’d sent me general emails if I don’t pay I would have financial holds that will not allow me to get my diploma or transcripts which I understood but if I do have a loan coming through to please let them know. I spent over 1-3months letting them know that there is a loan coming but did not go through so had to go through another company which didn’t accept or went through til December. Now tell me why all the calls I’ve made I was told that as long as my disbursements will go through they will waive my late fees. I’ve called in December that the loan has came through but it hasn’t updated in the system unfortunately it was winter break and was told it would be signed off til after holidays which is usually after the 1st week of January. Time went buy and I called again being told multiple times that yes the late fees can be waived just to be transferred to some rudely individual from the business office that they will not do it because the semester is over and I had the loan in too late. Where was all this information when I was going back and forth for months and reminded the employees to keep it in my notes in my account. She told me that there’s nothing, no notes then was interrogated who I spoke to and why I needed them waived. Too bad I did not remember her name ( **reminder to all always get their names**) but this person really blamed me saying that the semester is over that I should have known the academic calendar that it’s common sense that because the semester is over that I can’t get my late fees off and even questioned my experience asking who told me that. I should not have been talked down like that at all. Like are serious?! I would not be wasting my time dealing calling back and forth and asking for late fees being waived off for months if I wasn’t told that it will be waived off. I am a hard working person but I don’t make enough here so of course as a student with no financial support I asked help to my university and ask where they can help me to reduce what I owed. What kind of support and aid is this university is hiring if they are giving out false information and promises and then blames the student who was just following up what has been told to them. This school has some great amazing professors that care but some of the staff members that they hired has been an extreme let down. What a horrible way to remember my last semester. All this school wants is money, I wished I did transferred to UH.']

name: Honolulu Community College
reviews: ["Great staff! Very helpful! I haven't seen a safety program from any other college that can top this one. Great advisor and experienced instructors.", 'So far the campus seems fine. Due to the pandemic most classes are online so the population on campus is sparse at best. Staff, security, and other employees are friendly.', 'Great services. The place is under construction all the time, but the curriculum is great. An older college but the student life organization maintains the area well.', "Was here for a friend. Have to say I was very impressed with the campus, security, and the staff. Very well put together, and executed campus. I'm rethinking my online studies and switching to HCC. Wow......keep up the great work folks!!", 'The teacher who teaches ESL23-24 is very rude. She like using threatening words to respond the student , if you want to ask or figure out any further issues of your homework or tests. She looks kind at first , but when you get her class , then you will find her teaching method is very arbitrary. I never met this kind of teacher before.']

name: Kapiolani Community College
reviews:
["Really beautiful cactus gardens!!!

Free parking.

Every Saturday till 11am there's a farmers market.

Do take the time to stop by on your way to the Diamond Head hiking trails. It's beauty will not disappoint. Watch for birds coming.']

reviews: ['Side note here.... go here on Saturdays since they have their farmers market. Awesome selection especially starfruit, papaya, avocados, honey. Also great source of local food. Or to students who want a cheaper stepping stone alternative leading into the UH system.', 'Kauai Kim Chee Bulgogi Sliders Kalbi', 'Excellent Farmers Market on Saturdays']

name: Leeward Community College
reviews:
['Leeward Community College (LCC) is a "best value for your dollar" if you are seeking to pursue higher education. It's conveniently located near central and leeward Oʻahu with accessibility via public transportation. For commuters free parking is available, however the lot fills quickly most mornings, so it's early bird gets the stall on this one.

This four-year college provides degree programs in a variety of disciplines including culinary arts, education, health, communications, and technology, among others. LCC offers robust distance learning options, programs for non-traditional students, and a head start program for high school students.

LCC is a firm stepping stone toward an advanced degree and a terrific environment to hone current skills or retrain in a new industry.

Those who are considering transferring from another institution should careful check your transcript to ensure that your credits are transferable. Even if a class has the same course title, syllabus information may be valuable for approval. Keep in mind that transferred credits are at the discretion of the institution and may vary from program to program.', 'It was a great experience attending this local college when I lived on Oahu.  I still cherish the lessons learned and the great instructors, who taught well.  This college was a great way for me to start my college journey.  The campus is isolated from the main community but it was worth the effort to attend it.  After a few semesters as a student, I graduated. I am joyful, and still proud, of my first college degree which I earned from this college.', 'School experience fine. Admin / counselors , horrible. I’m incredibly disappointed with how Leeward Community College handled the Interstate Passport program, especially given how much I trusted their advising over my two years there. I was told by my LCC counselor that completing the Passport would allow me to transfer my general education credits anywhere in the country, and I worked hard to meet every requirement even scheduling my last class during Summer 2023 before transferring to Nevada. I was assured I was “all set” and had completed what I needed.

What I wasn’t told not once was that the entire Passport program was being discontinued in 2023. No email. No warning. No update from my counselor. Nothing.

When I arrived in Nevada, I was told by my new university that they do not accept the Passport, because the program was no longer active.

I had taken specific classes, spent money, and delayed my transfer to follow LCC’s advice. I trusted this institution to guide me, and they absolutely failed me.

This was negligent advising at best and a complete lack of transparency at worst. If LCC knew the program was ending (which it did), they had an obligation to inform students who were actively enrolled in it.

To the University of Hawaii and leeward you failed me.

(Yes I talked to many administrators and higher ups even at the main UH campus) they could’ve cared less about my situation and wanted to play golf or whatever event the guy on the phone with me was at', "I love school so I might not be the best person to take advice from, having said that Leeward Pearl is a really great place to go to school. They have a Subway, and the instructors really help you to complete graduation. I also like the fact that the Rail system let's you off right on campus!", 'Two stars because of two of my professors being incredibly kind and understanding regarding my severe medical issues.

The rail system is now complete, which means that the bus no longer goes to the school itself. I'm physically disabled and often left sweating and in pain while walking to and from the rail, which sometimes means that I'm late to class. Attendance is now mandatory for a lot of classes and my grade has suffered severely for it, both in regards to tardiness and not being able to come to school. I've had a professor kick me out for leaving class for all of five minutes to get food because I was on the verge of passing out. Yes, he did give me the OK to do so. Multiple people confirmed this. I did not go to anyone about this out of fear that he would fail me.

The school is literally falling apart, and the construction made everything difficult for everyone. They have/had several parking lots closed off for the majority of the summer and fall semesters, and a lot of my classmates opted not to come at the risk of failing due to how awful everything was during this time.

The disability services center isn't really useful. I've had several professors who completely ignored the mandatory emails I've sent them regarding the service, and don't honor the extensions I've requested. I was made to feel incredibly shameful and irresponsible for having my parents speak for me when I was going through a nonverbal episode, which the individual I was talking to regarding the service was very much aware that I suffer from.

While I understand that Da Spot had no control over their funding, Leeward has not provided any alternative food services outside of two food trucks that come for an EXTREMELY limited time and not every day, and Subway, which many students do not like, myself included. I am not blaming the food trucks nor Subway for this, but it's incredibly difficult to get through the week as I rely on food that was served at Leeward. The food pantry is available and I'm extremely grateful for them, but a lot of the things they've had I've either been allergic to, or they require cooking at home.

My friend was assaulted and they sent out an email about it to THE WHOLE SCHOOL without asking her first. She was extremely upset over this, and rightfully so. I myself am a survivor, and wouldn't feel comfortable coming forward about anything that happened to me, especially since I've had a professor tell me to "just go to security" and completely brushed me off when I told her that a man was making me uncomfortable, and that I'd like to wait in her classroom rather than outside, shortly after the incident. She's also shamed me multiple times for my health issues. Fortunately, the man in question no longer goes here. Unfortunately, I don't feel safe nor comfortable going to faculty regarding things like this for previously mentioned reasons.

My friend (40) went to Leeward when she was my age (20) and she says that it was nothing like this now. She's made the decision to send her children to a Mainland school because things have gotten so bad. I no longer want to go to this school, and any and all faith I've had in college has been crushed by my experiences at this school.']

name: University of Hawaii Maui College
reviews: ['I came back on island having been away for a decade and was happy to see UH\'s presence on Maui.  The buildings are beautiful and a sight for sore eyes!  A decade ago, there was no official "university" level campus here on island. The fact that you CAN get a bachelors degree while on Maui is a HUGE improvement in serving the people of Maui County.  I have read some of the reviews about "room for improvement" etc.  Of course there is room for improvement (!!)  but I love the growing part of this as well.The staff was iinformative, friendly and eager to help.  It shows that the progressive minds on Maui is supported by higher educational institutions. I am hopeful for what is to come. I took a couple of photos of the campus while stopping by and am I already seeing the campus grow and grow, filled with eager minds =) Hooray for us all.', "I have always loved the pursuit of academic knowledge. Attending this university has only made my love for this grow. Great staff, better location, and a great place to learn. I have had so much fun learning here. It's been nothing but my pleasure to attend this learning establishment. Mahalo for your time. Aloha", "I got my A.A. degree here in two years. Then I took outreach courses for UH Manoa from Maui's campus before eventually moving to Oahu and completing my B.A. at Manoa. I had some good teachers here, and some not so good teachers, but my counselors were all great.", 'I can understand how someone that expects attentive "customer service" might be frustrated with Maui College. There is definitely room for improvement in this regard.  Yes, you may have to hunt some of the teachers down to get service, get overrides or deal with other items (like getting a grade, lol).  However, the content, facilities and opportunities for learning and personal advancement are there.  It is up to the student to be proactive at managing their education and career goals.  I guess my point is, Maui college is not immune to the "island style" mentality... some people find that to be negative, others positive and some, like me, are just so stoked to be living and attending school on this magical island that we don\'t care... we just do what it takes.', 'First class meal from the culinary students. Amazing flavours in each dish. Actually a very good value compared to local restaurants. Check it out, 2 days a week it’s offered.']

name: University of Hawaii-West Oahu
reviews: ['The University of Hawaii West Oahu needs to contract another vendor to take pictures at their commencement ceremony.  Everything I ordered was broken and damaged.  The coffee mug... broken handle in the box.  The magnets.... worn and scratched like it went through the washer dryer. I was able to earn two degrees from this campus!  They were just beginning to offer classes, and we had to have gotten our lower division classes at other campuses!  I am glad to learn that they have became a full four-year university!', 'Awesome school if you are interested in business! name: Boise Bible College
reviews: ['This location can provide accommodations if you are looking for a space to host an event, conference, concert, wedding, etc. They have a comfortable facility, large field, outside sitting areas, large amount of parking spots, and great views of the Boise foothills.\n\nFor those interested in attending... Boise Bible College is rooted in biblical teaching and will not budge on their beliefs!', 'Good things are happening here.
