name: Ivy Tech Community College
reviews:
['I’ve had some great experiences with certain faculty members here, but I have overall found Ivy Tech to be disorganized and the curriculum to be lacking.

The Jake reviewer is correct, the teachers at times have no idea what they’re teaching. I found out that the teachers can’t even view the pre-written lesson plans until the week the class starts. They also can’t edit or adjust any curriculum that they find to be incorrect or outdated. I’ve done too many labs where the equipment straight up doesn’t work, or Ivy Tech has different equipment than the curriculum does. Oh, and the class times are not very flexible unless you’re doing a completely online degree program such as business or accounting. Are you a Nursing, engineering, welding, robotics, or other health science/trades major? Better hope you have a flexible job.

The reason I didn’t give one star is that I have had some great advisors, great instructors despite the confusion with the pre-written curriculum, great experiences with the tutors and library staff, and also made friends here. I also didn’t have to pay any tuition for my associates degree due to financial aid programs.

Overall, Ivy Tech is a great place to save some money or even go for free if you can, but expect a headache from their bureaucratic processes.', 'WOW! Practicing law here is the greatest decision of my life. From the professors to the student body… 10/10 experience. If I could give it 6 stars, then i’d push it up to 7 cause that’s how awesome it is. Especially loved how much my S/O loved living here too. So if you are looking for your next chapter and have a partner who is coming with, GO TO IVY TECH!!!!', 'This is the worst school ever, and I regret choosing this school when I moved here. I was taking online classes for not even two months, and they dropped me. I’ve been reaching out and couldn’t get in contact with anyone. When I finally went to the school, they told me everything was on Zoom. When I eventually spoke with someone, they told me I was dropped for attendance even though I was taking online classes and always completing my homework. Nobody ever told me anything about Zoom classes, and none of the professors emailed me about it. They just dropped me without any explanation. This isn’t even my first college. At my previous school, if something was wrong, they would email or contact you to discuss it. In Indianapolis, Ivy is the worst school ever. People warned me about this school, and I didn’t listen. Now I see that it’s true.', 'I earned 2 degrees in 2 years. As President of the Human Services Club and Phi Theta Kappa Public Relations Officer, I enjoyed my experience at Ivy Tech.', 'If I could give Ivy Tech a negative I would. I had to pay out of pocket for my prereqs because I already had a degree.

Now I am one class away and Ivy Tech put a hold on my account for a book I NEVER GOT FROM THEM FROM 2024! They just put the hold on in October, 2025! This means I cannot get registered to try to get into the program I want that opens  once a year.

Happy to take your money but not happy to help you or are constantly trying to steal your money for things you did not do.

Disguisting']

name: Purdue University Fort Wayne
reviews:
['Good arts and such here. I took my kids to a number of shows in their theater and it was not too expensive for the whole family. They also had an international themed festival on campus that we went to and there were many good activities for kids at no cost. Good place in our community.', 'Going to this school was the best decision I ever made. I got a quality education with friendly professors who you could tell were passionate about what they studied. I was in the College of Liberal Arts, and it was fantastic! I made so many friends here, the campus is beautiful, and it is easy to navigate. I suggest getting involved in student organizations because it is a great way to add to your resume, have fun, and make connections, memories, and friendships on campus. I am proud to have gone to PFW.', "While the professors and actual academic staff are phenomenal, this school will suck you dry of every penny you can have when simply trying to balance life and school. I had to drop out of classes only two months into the semester due to health issues, and I am now dealing with attorney fees and court cases. Even though I followed the parameters outlined by the university for withdrawal, I am being plagued by financial burden for withdrawing in my best interest. The Board and the Bursar's office are cruel and careless, they just want any money they can to cover the fact that they need money. Do not attend here unless you are 100% certain of financial longevity.", 'Staff goes overboard to help you in all departments. Easy parking. Safe campus.', 'Investing in university summer camp was a GREAT decision when looking ahead at options in the industries of interest, but one so close to home.

We appreciate the STEM offers this year!

Thank you Purdue!']

name: University of Indianapolis
reviews:
['Fall Term 2025.

If you are considering attending this university, I strongly recommend you reconsider. I withdrew from UIndy before my first semester even ended due to the consistently unacceptable conditions and treatment I experienced.

Many professors behaved unprofessionally, often treating students as though we were in elementary school rather than in higher education. One course in particular required a graded food journal that contributed to the development of an eating disorder, an outcome that should never be triggered by a university assignment.

The residential conditions were especially alarming. My dorm had black mold actively growing inside the AC unit, and the communal bathrooms were covered in mold as well. I woke up sick nearly every morning, likely due to mold exposure. Even worse, every email or call I made to report the mold issue was ignored. Not a single person in housing or maintenance took responsibility or followed up. An unacceptable response to a clear health hazard.

When I sought help for any issue whether in person, by email, or over the phone, staff repeatedly redirected me to different offices with no one taking ownership. The level of disregard for student concerns was incredibly unprofessional and disheartening.

The dining hall conditions were also substandard. Food was frequently burnt, cold, or poorly prepared, the environment was unhygienic, and even the drink machines were rarely restocked.

To make matters worse, I am still waiting for a refund from the university. Each time I inquire, I am passed between departments with no clear answers. After more than a month, there has been no progress.

Overall, this university caused me significant stress, health issues, and unnecessary hardship. Based on my experience, I strongly advise against enrolling here.', 'Please for the love of God make a course on teaching people proper directions and how to direct people. This employee or student lead us to the opposite side of the building and then tried to tell dispatch how to get to them the wrong way. My God people Know your directions. You are looking pathetic...', 'Duo Espana as part of the Classical Guitar Series at the Christal DeHaan Fine Arts Center. Awesome!
Very nice facility. World-class acoustics. Comfy seats. Well-maintained.  Ample parking. Centrally located, but not downtown. Love going to events here!!!', 'I transferred here after attending Indiana University my first year of college.

I felt the college is a great option for students who want more attention and a smaller class size. I always really enjoyed my time at UIndy because of their great and supportive athletic department. The school being smaller gave me more opportunities to fulfill my dreams and do what I wanted to do in college.

Like everything, it is not for everyone. I believe it is a great school though and should be considered by all. It ended up being a perfect fit for me.', "This school is not worth the money you pay to attend. The professors do not teach and the advising is horrible. I know this isn't high school, but you basically teach yourself at this school. If you ask for help the professors pick and choose who they want to help. I sent a lot of time in tutoring labs and was still told wrong. The advising does not communicate with each other when a new change has be established. Not happy with Indiana schools at all! Best of luck to other students!"]

name: Indiana Institute of Technology
reviews:
['We visited the school for a campus visit on one of their GOIT days.  It was an amazing experience.  From the President of the School and First Mom to the admissions office and their staff, KUDOS.  The amazing hospitality was greatly appreciated.', 'Dropped into a Indiana Tech University a Norfolk Indiana for a woman’s wrestling camp.

The campus is small but incredibly new beautiful and seems to have everything a big university would offer.  It seems to be conveniently located on the west side of Norfork here in Indiana close to plenty of amenities.

From what I’ve seen the staff and coaches here are top notch in first class very good at conveying information in a modern world atmosphere.

This university competes in the NAIA division for sports and it does have several sports that I’m sure you can see from their website.  The overall feel of this place is that it’s new it’s clean and it really is a gem.

We specifically came here for wrestling camp and to check out the wrestling program which seems to be a new program yet growing fast and improving constantly.  Really like the wrestling camp because it gave technique live competition and classroom time for evaluation of such things as weightlifting nutrition and technique breakdown', 'The university is the best for engineering and business students. Fort Wayne campus is charming and peaceful. An ideal place for learning more updated and advanced skills.', "I contacted this school 3 separate times to get information to book the bowling alley. No one has responded. I started in early March with the first inquiry. I sent an email, that probably went to admissions. And a week after a thought about it I realized what I did, and figured just maybe the email would get forwarded,  nope.

So a little while later I called, whoever was directing the calls may have sent me to the wrong extension because I left a voicemail, name, number, and the reason for the call. And doubled back right after the call and did an email inquiry directly to the Andofer event information request.  Still no answer.

I don't understand the point of having the ability to request information but never getting a response.", 'My son is a freshman at Indiana Tech. And I love the campus and how friendly the staff is every where you go.']

name: University of Southern Indiana
reviews: ["The faculty tries their hardest to teach, but this school has absolutely been set up to filter out poor people. I am a GI Bill student and the admin has done all they can to push me out to make room for rich kids. If you are prior military or not from a rich family, be very wary of going here. The bursar's office won't give a single damn about you I promise.", "So far my experience with my professors have been amazing. However, the staff of the Financial Aid department as well as the Bursar's Office are not friendly whatsoever. I don't typically write reviews but it is just so frustrating to have someone condescend me and be plain rude when I am asking about financial questions. The university  provides excellent education opportunities in all fields and everyone here works together to make top notch.', "It's a great place to be. The climbing center was probably the greatest experience of my life", "Very clean campus.  Always something being improved.  The Social Work program is excellent.  Atmosphere is always great.  Walking trails are nearby.  The only thing that I can really think of is that the flow of traffic is dangerous in that area.  The professors are kind in the Social Work program.  I don't know about other studies, but the SW professors work really close with the students.  They are true mentors for the students and guide them through their time on campus as well as abroad.  This is an excellent school.  It is on the far west side.  It provides a good space for Evansville residents along with neighboring counties or some from Illinois.  And, have to mention, an excellent basketball team."]

name: Indiana University-Kokomo
reviews: ['Very pretty campus! I just installed one of my sculptures for a 2 year exhibition loan. The grounds staff were super professional and efficient during the install. name: Indiana University-South Bend
reviews:
["It's a great campus wonderful University people are very friendly in very easy to get around", 'I went here a year after high school from 2009-2012 then transferred to Western Michigan University to finish my bachelors and masters. Id say that it was a pretty good school. I was out of state, so that made it pretty expensive. I really enjoyed my professors and the small class sizes. Academics were challenging but definitely do-able. Not hard to get on the deans list if you show up and do your work. I would recommend.', 'I will soon be an alumni of this campus. As I reflect on the experiences I have had at this college, I greatly appreciate all that I have learned. Several of the professors in the business school have heavily influenced me to pursue my goals and have said that they would always be willing to give advice along the way. While this school still needs more remodelling, it is slowly catching up with more modern looking buildings.', 'IUSB is a terrible institution.  While I was attending this school, I learned to realize that you should never count on anyone in any administrative role to care about you.  In my opinion, the university cares about one thing:  Money.  They could not care less if your professor is a dishonest instructor that has to curve grades to pass students, they could not care less if you have any disabilities outside of physical disabilities, and in general, they could not care less about you.  Now, that doesn't mean that every instructor was terrible.  I had some great instructors there.  However, I still hated being on that campus while I was there.  Almost everything about the place made me transfer.  They like to talk it up as some sort of growing, vibrant campus that has a lot of fun stuff to do.  Wrong.  It's boring.  They have two little restaurants that serve generic garbage food that aren't even open late to accommodate the on-campus students, the "events" they hold on campus are usually a joke as well, and normally have some sort of Liberal slant to them (which, the campus is primarily composed of Liberal Arts majors that are tree hugging hippies.  That's okay, but not for a university-sponsored event.

Additionally, a lot of the academic advising is poor.  Before I switched majors, I had an adviser in the Education school that never once responded to my emails or phone calls for assistance.  Only when he needed additional information of ME did I get a message.  However, it never addressed anything I asked.  The business school was better, but they still have a lot of garbage professors.

I don't know why this school tries to present the image of awesomeness that they attempt.  Take a tour of campus and see for yourself.  Experience the putrid smelling and poorly cleaned restrooms (even the remodeled or new bathrooms smell!)

It's just not a great place.  You may enjoy some classes, and perhaps you may be able to get a job outside of Michiana with your IUSB degree, but there's  a lot to not like about this school.

However, if you are a guy, the girls on campus, for the most part, are plentiful and absolutely gorgeous.  But, if you care about your education and getting true value for your money, do yourself a favor and go somewhere else.', 'I came here at Masters of Music, which is a very mentally and financially demanding. There is no medical insurance offered for graduate students yet I was demanded to be at school for over 30 hours a week doing useless ensembles ( 2 required a semester). The inflexible program makes it impossible for you to work a job that can provide health insurance. I came there to study with faculty not for the program. While I am grateful for Dr. Muniz and Dr. Olivier, the program is not worth the demands. The administration offices will not help you and in fact find ways to make your already draining and stressful schedule more of a headache. Such as students are forced to attend recital hour, and also turn in  5 cultural events (basically only IUSB recital events, however this is not mentioned in so plainly and bluntly as it should be.) Students must pass this class 8 semesters (4 if a graduate student). The problem is that the instructor waits until the end of the semester to tell you that your 5 events submitted early in the semester are not going to be approved, which means you have to take this class again. The problem is: this is Friday at noon class, so if you come back an extra semester just for this class, it will interfere with your ability to have a full time job with any benefits. The administration will treat you poorly but expect you to praise their school. The ensembles are basic, a very conservative and religious choir, orchestra and wind band. The school should have a rock/pop ensemble but god forbid enabling students with any skills they use in the present. If you are a creative person, look at Columbia College Chicago. The administration at IUSB has almost zero accountability therefore your money, time and mind will be swallowed up by their incompetency.']

name: Indiana University-Bloomington
reviews:
["All you will ever be to this school is a 10-digit number. It does not matter how strong you are academically. It does not matter if you want to do high-level research. It does not matter what issues you are facing in your life. You are a student ID number. Nothing more.

Though I'm sure the athletes get plenty of special treatment.", 'College football has become MLB baseball. It doesnt count what you do, it is pay to play, and it isnt competitive and should qualify as Anti-Trust. Ooo the Yankees or Dodgers or Mets bought the best talent again= same as college football now. Its a charade', 'Love the campus! So much history and beauty.
So many students are willing to help for anything you need. Everyone seems so nice, even the squirrels.
Food on campus is good too.
Would recommend a walk around the campus.', "Bait and Switch University. They lure new students with the Kelly School of Business undergrad program, and then after you decide on the school they change the freshman year GPA threshold to qualify for the program starting your sophomore year. Not only do they change the rules after you're already in the school, but then they put you through classes that were strategically engineered for students to fail. Single credit classes that are more difficult than 3 credit classes, taught by teachers that don't teach. Students have to self teach themselves classes like accounting.

They lure new students with an undergrad program they have no intention of ever putting you in.

Do your research before spending your hard earned money in this scam of a school.", 'Great college. Beautiful campus. School of Music has some amazing professors. Indiana University offers a World Class Education.']

name: Indiana University-Northwest
reviews:
["My Experience at Indiana University Northwest was Amazing! I met so many Good  Friends!   I enjoyed  my Program's Classes I Took!  My Professors were awesome!  They All worked Hard to Help the Students Succed in their Individual Program.  Many Students have the Opportunity to be Involved in Activities!
I  am grateful that Indiana University is Involved in Helping the Community's in Northwestern Indiana!
Their CURE Program is another Example of how Many People They can Help! Thanks to Indiana University Northwest Programs!", 'My children participated in IUN’s kids college this summer. My son was apart of the medical program in which they learned about a variety of things including prosthetics. My daughter was in the business program where she had the opportunity to pitch her cosmetic line to a panel. The program was a renewed success & my children met kids from all over the region. Very positive experience overall.', "I can proudly say I have two students attending. The staff is very approachable and knowledgeable. Very clean school. They are always willing to give you a tour of their school. I visited and saw their students art work. I was blown away! Made me emotional, I LOVE ART! They have a Starbuck's. You just have to see it. Their tuition is reasonable for everything they have to offer. I appreciated everyone's time. I definitely recommend!", 'I met my husband here so I’ll give 5 ⭐️
But seriously, the professors overall are great and for 1/4 of the price I paid when attending IU Bloomington I’m very happy I switched campuses.', "They have some outstanding faculty members here. They have some nice athletic facilities. The theatre and art studios are impressive, state-of-the-art. But Gary is definitely not a good location for a University, that's why it gets three stars."]

name: Indiana University-Southeast
reviews: ["Easily the worst university I've ever attended. Teachers quit mid-semester and were replaced with people who didn't know the subject. The police chief would often harass students as well. I got a full refund for all my classes here. Don't waste your time. The good reviews are mostly staff members.", 'I like it. The tour was fun, and the open house was also fun. The female (that she showed us a tour) was nice and cute. Thanks for sharing this with me and my dad! 5/5.', 'If you’re a person of color planning to join the cheer team then read this. I got kicked off the team over text messages saying I’m “intimidating, rude, and uncomfortable.” I barely spoke to any of those girls and let them say anything and everything about me and to me, but once I spoke up for myself, the head coach did not like that. I wasn’t allowed to wear my curls until I repeatedly told her my hair was getting damaged then she finally told me I could, as long as my hair is “maintained and polished.”  I was told from the beginning two of teammates didn’t like me because I was black, my hair would get called weave and three girls would put on a “blaccent” around me. The coach had favorites and it shows really bad. This schools cheer team isn’t worth it and i suggest cheering for a different school especially if you’re a black girl.', "My daughter went there for 4 years and after paying all that money to graduate, they held their bachelor's graduation outside in the rain. All of us family members and the graduating students had to sit in the rain for hours, while the staff was under a make shift platform. How disgusting and low class can you get? From what the students say their new chancellor decided they weren't worth her paying the money for the regular facility they usually use and they weren't even worth using one of the campus buildings.  So, you mean to tell me, these young adults worked that hard and couldn't even get a library or gym on the campus. She needs to fired!!! You don't try to save money at the expense of these graduates who have paid and worked very hard to enjoy having a graduation ceremony with their family members.  Some were disabled and elderly standing in the rain for hours only out of love for their children. How disgusting. Please fire that", "I personally really enjoyed my time here. As others said, being a bit off the beaten path it's more of a commuter school feel. I think they're trying to change that and it shows with campus life having started to pick up in the past few years and the addition of dorms. Overall though my concentration in business and finance the professors were extremely knowledgeable and had a wide range of ideological backgrounds so you were challenged in thinking outside the box. Not sure what these others reviewers concentrations were, but no school can be great in everything. They are great in their business programs though."]

name: Indiana University-East
reviews: ['Nice campus. Be careful of the popo they will stop you for 1 mph over the speed limit. They have the Barney Fife syndrome. Staff and faculty are friendly.', "This university is a disgusting cash grab. They grade assignments with AI and if your handwriting isn't perfect, they'll just give you a 0. The expectation is that you have AI compile your homework into a nice LaTeX document, AKA 95% of students cheat on every single assignment and exam. The federal government needs to do something about this school.", 'Beautiful campus with friendly and helpful staff willing to assist you with any request u may have', 'Indiana University East is a fantastic school! I have been there for a year after transferring from a private college. The staff has been excellent, always  willing to help in and out of the classroom, they work with you, even with my hectic schedule. They are also REALLY affordable.', 'A great school to get an education in a special field. The professors are knowledgeable educators who cares about wanting you to learn. Plus this school is in a good location. This school is in an area where everything you need is conveniently accessible. So if you want a good education go to IU East.']

name: International Business College-Indianapolis
reviews:
["I go here just got finished with my first semester 🙌 was a little fast at first but if you want it you'll get with the past and the instructors are amazing very level with you and not dead set on making it feel like you can just drop if you feel like it", 'If you graduate from here, don't plan on getting a job with your "degree." It's useless. The school has a bad reputation among employers. And, that's not surprising since the education is so subpar. Heck, sometimes your grades are based on whether you're a "popular" student. This is because this school also has a major culture issue.  It's like a a high school where your teachers participate in the cliques. And, the administration doesn't care about students or providing a proper education.', "I'm a 2015 graduate from the International Business College's Travel & Hospitality Management program and I couldn't be happier to have chosen IBC. This isn't a school you choose if you're not serious about your education and your future! It's a very small school with very dedicated teachers who will notice if you're not getting it, you're not trying as hard as you can, or if you're not there. Every staff member in the building from the receptionists to the President want you to succeed and they are there to help you every step of the way.

Living in the dorms was a fun experience. Moving in with strangers can be intimidating, but it's worth it in the end. I made my best friends at IBC because they lived across the hall.

The school's placement office is also a wonderful asset not to be ignored! If you need help with your resume, finding jobs in your area, preparing for interviews- they are there to help! Even after you graduate, that is a wonderful perk to have in your back pocket when the job hunt seems like it will never end!

IBC is definitely a GREAT school that you wouldn't regret attending. They all want you to get out there, get jobs, get experience, and start your life two steps ahead of everyone else. Put in the time and effort and it WILL pay off!", 'I finish up my Graphic Design Associate Degree this year at IBC.  I absolutely loved my professors and career services professionals.  Not only did career services place me before I graduated, but they also helped me develop into a young professional. They truly care about your successes and overall well-being, all while encouraging and pushing you to be your best.', "I am a 2007  graduate of International Business College and I believe that this is the school for the career focused individual.  The education and the attention you get from the faculty and staff at this school is one of a kind.  Not only does this school teach you how to become a successful person but they also teach you how to take responsibility for your work.  The Placement Department is one of a kind!  The ladies that work in that department are some rare ladies.  They dig to find an opening for you.  The ladies in placement show you that you can only be led so far before you have to take charge of your own life.  They can't go to the interview for you, sometimes they can't even set up the interview for you.  If you want the job, put in the effort.  They have experience in things that your teachers might not and that is what gives you an all-around great education.  You pay for what you get.  You get QUALITY education versus a Traditional QUANTITY.  International Business College is small so you get the one on one attention.  If you were to go to a community college or a Traditional, you would just be a number in a seat."]

name: Manchester University
reviews:
["The University of Manchester is a world class university that's home to more than 12,000 staff and tens of thousands of students all drawn to this centre of excellence for learning. The canpuses combine heritage with modern design and the learning facilities are as impressive as you would find anywhere. The city of Manchester is also one of the great cities of the world and the students at this university benefit from being within it. For anyone looking for a leading university that's within a vibrant city, Manchester should be a priority. Recommended.", 'Was guided by someone who works here, omg why is this place so big, it is an amazing place tho, would recommend you to visit during a sunny day

Even the squirrel seems like they do not have a care in the world

A must visit in Manchester', 'Founded in 1824, the University of Manchester is a prestigious public research university located in the heart of England’s second-largest city. With a rich history and a commitment to academic excellence, Manchester has become one of the world’s leading universities, renowned for its groundbreaking research and innovative teaching methods.

As one of the original red brick universities, Manchester has played a pivotal role in shaping the modern world. Its alumni include 25 Nobel laureates, highlighting the institution’s profound impact on various fields of study. The university’s research strengths span a wide range of disciplines, from science and engineering to the humanities and social sciences. Notable achievements include pioneering work in nuclear physics, the discovery of graphene, and groundbreaking contributions to the field of materials science.

Manchester’s commitment to providing a world-class education is evident in its diverse and international student body. The university attracts students from over 160 countries, fostering a vibrant and multicultural learning environment. Students have access to state-of-the-art facilities, including cutting-edge laboratories, well-equipped libraries, and dedicated study spaces. The university also offers a wide range of extracurricular activities, societies, and sports clubs, ensuring that students have ample opportunities to develop both academically and personally.

Situated in the vibrant city of Manchester, students have access to a wealth of cultural, social, and economic opportunities. The city is renowned for its music scene, art galleries, museums, and historical landmarks. Manchester is also a major center for business and industry, offering numerous internship and employment opportunities for graduates.

In conclusion, the University of Manchester is a world-class institution that offers a unique and enriching educational experience. With its rich history, outstanding research, and commitment to student success, Manchester continues to be a sought-after destination for students from around the globe.', 'While the university is good overall, its teaching quality needs urgent improvement. The program is overly focused on theory and lacks sufficient practical training. Engineering students should be offered a compulsory placement year, available to every student admitted to the university. In today’s competitive job market, graduating without industry experience is no longer acceptable and severely impacts employability.', 'One of the best universities in Manchester .. the campus was amazing']

name: Marian University
reviews:
['Disappointing Experience — Poor Organization & Unprofessional Service

I had high hopes for this school, especially given their early reputation. Unfortunately, as they’ve grown in popularity, the quality seems to have gone downhill fast. What was once a promising service has become one of the most disorganized and unprofessional experiences I’ve had.

Scheduling is a mess, communication is inconsistent at best, and there’s a serious lack of accountability. It honestly surprises me that they’re still in business given how poorly things are run.

If you care about your education and value your time, I strongly recommend looking elsewhere. There are far better, more reliable options out there.', 'It’s a business for them not education and most credit do not transfer. They are also connected with Marian Ancilla College. Explore different options for better educations please .', 'Here visiting for a campus tour with my daughter. So far what we have seen is amazing. Marian University is a great place. The buildings are contemporary except for a few historical sites that were preserved. Other than that, it appears to be a great place. The people were friendly as we visited as well.  We look forward to visiting with her here at Marian University.', 'Only giving it a one star because zero stars is not an option. Terrible school, they care more about numbers than the well being of there students. They remove 3/4 of commuter parking and then ticket all the commuters who now have no place to park. Mental health services are non existent. Professors are of the poorest quality and only care about getting a paycheck. Photography makes students go off campus and work with a stranger in one of the worst areas around Indianapolis with shootings happening weekly in said area. Do not attend this school, especially if you are commuting.', 'The baseball game was exciting!']

name: Indiana Wesleyan University-Marion
reviews: ["Wouldn't recommend at least not for online learning. Classes had too much unrelated topics and missing information. I had classes the require you to use external links that no longer exist in both reference material and in quizzes. One class referenced a book that was unpublished and many classes used outdated articles. The whole experience felt like a copy paste class from many years prior. Seemed like the staff never took the time to update or review the classes before students were expected to complete them. The degree program was also filled with far to many arbitrary classes not related to degree. This whole experience has left far to sour of a taste in my mouth to give a good review. To quote the bible as I was required to so many times in these classes  Proverbs 13:11 Dishonest money dwindles away.", "Why is it so hard to get in contact with someone? I'm trying to change what type of degree I want to do , and I was told they were closed and to call Monday. I called Monday, and they keep hanging up the phone on me while I'm waiting. I make another phone call to try to see how much my tuition going to be and they redirect me to another call and the calls ends. Why is it so hard to get any info?I send multiple emails, and it takes over five days to get a response. When I do, it's not responding to the questions that I asked. It shouldn't be that hard to get in contact to know what my tuition fees are and to change my degree, especially if I'm going to be paying a lot of money. I wouldn't waste my time going to this university when they clearly don't take the time to help you with anything unless their just doing it to me.", "I would NOT recommend this school to a veteran or member currently in the service. I paid back my debt to the VA education department IN FULL because I dropped out of the program due to personal reasons.  I get an email from this school stating I STILL OWE MONEY! I called and the financial department stated that the VA requested an amount of 261.10 from the school. Now the school turns around and request I PAY THEM BACK THE 261.10!! I haven't enrolled in this school since 2019 and I am STILL DEALING WITH THEM! Again if you are a Veteran or currently in the service,  I WOULDN'T RECOMMEND THEM AT ALL!! This is ridiculous! Smh", "Our daughter goes here, it's an beautiful campus, great professors, welcoming students.", 'Indiana Wesleyan won their Quarter Final football game today 24-13 and are headed to the Final Four of the NAIA National Championships next week !!  Go Wildcats !!  Sat in reserved seating row #1.  The Chili and Hot Chocolate hit the spot on a cool late November Day.  Sat close enough to get pictures of players faces inside their helmets with just my phone camera.  Great to see even the losing team kneeling to pray after a hard fought loss.']

name: Martin University
reviews: ['Always enjoy the events that o jave been invites to to speak ans share!! Nice auditorium.  Class rooms are clean and nice. Foyer is nice. Facets in the bathroom are unique!', 'Held our Annual Holiday Recognition Ceremony. Great turn out!', 'Great experience attending a conference here. Wonderful facilities, easy to access and easy parking.', 'Very nice place and the staff:both the young women and men who assisted with all faucets of the events were fantastic!!!!', 'Today I went to Martin University to register for classes for the Spring 2015 semester. Everyone was very disorganized and unaware of what all I needed to do to set my classes. Everything is done by paper and my file was lost because the lady said that "too many hands" had got a hold of it. When I went to financial aid the lady was very rude and trying to rush me through the process. When I asked her the amount of money that I would need to pay for school after using financial aid she responded "well you have loan money so there is no need to worry." But that was not the question I asked. I had my 7 month old daughter with me who got a fussy, the lady asked "what is wrong with her? Does she have a pacifier?" After having been there three hours and still not registered for classes I decided that this school was not for me. I need something that is more organized and able to keep up with my file. Martin University needs to get advanced in technology area and hire individuals whom can understand basic questions.']

name: Mid-America College of Funeral Service
reviews:
['I attended AAMI from 2018-2021 it was a really unique experience I gained so much knowledge that I didn’t have going in. It wasn’t always easy but I learned so much. The classes were challenging and interesting and they prepared you for the boards and the profession in general. The instructors being funeral directors as well was something I appreciated. During my time there covid happened. I could say the school adapted and handled it all very well. Overall I would say if you put in the work at AAMi and with the support from your teachers and classes you’ll be confident and prepared for the future after you graduate.', 'I’m a proud graduate of the American Academy McAllister Institute of Funeral Service. My experience there was challenging but incredibly rewarding. The instructors really know the profession and care about preparing students to serve families with compassion and professionalism.

The online coursework is intense — from embalming and restorative art to psychology, ethics, and funeral law — but it gives you the knowledge and confidence you need to succeed in the field. I also appreciated the flexibility of the online and hybrid options, which made it possible to keep up with work and life while studying.

I left well-prepared for the National Board Exam and ready to begin my career. If you’re serious about funeral service, AAMI is a great place to start your journey.', "After working as an assistant at a local Funeral for several years, I realized I wanted to get into professional funeral service work. I was in my 60's and enrolled into McAllister Institute. The application process was simple, I transferred
some credits from a previous degree I had. The staff at AAMI helped me get some financial help, and I began my journey.  The educational process was very understandable, AAMI staff was very supportive, and I graduated 2 and a half years later!  I had no problems with the final exam, the National Conference Exam, nor the State Law exam.  I'm very happy with my progress. I've been licensed for 5 years now!", 'I graduated from AAMI in 2019 and had a great experience. The instructors were knowledgeable and the program prepared me well for the licensing exams and for working in funeral service. The online format was convenient and well-organized, making it easier to balance school with everyday life. I’d recommend AAMI to anyone looking to enter the funeral profession.', 'In 2012 was already working for a funeral home and decided to go to school to get my mortuary license.  Living in Kansas, working full time and raising a young family I needed to attend online.  I researched and compared all of the schools offering all online at that time and decided to go to AAMI- the deciding factor being - I had the opportunity to go to NYC for 2 weeks.

There were some things I didn’t care for, mostly not having a good support structure with the school for online students.  It’s more here’s  the syllabus, watch the class, take the tests with no hands on help or study structure, however that was 10 years ago so hopefully things have improved on that since then.

My other major concern was Little to No help with travel arrangements, where to stay, how to use the trainst systems etc. but in the end it was an awesome experience that I’ll never forget.

All in all AAMI did provide my education, fit my basic needs and I worked hard to be successful.  I was prepared (even if I didn’t think so) for my National Board Exam and passed on my first attempt in 2015.']

name: University of Notre Dame
reviews:
["A very beautiful Campus. Well maintained as it is makes it easy to see why it's such a popular choice for a great education. I would give a full five just for the beauty but as I have never been a student I can't fairly say how I'd feel having never experienced attending. As a visitor I truly enjoyed the architectural beauty and the history of the famed campus. I recommended this as a great free must see in the area!", 'I still have nightmares about the time I spent here doing my Masters.  I attended the Mendoza school of Business to better my career, but it completely derailed my career track and I haven't been able to recover since.  I'm 50k in debt and haven't managed to get a job since graduation, let alone make the 87k "average" and being able to get a job in under a year like they promise.  The alumni network is completely non-existent, despite the claims the school makes.  My cohort of students were all snakes, throwing each under the bus for the semblance of gain for themselves.

This school literally ruined my life', "Absolutely beautiful campus. I didn't study there,  so, cannot talk for the quality of education but the place is gorgeous.

I love taking walks there, I love roaming around the campus. I love the lakes, swans, and ducks as well! The landscaping is amazing.

I like coming here to light a candle for my grandma. 🕯

I think I'd be absolutely happy to go to this school as a college student!", "I love it here! I have worked here for 15 years and don't plan to leave anytime soon. Plenty to do and see, people are kind, as it's a beautiful campus.  Plus, who doesn't love the best football team?", 'The University of Notre Dame Campus is strikingly beautiful. The architecture of its buildings is stunning. In May the tulips around campus are beautiful to see. Souvenirs can be picked up from the bookstore. You can take in a mass at the beautiful cathedral or partake in a sporting event. It is a must see when visiting South Bend.']

name: Oakland City University
reviews: ['Went for a college tour.  Great faculty and staff -  Knowledgeable,  invested,  helpful, and encouraging. Very nice campus', 'I attended Chapman Seminary/OCU for one semester.  My only complaint is that I had to drop out for family reasons and relocate to St. Louis.\nBut speaking of family, the seminary itself has a very small student body by design, and there is a family feel between the professors and the seminarians.  Five stars is insufficient to express my high opinion of this seminary.', 'Good school, love the Upward Bound program, very quiet campus, good cafeteria, no complaints.', 'Positive experience so far I feel like, finally a school I belong to!!', 'Cute little town.']

name: Rose-Hulman Institute of Technology
reviews: ["Great school to go to for undergrad. Professors and instructors are easily accessible and friendly. Three quarters in an academic year which means course workload can be heavy and midterms/finals can happen in a very short and consecutive timeline. It is a course focus school, which means that research opportunities and resources, on the other hand, are limited. Cafeteria is quite bad. I went to a bigger university and realized how bad those food provided by Bon Appetit was. Still, can't believe it has been three years since I graduated.", "Honest Review: This is the absolute most wonderful place to be miserable as a student. It's a beautiful small campus full of mostly wonderful people. The academics are completely insane and demanding, but the campus life is outstanding (I mean, weekly housekeeping and tight-knit dorm floors? Come on. It's awesome. It's easy to make friends even if you're weird.). And there is always someone to help you if you get stuck on coursework, whether it be professor or fellow peer. This is not a place for the weak spirited. They say you have to go through hell to get to heaven. I guess that's why we students go here. Do you want a secure, guaranteed job with an awesome salary? Spend the next four years of your life here in sweet, blissful agony with a bunch of like-minded nerds, and it'll all be worth it.", 'I attended Rose-Hulman a number of years ago, getting a Computer Engineering degree.  I disconnected from Rose for a while at the beginning of my career, but have reengaged with Rose recently.  While I do not directly use much of my engineering education given that I am more of a businessperson today, the experience I gained at Rose in how to think, how to learn, and how to figure things out in my job and in life in general was invaluable.  While I did not love it while there, especially given how hard it was, I am very grateful for the opportunity to have graduated from Rose.  After reconnecting recently, and being on campus again a few times, it is EASY to see that it is a great school.  The brain power there among both the faculty and students is amazing.  A great school!  I would highly recommend it!', "I can't say enough about this excellent school. I see kids with degrees all the time that don't seem to be very prepared for the working world but Rose Hulman truly prepares their students with a combination of knowledge and hands on experience. Our son is excelling on his internship job and will graduate next year with even greater ability.  No wonder this school is rated so high.", 'Some of the best 4 years of my life. Challenging education but well worth it in the long run. The best part is the work Rose does to help you get a job and networking opportunities with alumni, however the tuition is getting out of hand..']

name: University of Saint Francis-Fort Wayne
reviews: ['Professor to student ratio is great, every thing within a 12 minute walk.', 'Gorgeous 😍 beautiful place💙💗🫶🏻✨️ I have been here throughout the years, I remember coming here for cheerleading and football games as a teen. Also, beautiful scenery and place to walk👣 🚶🏼\u200d♀️around at!', 'absolutely beautiful campus, the admissions staff was very knowledgeable and kind.', "This is an ever growing campus. If you've never been. I highly recommend going and taking a walk around the campus. You can find many great picture opportunities. You can also find nice quiet place to relax and watch nature. If your ever lucky enough to go inside some of these buildings and see the amazing architecture.", 'my school came for a tour at 10am. our tour guide finished a presentation at about 10:30am. we stood around for almost 10 minutes just waiting around cuz we didn’t know she wanted us to go outside cuz she just dipped. then she was kinda snobby. we then proceeded to basically jog around the whole school cuz she was walking so fast. she said absolutely nothing basically the whole time. we didn’t even barely look at classrooms or any rooms at all. we had to fast walk thru all the halls and went up and down stairs endlessly as she has not explained a single room to us. we didn’t even see where the dorms were or what they looked like. we didn’t even go to all the buildings. we had people interested in art(which she knew) and we didn’t even go to the building or area. she then proceeded to ask if we had any questions when we didn’t know what to ask cuz she didn’t say anything but maybe a sentence. she then ended our tour at 11:15 when it supposed to be done at 12. she continuously checked her watch the entire time when she was literally the one who sent us the schedule that it ended at 12. worst tour ever. a lot of students are now not interested in coming to the school cuz the tour was so awful. at 12, we found a completely different person who works here who wasn’t supposed to be a tour guide but she stepped up to make our experience better. and to hopefully make up for the other horrible tour guide. (our original tour guide didn’t even graduate from the school so how can she tell us what it’s like nor did she work here very long). but our new tour guide graduated from our school in 2014 and from this college and now works at the college. hopefully in the future the tour guide is more prepared. but luckily it turned out decent in the end.']

name: Saint Mary-of-the-Woods College
reviews:
['Went to visit my daughter today January 31 2026. yes we had tons of snow. But the sidewalk and steps should have been cleared! I slide and fell hurting my leg because of this!  Going into the main dining hall they don’t even have the side walk cleared you can see the kids have made a path through the grass that will be mud as soon as it warms up!  She will finish out this year and never return! I could go in for days about the things they try to pull over at this school.', 'As of 01/26/2026 at 6:30 PM EST, administration of Saint Mary-of-the-Woods issued a press release on its Facebook page indicating that both students and staff were expected to return to campus on 01/27/2026 despite Vigo County remaining under a travel warning per-the Indiana Homeland Security website. Here's what that means:
---
Warning:

The highest level of local travel advisory means that travel may be restricted to emergency management workers only. During a "warning" local travel advisory, individuals are directed to:

- Refrain from all travel;
- Comply with necessary emergency measures;
- Cooperate with public officials and disaster services forces in executing emergency operations plans; and
- Obey and comply with the lawful directions of properly identified officers.

Additional exceptions to the warning travel advisory are found in Indiana Code 10-14-3-29."
---', 'I absolutely love SMWC! I highly recommend sending your child to this historic Catholic institution of higher learning.', 'I think the school needs to work on diversity. I had no problem with the women’s educational department for distance learners but some of the leadership showed they were not ready for diversity in the student population. However I did get a great education and I had a wonderful counselor. I know that God called my name and a previous student contacted me about this college. I graduated with my Bachelors in Theology and I am proud of that.', 'She had a great time at the beginner equine camp. Thank the staff for a good week..']

name: Saint Mary's College
reviews: ['MSMC is not aligned with modern nursing education models. Schools that can’t evaluate competency-based nurses probably aren’t the most innovative or supportive places to grow anyway.', 'Good school with gates all around campus and good security. Good maintenence and happy, lively student body. Nice faculty staff to help.', 'Greater Newburgh Symphony Orchestra performance at Mount Saint Mary. The best classical music experience in Hudson Valley.', 'I had an AMAZING experience at Mount Saint Mary College. Reading some sour reviews on here reminds me that students need to be the ones to make the first step in order to get the most out of their college experience.  The Mount has so much to offer.  The Career center motivates students to take on as many internships as possible, the student life departments help students grow and work on leadership abilities, and the theater program works with students to reach their full potential.  I highly recommend students to attend Mount Saint Mary College, and get as involved as you can!', 'From an educational standpoint, my experience at The Mount was one of a kind. Every professor I had in my field took the time to get to know me and make the most out of my time and learning. One of them even invited the graduates of our department to her home for a celebratory dinner before graduation! I was very lucky in that sense. Additionally, I met some of my closest friends there and there was always something fun to do! I highly recommend to anyone looking to peruse teaching or nursing.']

name: Saint Elizabeth School of Nursing
reviews: ['I had an excellent experience at Trinitas School of Nursing 🫶from my first semester through graduation. Throughout the program, I worked with a wide variety of professors and completed clinical hours at multiple hospitals 🏥 , which provided a well-rounded and high-quality nursing education.\nThe faculty were consistently knowledgeable, supportive, and genuinely invested in student success🙏. I am truly grateful 🥹 for the guidance, encouragement, and mentorship I received during my time in the program.\nI highly recommend Trinitas School of Nursing to anyone aspiring to become a Registered Nurse.🍀', 'I used to trust on my skills and passion to continue in the nursing program. After failing my first semester, Bonilla professor stop me to continue studying with all the recommendation and "motivations" to inspire her students. I would never recommend this school to anyone. If anyone take the risk, go ahead. That\'s my honest opinion.', 'I had a great experience at this school. I just graduated in 2025. Not easy at all, even up to the last semester I was always changing my study methods. I was lucky I didn’t have to work during the last part of the program, and admire anyone who was able to get through it while working. Very hands on learning, it wasn’t perfect, I didn’t love all the professors, some did stick out though like Bowers and Mojica, I absolutely loved and learned so much in their lectures and will never forget them.', 'I usually do not write reviews but due to the mistreatment I made time today to explain. This school needs to be audited/ looked into including every instructor they are disgusting to their students treated us like trash. They do not help at all their main goal is to collect your 9k every semester and fail you so you can come back and repeat the course and get another 9k. About half of the class  are re-admitted students. You reach out for help they do not help you but instead watch their students struggle, request office hours and you gain nothing from her. They are very discouraging especially the Nure 131 coordinator she doesn’t care about her students. They are unorganized the clinical instructors never know what’s going on we were always left in the blind. Forget about tutoring you reach out to them and no one wants to help after begging and pleading to get some kind of assistance..  UCC barely has tutors for the course .  Now the Exam reviews they do not go over the exams after you have taken them they place you in a room to go over the  50 questions  they rush you out of the room you can not ask any questions about what you did wrong or how you can improve. They encourage you to drop the course more than they encourage you to stay in the program. You pay all of this money sit in class for hours just to go home and be your own instructor because they spend more time arguing and bashing students during lecture then actually teaching us felt more so like a war zone then an actual nursing class. If you dare to ask them a question about material during lecture that you need clarification that they CANT  answer they get embarrassed and talk down on you in front of the class.  If your able to find somewhere else where you will receive better education than this I suggest you save yourself the trouble  from this unorganized establishment . Your mental health will be in shambles dealing with them. Please do something to help your students they are really trying to become nurses but you guys are very discouraging and bashful', "Before entering the school, please check the graduation rate. School grading is based only on testing, all the hard clinical work, and additional paperwork are not graded. Some tests include questions that weren't covered in the lectures. Testing is horrible. To me- waste of money and disappointment.  I will look for better nursing school, I should listen to students who failed TSON but succeed in other schools. However, I decided to give it a try. Big mistake. Do your research,  talk to students who already in this school."]

name: Taylor University
reviews:
['Incredible community of people.. faculty, staff, and students.. which forms students to live well in the world by nurturing a sincere love for Jesus, engendering a holistic biblical worldview, and tactfully addressing issues in culture from an intellectually engaging posture. I had an amazing experience as a student!', "We have a community membership for the fitness center. It's always immaculate with pleasant music and the full range of equipment. We highly recommend", 'We attended a football game. Beautiful and clean campus, friendly and helpful student body. They kindly accommodated those in our group with mobility issues. Clean bathrooms! Concession stand could use a couple extra sets of hands during events.', "Taylor has a beautiful campus with a kind atmosphere. The grounds seem very well taken care of and intentionally worked on and developed. The building placement does not seem to be so as much, which is a factor in dropping the score as well as friendliness. People are kind to newcomers, but there does feel to be an air of exclusivity. Don't really expect anyone to smile at you while on a walk unless you are with someone they know or you had previously met. The events they put on, especially for students, are amazing. The time, effort, and intentionality that seems to be put in them is very evident in their excellence. The cafeteria food is good, especially compared to other universities. My chapel experience as a guest was pretty good, aside from the student introducing the speaker making a short bus joke. Overall, Taylor University is a beautiful place for students to get connected, involved, and find community. It is not necessarily a place for the community unless there is prior Taylor affiliation.", 'My sister spend 4 years of college here.
In 2017, I visited Taylor on a family weekend. We were at an event, it suddenly began pouring rain. Everyone went in panic, and running to shelter. My sandal slid off while I was running across the street, I got hit by somebody riding a bike. Head to pavement, I had a seizure and was rushed to the hospital.
Many girls on my sisters dorm floor were praying for me, they wrote me letters.
I never would have expected such love from strangers. I will forever remember that selfless act.']

name: Trine University
reviews:
['Im am an online student. My experience with the advisors, financial aid and my professors have been amazing. I will be graduating this year and I am so proud to call myself a graduate of Trine University.', 'The indoor track facility cannot really handle the spectators for a meet of with more than four schools.  The concession stand offered fewer options than that of a middle school.', "So much to say I don't know where to start! A small school that is big on options for programs and degrees, caring staff that know your child by name and not just as a number, a wide variety of sports and extra curriculars, located in Angola which offers plenty of shopping options for last minute items or stocking up, close to lakes and a state park which makes visits less complicated, but perhaps the biggest reason is how Trine creates a home away from home atmosphere that encourages learning and growth, while reassuring parents and loved ones. Our boys are proud to be a part of the Trine family!", 'if i can give a half star or negative i would love to give it .
worst experience i have is they are not Responsive for the calls or the emails expecially intlhelp department ,  even in the emergency situation also .
1) i applied for my i 20 and its been 1 month no i20 is approved.
2) during my initial opt application they have done the delay in the same way it lead me in a pending phase of 6 months and resulted in RFE , they didnt provide me the complete set of the requested documents also Now again for the stem OPT they are doing it in the same way.
3) i applied for i20 i still didnt receive it yet,they block the email and suncase account saying i am graduated, with out access how can i get my i20 and apply it to uscis.
3) No one will pick the call and guide us .
worst college i have ever been , if i have a chance i will go for the legal actions against them .
government have to take action on these kind of colleges where money is their priority nothing else.', "I would strongly caution anyone considering this university to think twice. My experience with this institution has been nothing but disappointing and frustrating.

1. The advisors(Timothy strange)  and DSO(Karla) , director  and the intl help( lied to me saying that the DSO reached out to me when she never did)  are shockingly negligent. They rarely respond to emails, even in emergency situations. Reaching out for guidance or support feels like shouting into the void.  This is unacceptable, especially for students who rely on their guidance for academic and immigration matters.

2. It's clear that this university does not prioritize students'lives or careers.. they don't provide any kind of support when it comes to bids related queries or academic support they show little to no concern for the future of their students and I have no idea how this institution is still running

name: Valparaiso University
reviews:
['Got my second graduate degree and terminal post grad at VU. As a graduate student, I cannot recommend it more highly. I would have classes with as few as six people in them. But what the president has done to the university is unthinkable. The controversy with the art museum is despicable. I used to be proud to say that I was a VU graduate. I’m not as proud as I used to be.', "I had a great time here- 20+ years ago! Looks like times have really changed and the school has an identity crisis now. I made a lot of friends, went to a lot of parties and had a lot of great classes. I still believe in a liberal arts college for the best foundation in life. But Valpo has thrown out a lot of what it was in favor of change that makes no sense. They don't realize that trying to please everyone is a losing proposition. I don't think I would go there now. It's all really too bad", "School is simply not worth the money.   Especially now.  There are an extensive number of ultra-liberal professors who do not allow opposing views.

Instead of working one another, the departments compete with one another to the detriment of the students.

I'd especially avoid the education department as you can get far better preparation for nearly free, yet they want to charge tens of thousands of dollars for a worse education.", 'School is great for what I came for. Academics are challenging, but there is a lot of help if needed. Food  is good, the restaurants downtown are good as well. Overall, it is a great school.', 'I went to this university to swim and get a great education in biology and psychology. The science facilities where labs were held hadn’t been updated in Lord knows how long. Every freshman has to take a “core” class and my second semester my professor was the catholic minister of the school who discriminated against me for my religious beliefs. That’s when I knew this school was a joke. I would say 75% of the freshman are promised tens of thousands in scholarships throughout their four years from the school which convinces a lot of them to choose Valpo then after their freshman year they take away almost everybody’s scholarships after their established at Valpo and half their credits won’t transfer. They pump their money into new dorms, new sorority housing, and adding to the already extravagant church while neglecting to update their outdated education facilities. The athletics spends all its money on its average basketball team. The swimming pool was literally a gas chamber and some of my teammates on the swim team who were juniors and seniors had developed asthma swimming in that pool so long. It’s an “engineering” school but the campus itself is poorly engineered so there’s always huge pools of water everywhere. You’ll have to move your car so there’s somewhere for them to put all the snow in the winter. The student population is pretty cool I made a ton of friends with a lot of great people but it’s mostly kids from mommy daddy money with everything handed to them. I got falsely accused of cheating by a student with a vendetta against me and had to go through a long, drawn out process with their “judicial board” just for them to tell me I didn’t cheat. I had a professor with a “Christian psychology” degree - must be a degree given by Valpo themselves because those are probably one of the only people still living in the nineteenth century incorporating religion with science. He was also clueless on most modern day psychology, so was the head of the psych department who looked like he was still alive from the nineteenth century. My current roommate graduated from Valpo and they did a horrendous job with his career placement and search before graduating because now he works for - believe it or not - a Lutheran organization and doesn’t make half of what I do without a college degree. I hear the engineering program is decent but definitely has nothing on Purdue’s which is a fraction of the cost. Long story short, Valparaiso university is a big fat waste of money and I would stay far away from this cold, desolate place. Engineering kids - save your parents some money and go to Purdue. Valpo is a joke of a university.']

name: Vincennes University
reviews:
['This is the oldest university in the state of Indiana. You would not know that by visiting it though. It has a complete collection of some of the most state-of-the-art facilities of any university visited. This is an outstanding institution with a great history of producing great graduates at the two and four year level. They have a catalogue of transferrable programs that can go to just about any other university. The faculty and staff are some of the best in the nation. It is easy to find using Google Maps.', "I am proud  to say I am a student at Vincennes University. It is the most amazing school with the best faculty, financial aid department teachers and facility. Not to mention the most inexpensive School in the state. I am a sophomore and I've been to three colleges this is the best college in the world! I would recommend it to anyone!", "Went here from 2014-2016. Really enjoyed every minute here. The classes and all the programs I took for Computer Networking were top notch. I see a lot of reviews about people not liking the school or town, and it may have changed since I was there a few years ago. I was fortunate enough to be roommates with people I've known all of my life, but it's really about finding things to do in town. On the surface, Vincennes looks really boring, but I promise there is a lot to do there.  There are some cool shops downtown to check out for one.

Anyway, when I went there, the classes and professors were great. They were always willing to help and work with you as well.

I lived in Harrison my first year and Clark my second year. The bathrooms in Harrison were terrible. It was never the janitor's fault, and quite frankly I always felt bad for them. It was,and probably still is, the people who live there that make those bathrooms so disgusting. Clark Hall, on the other hand, was great! Hard to get into so make sure if you want to get in you apply for it early.

The dining center was better than I expected for a small college like this. It's true that it's pretty much the same food every week, but it's still good. There's enough variety so you don't get burned out", 'Hanging out on campus today finalizing everything needed for the next semester.   Worked with many great people today, starting with the ladies at the administrative service desk, next heading to the student success center, the financial aid office, student records, VA services office, and finally the IT services center.  Each and every department was insightful,  knowledgeable, and detailed. We left with no questions unanswered!!!  My student is very content to continue their higher educational path at this University.', "It is a nice university,  with mostly kind folks. I came here to train and stayed I'm th dorms. I was here in the winter...bring lots of winter gear!"]

name: Wabash College
reviews: ["Similar to Hampden-Sydney College in Virginia, this liberal arts college is small and focused.  It serves a brotherhood of men who have come here well disciplined and responsible.  Those looking for a place to party will find it, but they may also find that the academic rigor of the college is not compatible with the life of a drunken frat boy.  Consider this before applying.  Do your homework FIRST before committing to a college you don't fit.\n\nThe campus is small and beautiful.  There are many classical and historic buildings.", 'Lovely campus, a beautiful library, and a treasure of city.', 'Nice little area to walk around. Has a beautiful quad with trees and a lot of friendly squirrels', 'They do a great job in welcoming parents of freshman.', 'Great education and athletic facilities']

name: Briar Cliff University
reviews:
["My recent visit to Briar Cliff University provided a comprehensive perspective on its distinctive academic and environmental attributes. Located in Sioux City, Iowa, the university's most striking feature is its strategic placement atop a prominent cliff. This elevated position affords panoramic vistas of the surrounding landscape, a geographical advantage that significantly contributes to the campus ambiance. The inherent beauty of this setting cultivates a serene and majestic atmosphere, offering a conducive environment for focused study and professional engagement for students, faculty, and staff alike.
Beyond its aesthetic appeal, the university's physical layout and facilities appear well-integrated with its natural surroundings. The design facilitates a sense of tranquility that is often conducive to academic pursuits and intellectual contemplation. This harmonious blend of natural beauty and functional infrastructure undoubtedly enhances the overall collegiate experience, fostering an environment where both learning and personal growth can flourish. Feel free to ask me about the psychology program 😉", 'I went to college there years ago. It is still if beautiful and many things the same but new buildings and gorgeous view of Sioux City. Wonderful facilities now. Great place to go to school and meet life long friends and colleagues.', 'I have 2 kids at Briar Cliff, and our family has been very happy with their/our experience.

Briar Cliff offer a great educational experience with a family enviroment!

Sioux City makes for a good college town, offering plenty to do and still a small town feel.

Go Chargers - Battle On!!', 'Thank you to Briar Cliff for allowing REACH Youth and Family Theatre to perform in their theatre the past two weekends.  Your support of local talented children is well appreciated. ✨️🎭✨️', 'I wouldn’t personally recommend it or trust too many reviews left by freshman as we were incentivized to leave reviews. It also has a %100 acceptance rate on some websites which is not a good thing. Their professors are fantastic, though. Super accommodating, helpful, and well-learned. The campus itself is gorgeous as well.

I attended a couple years ago. This section is just cautionary. I was assured that if I paid a fee that I would graduate on time and receive my degree, they had lied. Some employees in the business office (though I do not know if they are still employed there) allegedly had an issue with pocketing payments. Unfortunately there isn’t anything I can do about this as I was too naive and trusting of a university to get this in writing. Just giving fellow students a heads up! If you need to do ANYTHING with their business department, ensure it is in writing! I suggest Morningside or ISU. You have way more invaluable networking opportunities at either of those universities.

That being said, if you’re looking for a religious college then this may be a good fit for you. Just be warned, though, a lot of the credits they force you to take will not transfer to other colleges. A few of my friends got stuck taking 3 extra years of college to make up for it when they left.']
