name: Coe College
reviews:
['The women’s volleyball teams antics of squeaking their shoes and slapping the floor have to be some of the most unsportsmanlike conduct I have seen in my 15 years watching volleyball. Coach should win by being better and not by being annoying!', 'They will suck you dry for as much money as possible. Many credits will not transfer, and it's just as clicky as high school. The advisor they give you your first year won't even pertain to your desired field of study and will set you up for failure. So so sad I even considered this "school." Just don't.

***EDIT: If you eventually try to transfer your classes in order to get a degree that matters, your credits will reflect as almost nothing. They make a small note in the corner of the transcript on how to correctly translate them into something meaningful to EVERY OTHER SCHOOL but you will most likely have to go in and personally point it out. I almost had to retake classes because of this.', 'Well, finally it is the time to update this review.

I was letting the anger, frustration or every bad feeling about this school to cool down, to fade out, to let go: 2 years after graduation; after a warm and nice day I had in LA; after received a decent pay from my job, I finally decide to write it down with a strong belief that I can do my best to keep this comment as objective as possible.

Here we go.

I went to Coe College in the year of 2011, Bachelor of Music, Composition program, you might know who I am because there are only few students in this program. If, there is possible to give a negative score on Google, I will give it as low as possible.

Here are some facts:

1. During these years that I had in this college, I had been forced to change three composition teachers each year. My education suffered tremendous impact due to this. Neither of these two teachers / professors had idea that where my path of education should go next after their predecessor left the school. These three teachers, the first one was a decent professor for sure; the next one was a "professor" who was believed to be still pursuing his doctor degree in University of Iowa by the time him left. The third one, who is still teaching at there, is a local high school teacher doing the part-time job.  Meanwhile, the Coe College still advertising their system as liberal art college where one professor teaches few students.

2. The music department is very conservative. They have a DAW lab in the B1 floor of Marquis Hall  with Pro Tools 11 and Logic 9; but sadly only few knows how to use Pro Tools to record or how to use Logic to score a film. But after you graduated, these are the very basic techniques letting you to survive in this industry.

3. Over priced. It is happened to be a common in all these comments. Seriously, , I paid $23,000 each years to "hire" a high school teacher teaching me how to write music. Before the school I published four studio albums and produced many artists in both China and Japan! I just don't know how to play an classical instrument so many conservatories in the U.S. wouldn't accept me.

So, If you had a same problem, go to a for-profit or easy-to-apply school in the cities where the industry grows, like New York, LA, Bay Area, Atlanta or Nashville. Study and go for internship, you can learn much more in the studio while you are working with famous artist and producer - even you just are making coffee for them. Plus $80,000 is enough for you to start your own records label or a small audio engineer business in almost anywhere. Ain't nobody gonna care about what DEGREE you have if you're working in the entertainment industry!

Let's go back a talk about these composition professors. When I first got into the school, I had a argue with my first composition teacher. Yet I still respect him and admire him all time. He told me that if I want to do commercially successful music, pop song or rnb, I should leave the school right now. I should listen to him and I wouldn't waste so many years and so much money as I did now. The second one, I remember he criticized many nowadays music just because it made by MIDI and electronic instruments. I remember he also loved to criticize ordinary listener who cares about lyrics more than music; as well as "songwriting is always bigger than composing." He hates pop, RnB and Hiphop for sure because these music "almost and always only using one chord". The third teacher, as I mentioned, is a high school teacher who part-times here as a "professor".

So, seriously, try to avoid this school please. College education is an investment toward yourself. I invested $23,000 a year and ends up nothing, no connect, no experience but a debt that you needs to pay for next 10 years. If you have a dream, or want to live a better life, go to a big city, even it is a for-profit or low ranking school.', 'They hate free speech. I was told I could not hang an American flag in my window because it would be seen as "racist". The professors are terrible, there is a horrendous leftist bias permeated in nearly every aspect of the school- the culture, in the student body, in the faculty, etc. It gets to the point where you can't breathe. Save yourself the money and the headache - don't go here.', "Just. Don't. It's not worth your time or money. Nice staff, but that doesn't add up to the thousands of dollars of debt you'll rack up from one semester."]

name: Cornell College
reviews:
['A disappointing display of scientific gatekeeping

As someone who follows emerging astrophysical research, I’m genuinely disappointed in arXiv’s decision to reject Dr. Beatriz Villarroel and Dr. Stephen Bruehl’s recent peer-reviewed paper on historical sky anomalies dismissing it as “not of interest.”

This work applied standard astronomical methods to archived sky-survey data and found statistically significant correlations worth investigating further. Regardless of whether one agrees with the interpretation, it clearly meets the criteria of legitimate scientific inquiry.

arXiv was founded at Los Alamos and is now managed by Cornell, institutions built on curiosity and open inquiry. Yet this rejection shows that the platform has become more about protecting reputations than fostering discovery. “Not of interest” is not a scientific argument, it’s a convenient way to silence research that challenges established narratives.', 'Beat Stanford to build NYC’s most impressive tech campus. Top notched Ivy League education with a scrappy vibe and a futuristic setting for any dreams to go wild. My partner did his MBA here and built a successful 8-figure exited venture all thanks to the Cornellian powerful network', 'Came here at night to enjoy the city view from Roosevelt Island. Cornell Tech campus was a modern design with lots of glasses. It sure is a nice campus and is a nice escape from the city', 'Cornell Tech campus tour on Roosevelt Island is just a lobby visit of the Bloomberg and Tata Innovation center buildings. You cannot visit classrooms. You get to see the lobby cafe. Save yourself a trip, view the pictures attached. Take the ferry from Manhattan if you have to visit in person.  Informational session in the Fall, is when you can visit the classrooms, not on Wednesday campus tours. Tata Innovations center building is gorgeous.', 'Beautiful campus, nice views of the city from the island . Air tram to the campus was fun and worth every penny. Buildings are amazing!']

name: Des Moines Area Community College
reviews:
['Want to thank everyone there for helping me! Best college ever! Graduated from there in 1997! Currently safe and receiving the medical treatment which I need. Thanks, again and keep going!', 'ASSET program with Eric Langner is top notch.
Some of the gen ed instructors were iffy but overall an excellent program.

Urban campus security is also great.', 'I love DMACC Urban Campus! The staff and faculty make me feel like I am wanted and loved here. I feel appreciated and accepted! Thank you to everyone who works here!', "This campus was better than Ankeny, in my opinion. This Community College was better than my experience at Iowa State University, as well. Didn't need any degree to become a self Published Author. My highly paid education is now outdated. The experience with professors, ladies, beware of male literature professors that just want to have lunch. He's only an author & married. LADIES BEWARE!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!", "I went to school here and graduated from here onto Simpson College. Great place. Caring professors. Many opportunities to network. Very clean campus. Always a spot for free parking. People only rated this college negatively because they probably aren't very good students either. I know so many great people went to school here and graduate onto doing something amazing. Also provides a lot of jobs for students!"]

name: Dordt University
reviews: ['Dordt University offers a warm, welcoming, and faith-centered environment that truly supports student growth. The campus is beautiful and well-maintained, with excellent academic facilities and engaging professors who genuinely care about their students. The community atmosphere is strong, encouraging leadership, service, and personal development. With a focus on quality education and Christian values, Dordt provides an enriching experience both inside and outside the classroom. A wonderful place to study and grow.', 'Seems like a great campus, in a small town that is built around the campus and the corn agriculture industry. It was a beautiful campus and we met some wonderful faculty and admissions people. Chapel was great. They could have better prepared for our visit as we didn’t get to talk to professors in my child’s area of study. Also the visit agenda was delivered last minute, some people felt unprepared for our visit, and there were many rough handoffs. The local community seemed great, with all the necessities of a college kid.', "The only Christian college I donate to and would highly recommend. I wish they were closer to my area because I'd love to return and further my degree.", 'Awesome school with great education and dedicated Faculty.  We have three graduates in our family and all of them were prepared to meet the challenges of the world upon graduation.  Excellent application of Christian teaching in all aspects of student life.', "I'm so happy with my experience at Dordt College! The faculty live out their faith very well and it reflects on how they teach classes and interact with students. Different viewpoints are acknowledged, discussed, and respected in the classroom. Genuine, authentic Christian education."]

name: Drake University
reviews: ['Great School, heavily considering after looking at their Virtual Tour, Excited to learn more on my call', 'Drake University was the best choice our kids could have made for their college education. Their alumni mentorship program gives students an upper hand in the work force.', "5 stars but I'm pretty biased as it's the best and most highlighted part of my life.", 'Thank goodness for spoiled college kids throwing away tvs and brand new $200 backpacks and all that food!', 'My band director graduated from here and graciously offered to give me a tour of all the places where he got hit by a car on campus. Also we saw like 20 emergency vehicles so 5/5 for keeping us safe! Go bulldogs!']

name: University of Dubuque
reviews: ['Great school. Has paid parking only for students and staff.', 'They have a culture at UD of not really caring about the student experience. They built a multi-million dollar theatre and student center, but then they kick classes out when the president wants to schmooze rich donors. They did everything in their power to suffocate Greek Life until it died. And they do nothing to ensure that you get a quality education, even when you speak directly to the people in charge. They told me it was my fault that my academic advisor had screwed me. I signed up for classes she said were required and they were not, but I still had to pay tuition for it all!', 'People are nice but if you’re a student 90% of the staff here will talk down to you and treat you like a child.  They take forever to get things fixed and don’t really care about the students here. It was -17 degrees and we still had class they had students walk from the dorms which is a 15 minute walk the high schools canceled school. Parking and the roads here forgot to mention that they are quick to give someone a ticket also. If you’re you like being treated as a decent human being definitely don’t come here cause staff here will go out of there way to be rude.', 'I had a great 4 year experience. I really learned a lot and met so many amazing people on campus and in the community. The city itself was very welcoming and allowed me to accomplish a lot of work throughout the community. I enjoyed the football program and campus life. I wouldn’t choose any other school to go to. Also shoutout to the great fraternity of all time ΩΨΦ!', 'Beautiful campus, lovely caring staff']

name: Ellsworth Community College
reviews: ["Hall of fame induction and homecoming week end ! As  family member of an inductees the committee went above and beyond providing a heartfelt ceremony to recognize the athlete's personal achievements and provide a lovely buffet Fri 10/17/25. Sat 10/18 we were given  an informative campus tour highlighting Ellsworth's continuing dedication to Panther pride and progress. A beautiful boat ride on the Scenic City Empress and Cadet Field tailgate party provided  a fun intro to the homecoming game against Dodge City CC with a gathering afterwards at Timbuk Bru to celebrate Panther's win!", 'Seems like a nice college. My daughter goes there and I had to pick up her vehicle. Her dorm seemed clean.', 'Best decision I have made for my education. I attended the equine program and there are so many great opportunities out here. The staff here is very supportive and want to make you successful! The Judging team was the highlight of my college experience! Highly recommend attending this program!', 'Just graduated from the Ellsworth Community College equestrian program with my associates in both equine science and equine management. Great experience! All of my instructors were so helpful throughout my two years and pushed me to be the best I could be! I was honored to be a member of student senate and enjoyed getting involved on campus. HIGHLY RECOMMEND! Proud to be a panther!', 'I took physics and calculus in the classrooms, not online.  The professors are adept and always encourage seeking help outside class time.  That could’ve been because of the small class sizes, however, which aren’t a bad thing.\n\nI also frequently ate at the dining center.  You get a lot of food for the price, but the quality and taste leave much to be desired.']

name: Emmaus Bible College
reviews: ['Wonderful University both my daughters and both son in laws went here.  Solid small and friendly.  Learn Bible and a career path.  Fully accredited.  Great faculty to student ratio.  Has done a fantastic job in keeping students on campus and safe.  Highly rated - check them out.  Big enough to be comprehensive - small enough to be personal.  Nursing, teaching and preaching are core curriculum.  Masters program starting in fall of 2025.  Online also.', "I'm a senior here and I've had an amazing experience. The best thing about emmaus bar none is the teachers. No matter what major you are in you find at least one professor to pour into your life. Coming here will surely sharpen your faith. It is a very small community rarely getting more than 270 students since I've been here. It's not flawless but you can tell that everyone in leadership here is genuinely concerned with providing the students with a environment that causes growth mentally and spiritually.", "Went to this college from 2011-2015 majoring in Bible and Theology and Youth Ministries. They have a great youth min. department and an overall great educational system that is centered around Christ. My only offense is that it has become a little too preppy for my taste, but that's only a preference. Other than that, if you want to go to a school where you want to learn more about the bible, strengthen your faith, and build up your career then this is the school for you.", 'My Alma Mater, a wonderful place to study alongside others with the same passion for Jesus Christ, yet without the baggage of as much denominationalism and hair-splitting that can often occur in the study of Theology. A small college where you get to know everyone, even the professors.', "They have become increasingly tolerant towards Calvinism, much to the chagrin of many parents who do not appreciate their kids being influenced by false teaching. They also have a music ministry department, although I'm not sure how that would benefit anyone or advance one's career."]

name: Eastern Iowa Community College District
reviews: ["This is not a good college in terms of real education. The classrooms are basic, the instructions are shallow, the school lacks real educators and real depth towards subjects. The staff is mostly white and so are the instructors. The school lacks the ability to really teach and use more current updated theories and ideas. This school didn't motivate me and I found it quite boring.", 'Loved my experience there, still speak to some of my professors. Fits well into downtown Davenport!', 'Great place to learn! Cutting edge technology here! Very helpful staff.']

name: Faith Baptist Bible College and Theological Seminary
reviews:
['What a wonderful place to be, maybe other colleges impact their students as much as Faith has impacted me but oh what a blessing. All the way from the students to the President himself there are people who are all pursuing God and who care for the student body. I praise God and thank Him for his blessing in allowing me to come here and to Grow. I hope God continues to use this college as He is now.', "I transferred to Faith in 2019 and as I write this review I'm weeks away from graduating with my Organizational Leadership degree. I recommend Faith with no reservations. I love this school and I have been shown unconditional love and care since I set foot on campus. The biblical and vocational instruction is of the highest quality and has given me every confidence to enter the workforce/ministry as a prepared and equipped worker. I will graduate into a job thanks to the skills and qualities built up in me while at Faith. Best of all, I have grown in my love for God, my love for people, and my knowledge of the Scriptures. Attending Faith will always be one of the best decisions I ever made.", "Great school with a commitment to God's Word and the Great Commission. I highly recommend Faith for a Bible education, even for people who don't plan to go into full-time ministry. A Bible education before pursuing a liberal arts degree is so valuable for life.

Faith also offers many great events throughout the year for people of all backgrounds. They just youth rallies, athletic camps, music camps, concerts, dramas, business summits, missions conferences, ministry leaders conferences, seminary, theology seminars, and so much more!

The faculty and staff is also the most friendly group that you will find at any school of higher education.", "Awesome Staff!!! Great college experience. Teacher's goals are to help you grow closer to God while pursuing your degree. Many opportunities to find new friends and to have lasting friendships. Even though FBBC are still missing some majors it is a great college to even attend their one or two year bible degree program!", 'Biblically solid, discipleship-oriented, friendly people, and overall a great environment to grow in the Lord Jesus.']

name: Graceland University-Lamoni
reviews: ['Graceland University is an unparalleled experience. The community building that happens there is unlike anywhere else in the world. Students are given a holistic, experiential education that will set them up well for the real world. The network of alumni are supportive, caring, and forever attached for their four years on "the Hill". You are guaranteed to meet lifelong friends and mentors at Graceland. Once you\'re a part of the Graceland Community, you\'re a part of it forever.', 'I highly recommend Graceland University to students who are looking for a special and unique educational experience.  Graceland is a small school that offers big advantages!  At Graceland, students find unparalleled opportunities to learn, to lead, to interact "one on one" with faculty members and other students, to participate in extra-curricular activities, to join student and campus organizations, to develop life-long friendships, and to tailor your education to your needs.  The power of Graceland is that it provides a well-rounded education and solid foundation that prepares students for future success.', 'Graceland University in Lamoni, IA is one of the best communities I have ever lived in. For a small community with a college located in it, there are so many events for all ages. There is no separation between the college and the town. Everyone partners together and supports each other! It truly is a great experience for anyone no matter if it is just for 4 years attending college or a life time because you love it so much you never want to leave!', 'My roommate from 40 years ago came for a visit and we shared about what good times we had “on the hill”.  I ended up staying in the general area having come from the KC metro but she has been in southern California and Omaha areas since then.  The ties from Graceland have reached across distance and time.', "Graceland University is an amazing university and offers amazing opportunities. It's especially great if you prefer to learn in small classes-- it really allows for a great learning experience. You will not only get the chance to build relationships with fellow student but the professors as well. At Graceland the professors really care about you as a person rather than just as a student. Graceland University as well as the alumni work with students to help you find internships and job opportunities-- they set you up for success in the long run. I would recommend this university to everyone without a doubt in my mind."]

name: Grand View University
reviews:
["Candidly, I wish I could leave zero stars. My experience as an online student with Grandview was, to say the least, abhorrent. After I transferred to a different institution, they held my transcript hostage until I paid the full balance off (which totaled thousands of dollars). This policy was not disclosed to me in advance, and Grandview's lack of communication and transparency resulted in a significant delay in my education.

They need to understand that many students are poor and working multiple jobs to survive, whilst taking classes. All they care about is getting their money at any cost, bowing to their donors who keep the school afloat, and implementing nonsensical policies that ultimately hurt the students.

There are better online colleges that offer much more value than Grandview, and I'd highly recommend that you not waste your time here. I hope this college goes insolvent, and if it does, I will be the first one to throw a party. First round is on me!", 'Completely my home away from home. Grand View is outstanding for adults who desire to go back to school. The professors are personable, understanding, and more than accommodating. I’ve had to bring my toddler to class with me on several occasions without so much as a second glance from instructors! My advisor is amazingly helpful and wants all of his advisees to succeed. I love the small class sizes and the professor to student ratio is spot on! Even in classes where I have struggled, I was given the extra help I needed because I feel the priority of the staff is having their students do well!

I am a veteran and processing my education benefits has always been effortless.

There are so many clubs, organizations, and extracurricular activities, students should have no problem finding their niche and becoming comfortable.

Reading the few negative reviews sounds more like a reflection of the type of student attending the institution; not the school itself!', 'Faculty signed me up for 15 credits, and informed me I was on track to graduate it being my final semester. In reality my requirement had been 18 credits to graduate. Now I am 3 credits short of graduation due to a mistake that should have never happened, and would probably never happen at a state school. My experience with sports led to permanent partial disability due to an ongoing injury that neither football coaches, strength coaches, or athletic trainers would take seriously.
Many have good things to say about this school but my personal experience has been not good', 'Grand view university is very clique, has a horrible science program, minimal and somewhat tolerable dining options with little concern to students safety. I was enrolled for a semester and had a horrible experience. My car was broken into and I had little to no help resolving the issue. My roommate and I had no AC until a gas leak occurred within the first couple weeks of moving in and they fixed it with no notice; leaving our desks, furniture and room covered with dirty footprints and build up of dust bunnies from the old AC. When we moved in there was also a used condom and old stickers in our room. Due to the minimal options for food i also lost at least 15 lbs during the months I was enrolled. At the end of the semester I tried connecting with the housing department to discontinue my housing contract for spring semester. I was strung along being told that all these issues should be enough reason to allow me the opportunity to move back home and continue my education. However, the movement was denied, resulting to me having to drop out of grand view. I now understand why their acceptance rate is so high because enrolling in grand view university is pointless unless you are an athlete or take a role in religious groups on campus.', 'Attended a play on the campus.  It was excellent! The actors were amazing and the play itself emotional and well directed! The campus is beautiful.  If the arts are any indication of the level of education there, I would say it is an excellent school!']

name: Grinnell College
reviews:
['The education I received here will always be my lighthouse. It’s more than just knowledge, but how people who disagree could respectfully communicate and learn from each other rather than simply commenting “weird” to anything they don’t understand. In moments when I feel stuck in life, Grinnell always reminds me to pass down the help and care I received, and of the wonderful, diligent, inspiring people I once worked with. Feels like all the darkness is temporary and life has hope after all.', 'AN OUTSTANDING HIGHER LEARNING EXPERIENCE OF A LIFETIME.  HAD THE OPPORTUNITY TO ATTEND A LATINO AFFAIRS AND HUMAN RIGHTS DIVISION THREE DAYS TO BE ABLE TO KEEP UP WITH THE ENORMOUS HISPANIC GROUWTH IN POPULATION IN THE SURROUNDING STATES.  BEAUTIFUL PEOPLE AND HOSPITABLE ATMOSPHERE FOR LEARNING AT YOUR BEST.
Mrs. ANNA  ISABEL GUERRERO
Assistant Director', 'Very friendly town and college.  The people there are very customer service oriented.  It is a very small town, but a great place to go if you'd like to get away from the "big city" college life.  Just know, there are only a very few places that stay open past midnight, so be sure to do your shopping and entertainment before then.  The town also doesn't seem to wake up until around 8am... so if you'd like to get a morning jog in, before anyone awakes - your safe between the hours of 5am and 8am... there are hardly any cars on the street - let alone, people.', 'Lovely campus. Small, quaint liberal arts college in a small Iowa town. I took a tour with an alum and a 2024 almost grad. Quiet and serene. They pointed out some of the more eccentric history like the peace rock.

I loved how they preserved some of the older buildings.', 'Grinnell College has a GORGEOUS campus. Fantastic academics and I enjoyed the classes I sat in on when I visited.

I also was aware of: "sticking out like a sore thumb" in the town of Grinnell. It's a TINY town. Being a NYC native, Iowa was a bit too isolated and rural for me. I opted for college in New England instead in the end.']

name: Orion Technical College
reviews: ['Orion Technical College is currently facing multiple lawsuits. These legal cases are reportedly active in states including New Jersey, California, Iowa and in some other states. The instructors are very supportive, they help in any way to help you excel, Fast paced and lots of hands on. 2 1/2 years for bachelors soo if your looking into a bachelors degree in electronics, this is the place to go. Great hands on experience for electrical majors. Highly Recommend', "The instructors are good however it just wasn't the right fit for me There rules are way to strict."]

name: Hawkeye Community College
reviews:
['I am very disappointed with my experience at Hawkeye Community College due to the conduct of one of the instructors, Mr. Todd Stabenow. The instructor was extremely rude, hurtful, and disrespectful toward me, and he even hung up the Zoom meeting while I was speaking. During a recorded one-on-one Zoom meeting, he repeatedly interrupted me, spoke in a demeaning and aggressive tone, and abruptly hung up on me while I was speaking. He also told me to “be like the other students and do what they are doing,” which I found dismissive, unprofessional, and entirely inappropriate.

He went on to make unfounded accusations of cheating on multiple assignments and incorrectly graded my most recent assignment. During this time, I was grieving the loss of a loved one, and he showed no empathy or flexibility—insisting that I meet with him despite being fully aware of my situation. I was accused of using AI and cheating on all of my assignments, even though I was willing to show my work and explain my process. This is unrealistic given today’s academic environment where nearly every major platform, including Microsoft, now integrates AI by default. The college’s policies are outdated and need serious refinement to reflect current technology.

Instead of addressing my concerns, the instructor responded angrily. He said, “Why can’t you be like the other students and do what you’re told and not do drafts? This isn’t a professional writing program. I’m not asking you for a high-quality literary work.” I explained that drafting is how I learn and prepare my final assignments. Despite this, I was treated harshly and disrespected, which was hurtful and made me feel worthless. My learning style was not acknowledged or respected. I felt like he was being quite abusive towards me during that one on one meeting and virtual interaction.

I reported these concerns to the administration, yet Hawkeye took no meaningful action to investigate or resolve my complaint. Their lack of response to his hostile behavior was extremely stressful and raises serious concerns about the college’s commitment to student safety, respect, and accountability.

Update: I requested a copy of the Zoom meeting recording, and that request was not honored. No video copy of the meeting was ever provided, despite my repeated attempts to obtain it. The dean’s correspondence made it clear that no action was taken to defend or protect my rights, showing the institution’s willingness to overlook instructor misconduct—including disrespect, name-calling, and abusive behavior—even though these actions violate the college’s own code of conduct.

I will be reaching out directly to the college’s President for his attention regarding this matter. I also intend to present the Zoom recording live to the Board of Trustees and the President so they can see firsthand the conduct I experienced.

Students deserve transparency, fairness, and a learning environment where concerns are taken seriously.', 'Hawkeye Community College in Waterloo has a welcoming campus that is easy to navigate and designed with students in mind. The college emphasizes a student-first approach, offering supportive services, study areas, and resources that make it easier to succeed both in and out of the classroom. The environment feels inclusive and focused on helping students reach their goals, creating a positive place to learn and grow.', 'What a great place. I had the pleasure to visit this fantastic College. The staff is very professionel and very helpfull. It’s a honor to work together with such great place and I hope to be back soon.', 'I visited the dental clinic where the technicians in training are able to practice what they have learned in pursuing their careers. I receive excellent preventative dental care by great students and staff.', 'All my teachers for gen eds were so nice and made class enjoyable. When it came to the nursing program very little was taught by the teachers. Class time was mostly used to review material we had to teach ourselves. Only 3 students remain from my class because of the same difficulties.']

name: Indian Hills Community College
reviews: ["For someone who doesn't go here but touring, I think it is a good starter college. But, not for me.", 'A nice college. My only complaint is the nontransparent limits they put on financial aid and the lack of decent organization to explain where your money went.', "This place is horrible. The dorms have cockroaches, a really bad infestation of cockroaches!! They have outdated elevators that should have been replaced years ago, they are just now replacing one of them. They would get stuck, open with no elevator in which someone could have been severely injured, one even caught on fire. Then now two of which I have seen of the washing machines are broken so some of us cannot do our laundry. The bathrooms are rather filthy. The parking lots need repairs badly. I have been treated poorly by numerous people including a professor who forced me and a friend to drop out of her class. That professor also called my friend a distraction because he is bisexual. The food in the cafeteria isn't the best. I honestly find this place a waste of time and money. It's not even worthy of being called a college.", "The campus itself is beautiful, and the professors are great and the people at the One Stop building are very helpful. But Financial Aid is a pain to deal with and when you're enrolled in just one class at a time, and you don't pass, they take away your FASFA and they don't tell you until you apply for a couple classes, then all of a sudden they tell you that you can't. The whole system they have there is outdated and ridiculous. The only thing I enjoyed about the campus was at the St. John Auditorium where there were performances put on by guests coming in, the choir and jazz band performances, and ESPECIALLY the theatre performances. This is a good college to go to if you want cheap education, and if you have a lot of patience.", "I graduated this past May. My first year I had no problems. My second year was absolutely awful. One of the ladies in the as tech building is more than rude. Also one of the academic advisors canceled my financial aid for the term and told me I was ready to graduate but I was 2 credits short. Then with information you'll get.a different answer from each representative you talk to and the answers conflict. I will say that most of the instructors are absolutely wonderful and setting up your classes is a breeze. I just wish the faculty that didn't teach were more trained and knew what they were doing."]

name: Iowa Central Community College
reviews:
['Daughter is having a great experience as an student/athlete.  Smaller campus life and a top notch athletic program.', 'Great facilities. Excellent staff. Their sports programs are very good. Especially their new esports program which has really taken off!', 'Very nice campus n students n facility go out of their way to help', 'Smaller campus feel. Welcoming students and staff. Technology savvy school. Nice dorms and class rooms.Students can receive a free teeth cleaning from dental assisting students. Several athletic options. Lots of vocal, instrumental, and theatre options. Great nursing program. Very well prepared meeting and tour. Great school.', 'Was studying here, but it can be difficult getting student loans. I was qualified, however I was told that you must be 24 years old or older to be qualified for independency. Those that are under the age of 24 are qualified as dependents, so you have to fill out parental forms and information including their marriage papers.
I was unexpectedly pulled out of the classroom indicating an issue with my parents marriage forms. I was told that there was an unspecified “error” and that I can no longer continue my education here until I can get that fixed.
Being pulled out of the classroom more than once because of slight problems during the student loan process and errors is ridiculous.

Decided to not return!']

name: Iowa Lakes Community College
reviews: ["Their aviation program recently just scored #3 nationally, and #1 community college offering an aviation program.\n\nReally a hidden gem. The college itself handles itself well. The staff are concise, clear, and attentive. Instructors you had one class with 2 years ago, will recognize you by name when they see you. It's a fantastic school, without all the negative stereotypes colleges can sometimes have.", 'Iowa Lakes.  Awesome Academic adventures await for those who choose this fine institution.  Friendly and knowledgeable staff mold minds young and old — and they want to see students succeed.  Many are the offerings to choose from, both for students and adult continuing education.  Consider them for your future.', 'Excellent College with a lot of great programs in technical fields like welding and aviation and others. Their wind turbine technician program is absolutely top notch with excellent teachers!!', 'Excellent teacher to student ratio. Every student can get direct assistance.', 'Beautiful, well designed theater. Excellent sound quality.']

name: Iowa State University
reviews:
['Currently attending Iowa State as a Sophomore. Absolutely loving it. It is such a beautiful campus, and besides the super wild weather here, it is perfect to maneuver around by foot or bike. Professors and staff are super kind and there are always fun events for students and locals to attend.', 'Looking back, my four years at Iowa State University were some of the most beautiful and transformative years of my life. The campus is absolutely stunning—no matter the season, there’s a unique charm that stays with you forever.

I am now living in Australia, thousands of miles away, but I still find myself dreaming about my college days in Ames. Whether it was walking across the historic central campus or the vibrant student life, ISU holds a very special place in my heart.

I’ve promised myself that I will bring my family back one day to visit and show them where it all began. Once a Cyclone, always a Cyclone! 🌪️❤️', 'Every fall, I am reminded as to why Iowa State University is ranked as one of the most beautiful campus in the country.  All the fall foliage makes me want to keep snapping photos like an incoming freshman visiting the campus for the first time. name: University of Iowa
reviews:
['The University of Iowa operates with a clear, no-frills mindset: show up, do the work, and leave with skills you can actually use. The academic culture tends to be direct and grounded, with expectations that students engage seriously with their field rather than coast on reputation. There is an understanding that outcomes matter — writing, research, clinical work, and professional preparation are treated as things to be practiced, refined, and measured, not just discussed. The environment may not be flashy, but it is intentionally built to produce graduates who are ready to perform.

UC Davis, in contrast, can feel like an institution more invested in how it appears than in how effectively it pushes students. The campus is attractive, the messaging is polished, and the branding suggests rigor and innovation, yet the day-to-day experience can lack the urgency that actually drives development. Large systems, diffuse priorities, and an emphasis on maintaining a certain image can leave students to create their own pressure rather than being challenged by the structure itself. When accountability is soft and expectations are uneven, motivated students may feel they are carrying the weight of their own education instead of being sharpened by it.

At Iowa, the culture signals that competence is the goal.
At UC Davis, the signal can sometimes be that affiliation is enough.

The difference is between a university that insists you prove what you can do and one that risks assuming its name will do that for you.', 'Their referral process to their pulmonology department takes 5-10 days, I was told, when I called. On top of that, it takes time to actually get in for an appointment, I was quoted another 2-3 weeks. When someone has suspected or potential lung cancer, this is a horrible wait time. Meanwhile, Iowa Health Clinics got me in for my first appointment within 2 days and a PET scan within the first week and a half. For Iowa City supposedly being the "best" in the state, this is below standard care. Iowa City still has yet to call me (this was all found out back on April 4th, it's now April 19th), I already have next steps and a diagnosis with Iowa Health Clinics. Time, when it comes to lung cancer, can be the difference between stage 1 and stage 3-4. This is extremely unacceptable.', 'I went to university of iowa for my hearing implant schedule...easy to get to .the parking was good went to the top & nobody to bother you ..just write the number where you are =the floor#& you got it Mark', 'I recently traveled to The University of Iowa, my alma mater (Class of 1989), for the first time in 25 years! It was a road trip from Chicago with an old friend whose daughter now goes there. We encountered great service, prices, friendly people, etc. There was "Caitlin Clark Mania" going on still on campus in celebration of the NCAA/Iowa girl's basketball legend who recently broke all NCAA scoring records & brought her team to the Finals. There was such a great vibe on campus while we were there, Iowa City & the university were jumping! We also stayed overnight at a great new hotel that was conveniently located near everything right in the downtown area! Check out Iowa!', 'Proud Alumni of UIOWA. I will forever remember this place. Once a Hawkeye Always a Hawkeye.']

Father Vu is sweet and funny, kind and caring. He's an amazing person to have at Loras. He truly cares about everyone.", 'It may not be your first choice, but don’t let its size discourage you. This hilly campus offers many amenities, and I always found it comforting during my study hours in the library.

During my physical training, the wellness center, though moderately sized, had everything I needed to stay active. All the equipment was well-maintained, and I always considered it to be an immaculate facility.

Grabbing a bite at the cafeteria was a delightful experience. The food was not only satisfying but also conveniently served warm, making it the perfect pick-me-up. Every meal was a reminder of the comfort of good, hearty fare!

Additionally, Loras has plenty of spaces to inspire your creativity. The Visitation, a facility once associated with Loras, not only provides living quarters for some but also serves as a venue for music and fine arts. Hoffman Hall features an impressive array of video and audio equipment, including a state-of-the-art lab that meets all your editing needs.

It’s a wonderful school, and I would highly recommend it.', 'In one word "growth." if you are looking for a school that has been designed to make sure you grow, from top to bottom, this is it. In no other school will you be challenged to expand, learn, appreciate, express curiosity,  fail, fail, and fail again, than at Loras College. This is what makes the experience so amazing. You'll be well served should you attend. And well served should you decide to stop by campus and visit - it's gorgeous!', 'Great education, caring instructors, small class sizes. name: Maharishi International University
reviews:
['Excellent university. All the courses you take are professional and very useful in your career. They prepare you in all aspects of life. Staff are very friendly and caring and tuition is fair, once you start working you pay it off pretty quick. I had so many friends for life that I got from there. I also refereed many friends, family members and others who are already successful from the program.', "if you are applying to CS program, don't bother if you don't have experience of 18-24 months in Java.
I have passed the technical tests, and I have +2 years of experience with another web programming language, and the final answer is we can't accept you, you can pay the full program if you wan to join.
I detailed with the reviewer more, and the real cause is that they want Java Profiles with proven experience.
You should tell people clearly about that condition so that they don't waste money translating documents and everything else that comes with applying.", 'Before attending clinicals, I reached out to the school to confirm whether it was worth investing my time and money given my low grade due to personal challenges. I was instructed to calculate a grade estimate, which showed I would pass with at least 70%. Based on this, I moved forward with my plans. During this time, my TA encouraged me by saying, “I would encourage you to continue to submit assignments. I think there is a chance you will be able to bring your grade up to passing. The webinar attendance will be updated this week and that will show an improvement in your grade. Do your best, while remembering the Ayurvedic principles of no strain or stress.”

With this reassurance, I took PTO from work, spent over $200 on airfare, and an additional $300 on transportation to attend clinicals, only to receive an email during clinicals suggesting I withdraw due to a low chance of passing. This was extremely disheartening and frustrating, as it could have been communicated earlier.

Throughout the program, I felt there was little to no support when it came to addressing missing assignments or helping students balance other commitments. As someone juggling a full-time job, running a business, and being a single parent, I found the lack of understanding and flexibility at odds with the values the program claims to teach.

I would not recommend this program to individuals who have significant personal or professional responsibilities, as the support system does not align with the demands of students managing complex lives.', "My experience so far at MIU is pretty amazing. I'm going for my B/A in Ayurveda health and wellness. I have multiple chronic illnesses and have suffered from migraines, depression, and anxiety from a young age. I'm guessing mostly from the environment we are raised in. I knew there had to be a better way, and there is. Our country isn't set up to inspire individual growth or enlightenment or to PROMOTE TRUE HEALING .. Through my own research, I found Ayurveda, and that put me on a holistic healing journey for mind body spirit💫 I would strongly advise a consciousness based education and meditation 🧘‍♀️ for everyone wanting a life change. TM and the process of bringing full awareness to ourselves is so important during this time. My question is... If everyone knew they could help change the world, make it a more peaceful place for us all just by meditation. Would they do so?", 'Maharishi International University is a fantastic choice for students looking to earn their Masters in Computer Science. The university provides a unique and holistic education experience that is well-suited for international students. The faculty is knowledgeable and dedicated, offering a high-quality curriculum in computer science that emphasizes sustainable technology and conscious leadership. The campus is beautiful, peaceful, and conducive to learning, making it an ideal environment for international students to thrive. Furthermore, the university has a supportive community of students, staff, and faculty who are committed to helping students succeed both academically and personally. Overall, I highly recommend Maharishi International University to anyone seeking a world-class education in computer science, especially to international students looking for a supportive and transformative learning experience.']

name: Mercy College of Health Sciences
reviews: ['I transferred credits smoothly into the ABSN program, their onboarding was quick and easy. The professors were supportive and knowledgeable, and the rigorous curriculum truly prepared me for a career in healthcare. MCHS is challenging but rewarding—perfect for those ready to work hard. If you’re looking for an easy path, this may not be the school for you.', 'This school is only a third the size of my high school and somehow administrators and staff still cannot run it and keep things organized. I was told when transferring that 33 of my previously earned credits (only 1 year previous) would transfer to my new program at Mercy, but when I got here the registrar told me that only 6 credits would transfer. Her words were "Well, I just told you those other credits would transfer in case you got here and didn\'t like that program. They will transfer for any of the other programs." So I am now retaking every general education class (math, psych, sociology) because "these courses are more medically based here at Mercy." Really? Math is more medical? Okay. Secondly, I have been attending this school for almost a year now and just last week my advisor emails me welcoming me and asking if I needed any help scheduling my classes. Thanks. Safe to say this is my last semester at Mercy. I advise you do not attend this school. What a waste of money.', "My experience at MCHS was superb! I transferred 2 years worth of credits into my bachelors degree program and had little to no hassles at all. My academic advisor, Dr. Suzanne Crandall (has since retired), was always very helpful and knowledgeable and I will forever remember all of the positive experiences I had with each of my professors. In regards to the few negative reviews about MCHS, this school was not easy and definitely pushes you to your limits. It is challenging and not meant for those that give up easily. I personally loved the challenge and the fact that the curriculum was rigorous to prepare me for my career in healthcare. If it were easy, the value of the education would be severely diminished. If you're looking for an easier route, I would advise you to seek a for-profit college education. Feel free to contact me if you'd like any guidance about MCHS! - Lukas", 'I wish my daughter never went here . My teachers were much more involved with my learning and although it is a hard program, I did it! I still keep in touch with a couple of my teachers even though I live out of state now, and I had no problems finding a job. I recommend going here.']

name: Northeast Iowa Community College
reviews:
['Northeast Iowa Community College in Peosta, Iowa, is truly an outstanding institution that exemplifies excellence in education, community engagement, and student support. From the moment you arrive on campus, it’s clear that NICC Peosta is dedicated to fostering a positive, inclusive, and growth-oriented learning environment. The faculty and staff go above and beyond to ensure that every student receives the guidance, resources, and encouragement needed to succeed both academically and professionally.

The campus itself is modern, vibrant, and equipped with state-of-the-art facilities that enhance hands-on learning across a wide range of programs—from technical trades and healthcare to business, agriculture, and beyond. The strong partnerships NICC maintains with local industries and employers further demonstrate its commitment to real-world skill development and career readiness.

Whether you’re beginning your educational journey, returning to school, or seeking career advancement, NICC Peosta provides an exceptional foundation for success. It stands as a shining example of how community colleges can transform lives, empower communities, and build a stronger future for the region.', 'Absolutely ridiculous experience with this college. I took a class through them that was $1000 and was supposed to take a $190 test a few months later. I called ahead of time to let them know I couldn’t make it, and the person I spoke to said they’d get back to me about rescheduling without having to pay again.
Now they’re claiming I never called—flat-out lying—even though I have screenshots of the call as proof. Since I “didn’t” call they said that if I want to take the test I have to repay the full price. So apparently, their customer service is not only useless, but also dishonest. Instead of owning up to their mistake, they expect me to pay the full $190 all over again. I wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone. Unorganized, unprofessional, and clearly don’t care once they’ve gotten your money.', 'Absolutely loved my time at NICC! Made some great life long friends, saved money over attending a state university, and worked and learned with some of the best and most compassionate staff. Highly recommend NICC and am proud to say I went there!', 'This school system is terrible. Unbalanced difficulty for the majority of the assignments.
