Thus, Washtenaw Community College is packed full of the possibilities of enhancing the potentialities, aptitudes and visions, just as any institution of higher learning should be. The key: Higher Learning. Do not disparage the “in-district” resident’s ability to pay $95 a credit hour. Of course, the Big 10, Ivy League and others are prestigious and wonders to behold. Yet talent is talent and at times it all comes out in the wash. We are all in the mosaic of life. An accommodating student center, the Legendary Morris Lawrence w the Auditorium’s name in his honor and the music program still going strong. WCC offers countless resources, references and an ability to improve your life plan. A new career pathway, a hobby, a skill, a language- don’t break an arm or a leg, go into an easy transition, by becoming a WCC student and hold your head high.']

name: Wayne County Community College District
reviews:
['Very unorganized staff Samuel Craig AAS and James Jackson (CJS)  both do not respond to emails I have emailed both 4 times on the same issue which is having a hold on my financial aid because they didn’t log my attendance and still no response. I called the distance learning hotline and they told me to wait 48 more hours on top of what I already waited and the financial aid department sent me in circles as well. This is not the first instance of wcccd having these problems with these teachers unfortunately I didn’t read the rate my professor and these teachers are known for doing this wcccd do BETTER!', "Really caters to the older crowd and middle easterns, you'll notice the programs and classes have a real old school mindset and doesn't cater to every type of student. As a foster youth attending here there is not enough resources discussed on campus for us. The students are always loud in the hallways during class hours and nobody likes to answer the phone when u 1st call. I had to threaten financial office more than once about me filing a complaint because of the lack of response. Be ready to advocate for yourself here and if u don't know how make sure u have a parent or trusted adult who does.
*Update! 2/17/26 - This schools financial aid office is horrible! I don't know who these people think they are playing with but they got one more semester to mess up my scholarship funds before I take it to the news and file a report with the State! Ain't no way yall are still gonna get government funding knowing yall denying or delaying aid for the most vulnerable!", 'The bookstore manager was dismissive and did not provide the support I expected. I hope management focuses more on professionalism moving forward.', 'Recent events: 01/16/2024

A "situation" waiting to happen! The pictures are what is supposed to be a clear and safe walkway.

I tell someone (I guess in charge) about the situation, and all HE wants to do is appear to be UNCONCERNED and states that HE saw the "maintenance crew" put salt out.  Well, guess what? It looks 👀 like YOU missed this!
Do ANYONE see a SAFE situation within the pictures?

03/24/2020
This is by far the worst place to try to get information.

When students call for information regarding their account, it states to call student accounts.
NO ONE answers the phone.  Students are asked to leave a message.  Students leave several messages over a period of time, and NO ONE returns calls.

Students are to graduate and NEED information to help students.

We go in person to speak with someone in students' services.  The people at the downtown campus were nice.  We called the number that was given (District Financial Aid), and the person (male) that answered the phone was no help and rude.

He stated that he would pass the information along and when asked how long it will take?  No answer.  He was reminded that there are 34 days left for the semester.  He was asked 30, 45, or 90 days?  or 2 weeks or 3 days?  Still no answers.

Students call to get answers, and students get sent from place to place.

WCCCD needs to make an area for student accounts.  Maybe if there's a section for them, students can receive faster information.

Disclaimer:  Not all staff are HORRIBLE. Those who are HORRIBLE make  it harder for the ones who do ASSIST students.

There should be a list of the staff members who go above and beyond.  To be HONORED.

The HORRIBLE staff's picture needs to be posted on a wall.', "A great institution for higher education and certificate training programs. They've also just opened a new entrepreneurship center @ the downtown campus!"]

name: Wayne State University
reviews: ['Wayne State University, standing proudly at 42 W Warren Ave in the pulsating heart of Midtown Detroit, is frequently characterized in my professional and social circles as an urban powerhouse that seamlessly weaves academic rigor into the city’s cultural and economic fabric. Through numerous meaningful exchanges with alumni and local entrepreneurs, a clear consensus emerges that the university operates with a merytorical depth, particularly within its top-tier medical and law programs which are often cited as regional benchmarks of excellence. My colleagues often remark on the university’s unique "Warrior" spirit, noting that the faculty demonstrates a sophisticated level of dedication that equips students with the street-smart moxie and intellectual versatility required in today’s unpredictable global market. In frequent discussions about the Michigan academic landscape, the public sentiment consistently praises the institution for being a vital engine of social mobility and a hub for groundbreaking research that directly improves urban life. I am particularly struck by the university’s commitment to diversity and community-based learning, a sentiment echoed by many families I know who have seen their children flourish in such a dynamic and inclusive atmosphere. It is evident from the collective feedback of those I trust that the administration manages this sprawling research university with a transparent and visionary hand, ensuring its status as a dependable pillar of Detroit’s historic resurgence. Reflecting on these consistently positive and grounded testimonials, I view Wayne State University as a distinguished entity that executes its complex mission with undeniable class and an inspiring dedication to the progress of the entire community.', 'Walking the campus in this historical area was almost mind blowing for me.  Missed out on so many details. Cool part...my first was also my kids first.  Get out and enjoy these warmer days.  See the city before the crowds drive up the prices', 'Our experience with Wayne State has been extremely disappointing, especially when compared to the positive experiences our other children have had at three other in-state colleges. The university feels far more focused on generating revenue than supporting students and keeping them healthy. I was initially concerned about the high dropout rate during our campus tour, but we moved forward because my daughter loved the urban atmosphere. Unfortunately, we now understand what it means to be “Wayne Stated,” and it has been frustrating and disheartening. I would strongly recommend exploring other institutions.', 'Over 5k in mandatory housing and meal plans for my kid to have a mold infested room and be so hungry everyone in her family is sending food. Do not recommend.\nUpdate: The school is moving them out of the mold infested room into a more expensive room and charging the difference. For their own negligence.', "Courtney Doty in the PA program, told me to have a baby to cure menstrual cramps. She doesn't know what patient autonomy is."]

name: West Shore Community College
reviews: ["I went to the beauty academy it's close down now. It Doesn't take 2 years to become a cosmetologist (beautician) I was in a position were I could go to college while the boys were in school. This was very important to me and Barry. So happy we made that decision. I didn't miss anything at the boys School. If I could help it, when Barry was home from being out of town working. He didn't miss anything at school either with the boys or his children!! LET ME TELL YOU I SO MISS THOSE DAYS!!😢", 'Still a great place to play pick up games or shoot around. Gym is nice as well.', "Will not accept most credits from other schools. One can have multiple degrees from accredited institutions but somehow lack transferable general ed credits. They give registration priority to high school students so good luck getting 100 level courses that must be taken because credits didn't transfer. Online system is archaic and tech support is abysmal. Credits that don't transfer are counted for financial aid, so they stop accepting FA for having too many credits. What does that even mean? So just don't try to get transfer credit because you'll be intelligible for FA, and your credits won't be accepted anyway.", "Just a trip to Westshore College haven't been there in almost 50 years Shurely looks different now.", "Nice pool and weight room that isn't priced ridiculously. Family memberships available. They also have a ice rink, indoor tennis courts and basketball courts"]

name: Western Michigan University
reviews:
['Western Michigan University (WMU), anchored at 1903 W Michigan Ave in the dynamic city of Kalamazoo, is frequently cited in my professional and local circles as a "powerhouse of purpose" that masterfully integrates top-tier technical expertise with a deeply supportive, learner-centered culture. From numerous substantive conversations with alumni and industry leaders, a clear consensus emerges that WMU operates with a merytorical precision, particularly through its world-renowned College of Aviation and the Haworth College of Business, which both consistently produce graduates with elite-level professional moxie. My colleagues often remark on the university’s unique ability to feel like a private college due to its focus on experience-driven learning, noting that 93% of students participate in hands-on projects that prepare them for immediate leadership roles. In frequent discussions about the Great Lakes academic landscape, the public sentiment consistently praises the campus for its visionary "Bronco Promise" and its role as a vital engine for both scientific innovation and social mobility within the region. I am particularly struck by the university’s status as a "Best College for Future Leaders," a sentiment echoed by many families I know who have seen their loved ones transition into high-impact careers at global firms like Stryker or Pfizer. It is evident from the collective feedback of those I trust that the administration manages this "high research activity" institution with a transparent and inclusive hand, ensuring that every student has the tools to thrive intellectually and emotionally. Reflecting on these consistently positive and grounded testimonials, I view Western Michigan University as a distinguished institution that executes its complex mission with undeniable class, academic integrity, and an inspiring commitment to the success of its global community.', "This is a beautiful campus for sure but if your career goal is to be an engineer then I would look elsewhere for schooling, this college has no internship program like most other colleges have and to graduate with no experience is a death sentence for your career, the job fair that they have is a joke, so don't count on that and most of the engineering professors can barely speak English so don't count on advise from your professors... There are so many Engineering jobs to be had but they ALL require experience that you will not get with this college", "went on a tour here as a junior in high school. Beautiful campus I would've considered this place if it was closer to home.", "Love this campus! It's always beautiful and I had great professors while I attended. I also loved the community. I was involved in a group called Cru where I met my wife and all my closest friends. Such a great club for new people and a great school!", '-Great University.
- Helpful Prefossers
- Diverse Community.
- Reachable destination between major cities in
the Midwest.
- Safe Campus.']

name: Alexandria Technical & Community College
reviews: ["I've had two out of three children attend so far and they both had great experiences! The administrators and instructors are very friendly and helpful. The facility is kept clean and in good condition. It's no wonder why ATCC always gets amazing scores in national reviews.", 'Very knowledgeable instructor. Very helpful staff.', 'The best Truck Driving Program there is in my opinion, the instructors are awesome and really help out with questions you may have and also are there to help you pass your classes too, just put in the time and effort as well!', 'The staff and teachers were great. The teachers we toured with truely had our daughters education in mind and when they spoke with her they were truely interested about her career focus and really took the time to point out the great programs that would help her achieve her goals. Our 15 year old even fell in love with the school.', 'Went to the truck driving program and it was the best decision ever. Definitely learned a lot more to truck driving than I would at any other school. Would recommend to anybody wanting to go!!!']

name: Anoka Technical College
reviews: ["The instructors are great and super supportive. The college itself is money hungry and everyone is not in harmonious communication with one another and it's a lot of telling the student what another faculty has no authority over as if the student should be scolded and most importantly GRADUATION IS HELD IN A GYMNASIUM WHERE OUR GUEST HAD TO SIT ON BLEACHERS. Can you imagine someone's grandparent or anyone not in shape sitting through an entire ceremony on a bleacher. It's just plain tacky after we spend our hard earned money and thousands to be given a cheap ceremony for accomplishing our goals in return.", 'I went for my cna exam multiple times and the instructors were horrible. They don’t not look up  often to observe what you’re doing, this instructor in particular would make me repeat everything I did because she was not looking and taking up my time. I was taken off points for things I very clearly did because she was looking down on the computer the most of the time. The instructor was very passive aggressive and impatient. If you’re taking your cna exam I would suggest going somewhere else.', 'Do not do their LPN program if you can help it. I had one incredibly kind and caring instructor (Kay). The nursing director is rude and dismissive. Honestly one of the most unprofessional directors I have ever seen. The courses are choppy, staff fight in front of students, the courses have no additional help (tutors, extra explanations). Very outdated teaching methods. If you ask for help expect to get "Well ask your fellow peers.". Which no peer has time to help you. I wasted my money and time. I was treated horribly for the three months I was there.', 'Staff and Facility are all good, staff are always helpful and clearly passionate about what they do and teach, the facility is clean, easy to navigate and occasionally fun to explore. There are nice outdoor hangout spots which are relaxing to visit (pre-Covid) I feel really happy with my choice to attend this school. The school also took Covid very seriously and at no point have I worried for my safety and well-being. If you’re looking to get into trades, or pursue other career or educational choices offered by Anoka Tech, I’d highly recommend it.', 'Very good programs and instructors. They prepare you well for work field.']

name: Anoka-Ramsey Community College
reviews: ['This is a good place to start a college education without sinking into debt. Anoka-Ramsey has the lowest tuition in Minnesota and is one of the top ten community colleges in the nation.  My oldest daughter received your associate degree a few years ago and my youngest daughter just started fall 2022. Her first day was this week and many on campus commented the parking lots have not been this full for several years. It’s good to see some normalcy again.\n\nI walked the entire campus and was impressed how well it is maintained  The instructors are personable and faculty very helpful.', 'Academic advising office is genuinely useless for providing help with degree planning and transfer information. They constantly suggest that we take classes that are of no use to our desired transfer schools, all in order to bring in more revenue. Genuinely deplorable', 'I attended Anoka Ramsey for PSEO during high school. My counselor was Ryan Olson, and he was amazing. My goal at the start was to complete my AA degree, and he helped me do just that. I was full-time and I enjoyed in-person classes at their newly renovated campus, and also enjoyed the online classes. If I were to do it over again, I would do the same thing! This campus is nicer than most 4-year campuses.', 'I have taken generals over the years here and those professors were always great. Since Spring semester of 2024 I have been in the LPN to RN MANE program. My one star review is in regard to the nursing staff, program, and dean of nursing. Multiple students filing complaints about student favoritism, inconsistencies in tests (spelling errors, abbreviations), not getting any assignment grades back until the week prior to finals. All of it was dismissed and not seen as an issue. Appeals have been made on the decisions of said complaints, with yet again another denial. The nursing staff are not supportive of their students. It does not feel like they are here to help us succeed at all. I’ve never had to fight so hard for minimal respect. We get told we aren’t professional, and remind us we agreed to being professional when we took our seat in the program. But we can’t even get a test without spelling errors. It’s so disheartening. Especially after completing an LPN program at Anoka Tech and had a wonderful experience. I knew the program was going to be hard, but what we students are being put through on top of all the difficulties in the curriculum, is asinine. I have contemplated dropping out (even though I only have 1 semester left) just to start over at a new school where I can feel respected.', "Surprisingly does a lot of things better than the next place I went, and I'm now trying really hard to influence based on what I know works. While I didn't originally want to start college at a community college, this was my best possible option when I found out for personal reasons that I had no other choice. I actually miss it sometimes. I visit when I can."]

name: Augsburg University
reviews:
["Parking is terrible for a commuter student, I recommend coming an hour early if you can, because you're never going to find a spot. And don't even bother buying a Commuter Student parking permit, it's worthless.", 'I attended Augsburg from January ‘22 to May ‘24 and I’m grateful for the experiences and all the staff who have helped me along the way.

Trio is a great program to be In, my advisor connected me to so many grants and scholarships and even recommended the McNair program.

The university does have wonderful opportunities for aid however they can be a hassle to obtain sometimes.

The food isn’t all the great, I went to Nabo almost everyday because it was the only decent thing to eat on campus. I was a commuter and a transfer student so I can’t really speak on living conditions on campus but parking sucks arrive before 9am if you want a decent spot.

I’m blessed to have made some lifelong friends and to have met some of the best professors during my undergraduate experience.', 'My good friend was getting inducted into the Augsburg Hall of Fame. A special occasion surrounded by special people.', "Update. An administration that places it's security officers in harms way and does not care about obstructing Federal Law Enforcement. A complete embarrassment.", 'I was really excited to go to college here, I was one the first students with FAS Grant for foster care and wow did I go wrong picking this college. My first semester I missed a week due to COVID which I’ll excuse, but I got in 2nd semester and instantly had issues. With the FAS grant foster kids have a free dorm room paid and college, I was supposed to have all these until they brought me in their office after attending for a month and was told I would start having to pay out of pocket, WHEN I WAS GIVEN FREE COLLEGE. I filled out the drop out forms that allows you not to get charged as well turned them in a week early and they told me two weeks later I missed the deadline and still dropped me from all classes then charged me $10,000. If you’re a foster kid looking for a way to succeed and find success and a supporting community I do not recommend this school. They also had dropped me from 2 classes for no reason so I would no longer be in 5 classes which is the minimum for all the scholarships. Dropped me in my FIRST 3 days of attending. This was supposed to be the experience of my life instead turned into the worst decision of my life.']

name: Riverland Community College
reviews:
["Riverland has helped me to become a successful adult and has blessed me in numerous ways. I first heard about Riverland as a high school senior thinking about college and dreaming about the future. The first things that really stood out to me were the foreign exchange student program and Be Your Best. This college recognizes and celebrates a variety of cultures. The exchange program provides an opportunity for students from other countries to apply and attend school here via student visas and then further helping students to apply to stay in the U.S. permanently. While I didn't go through this program, I met several friends who did and one of the leaders of this program M. Garate! It is a great program and many have been able to obtain their degrees here and then furthering their education by transferring credits over to a 4 year plus grad school to earn there Masters or Doctorate degrees.

As a student who qualified for the Be Your Best Summer Academy program for college success, I was able to apply and was eagerly accepted into this empowering program. It meant so much to me to be the first in my birth family to graduate with both a Highschool diploma AND a college degree. Be Your Best provided me an opportunity to ease into college by taking college prep courses which counted as college credit along with getting some of my generals done early and get them out of the way. I chose to do one of the classes I knew would be the most challenging and was able to have a one on one tutor. The tutor came and sat in class with my other classmates and I every day. She took the same notes we did and completed the same homework we did.
After this we were already a part of the school so signing up for Fall classes on in order to earn our degrees was a breeze.
As an alumni and graduate of the Riverland Massage program, I can honestly tell you my entire Riverland journey was not wasted at all. It is an affordable school and well worth everything I invested in it. My professors were well educated and taught very well. When I was in student housing freshman year, the manager was very kind and even offered me a little side job and paid me with Kwik Trip gas cards! This was very much appreciated as it allowed me to visit home more often than I would have been able to otherwise. She also made pancakes for me one Saturday morning and was appreciative of my hard work.

The layout of the Riverland campus is well marked and flows nicely. The common areas are kept clean and the library is a great place to study. The location of Riverland is very convenient and close to downtown shopping and restaurants. There are student apartments available across from the East side parking lot. I've not been inside any of them but to offer private housing so close to the school is not something all colleges have the ability to do. I highly recommend Riverland to anyone thinking about attending here. Don't let the negative trolls on here keep you from a great school. The office staff and school counselors are very helpful and I encourage you to reach out to them with your career desires and they will help you carve the right pathway that leads to your degree.", "Had to stay at student housing for the summer.
Literally the worst place ever. Internet was so bad that I couldn't even stream Youtube at 240p. My roommate's car was sliced open at the parking lot. Every unit was infested with roaches, millipedes, spiders and you name it. Housing manager was not responsive on time. I would avoid staying at the student housing at all cost.", 'Very helpful and kind at the front desk. Great energy!! Very welcoming.', "Being a graduate from Riverland I strongly encourage teens to consider community college prior to a university.  Riverland's curriculum qualifies to transfer credits to most if not all universities with in the tri-state area; and at half the cost.  (Personally I transferred to UW Stout without any issue of rejected credits.)  No matter where you go, your first 2 years will be filled with English, math, and writing, so why not pay less?  Also a great opportunity for athletes to get an affordable education while still playing ball, and possibly go on to play at a higher level.", "Went here to see one of their Musicals, was really good! If you're into Theatre, I would recommend visiting this place when they have one set up."]

name: Northwest Technical College
reviews: ["Like most colleges and similar institutions, it's got it's good parts and bad. But all in all, I'm enjoying my time here.", 'Amazing staff and faculty! I have never felt more welcome and encouraged in an academic setting. I attended the nursing program and it was fantastic! But truly everyone I interacted with was incredible!', 'A school that teaches you business classes and then screws you over when your classes start to disappear and you get no explanation so they sweep it under the rug, then bill you for the books you returned to them because they misplaced them. You would have better luck using Udemy than going here. Pre-covid parking is a nightmare, post covid, more people park in the street than in their parking lots, because the fee they charge you is not cheap.', 'VETERANS BEWARE OF THIS SCHOOL> Terrible school. DO NOT GO HERE!!!!!! If you miss a payment they are super quick to send it to collections. The Only school that I have delt with in MN that does this. Its a horrible school the way they treat people. They just want your GIBill money and thats it. If I could give a lower rating I would.', 'The college has seen a lot of improvements in the last few years. They are way more focused on students now than before, lots of great instructors and smaller class sizes which is really nice.']

name: Bemidji State University
reviews:
["I graduated from BSU with a bachelors degree in Computer Science in 2024. It was very empty, lonely, and boring. Every day I'd walk through the tunnels seeing maybe 5 people total in the campus. There was basically nothing to do on the weekends unless you liked to fish or hunt. The professors were dispassionate and under-qualified. The only reason I went here was that BSU accepted 95% of my credits as listed on Transferology, where most other colleges wanted me to retake my credits from my associates degree.", 'Five years at BSC were fantastic. 1964-1969. The picture is me now in 2025 at a pizza place in Boulder, CO. Proto’s is the name.', 'A very nice campus situated on Lake Bemidji; the lake might double as a parking lot in the winter.

Low tuition for Minnesota residents with scholarships available based on academics. If you score well on the ACT and have good grades or a high class rank you likely will get scholarship money.

The friendly admissions staff is knowledgeable and provides individualized service.

Most of the campus is connected by underground tunnels which is great on a cold or wet day.', "It's a good school if you like winter. Also, there are tunnels connecting the school buildings if you don't want to deal with the snow.", 'BSU is located on Lake Bemidji, where students enjoy views of the lake and water fowl along with water.  Besides a beautiful campus, small class sizes and excellent professors offer students a better opportunity for success in their education.']

name: Bethany Lutheran College
reviews: ["My daughter is attending Bethany and everyone has been so wonderful.  She loves Bethany and the small class sizes.  I'm so glad we found out about the school when she attended a college fair. Thanks again!", 'Great campus all the people here welcome you and just in general this is a small but big campus', "Once upon a time I went to school here. I had an overwhelming positive experience. The college isn't without its flaws, but there are a lot of passionate people working here yet, and the campus is undeniably beautiful. Shout out to the art departments - they're truly doing amazing things in Mankato.", 'Bethany changed my entire life in such a positive manner. The small, tight-knit community allows for students to be involved in a variety of activities as well as getting to know many people. The small class sizes allow for a lot of one-one interaction with the professors and staff. The staff are very encouraging and push students to their best. Bethany values each student and will do whatever is needed to make the college experience the best for the student body.', "Small class sizes and great extracurriculars make personal attention from professors and staff easy to come by. Choir tours were a definite highlight for me! If you're the sort of person that likes a place where you can know lots of people personally and lots of people know you, Bethany is a great place to learn & live."]

name: Bethel University
reviews:
['What an amazing college! I attended Bethel through PSEO and had many great professors who genuinely challenged me to become a better student. I also really enjoyed the culture at Bethel working in the Dining Center as a server and getting to meet a lot of great people was a highlight of my experience.

Like anywhere, there were a couple of professors I didn’t love but who doesn’t have that experience? A few rarely showed up, which made it frustrating to drive all the way to campus only to get a last-minute email saying class was canceled or replaced with a simple “what did you do this weekend?” assignment. Overall, though, my experience was very positive.', '05/25/2013 was the day I graduated with a bachelor degree in Nursing and was my last day I set foot in this school!! I was very traumatized by discriminatory experiences I had to endure in order to finish! I was very lost and confused thinking to myself how can a Christian school treats me this way just because of my skin color? I felt less human and I was very miserable. I was very confused because I kept on thinking to myself about the teachings of JC that they will preach at the beginning of each lecture as if they were practicing them to everyone but were only to white students. Whites students were treated as human beings with all the compassion, kindness and empathy, professors were helping them pass classes by giving them questionnaires to practice during the summer if they  were having difficulties with nursing courses. Students like myself were treated like thieves, cheaters and they will put a lot of fear to intimidate you. Whenever you write a paper, they will always single out  papers only  from POC students and look for words that are similar and call on us for plagiarism and give us 0, it was terrible! There were 84 nursing students I believe and only 5 or 6 black students, the remaining were whites so it was easier for them to pick on our papers to look for similar words and call on us for plagiarism! We were treated with no compassion, no empathy whatsoever. These experiences really had a negative impact on my mental health and whenever I try to relive  what I went through in this school I get very anxious as if I was having a panic attack. There was a lot of fear going to Bethel as POC, the  nursing department back in 2013 were 99% white females, and if you are a Poc female, it was a danger zone to be! Going to this school was the WORST experience of my life!!', 'I remember walking through the halls of Bethel University saying “I could live here”. Beautiful scenery, great food! Oh! The food!, quality of education is 🌎 class, they take sports 🥎 seriously 🙌🏽, hostels are homely and the environment is clean. I am not an academic person but if I got a scholarship to Bethel, I would be the most enthusiastic academic individual you’ve ever seen 😂.', "My daughter's academic experience at Bethel is becoming a mess. From the day she set foot on campus, she intended to major in Molecular Biology and Minor in computer science. However, there have been budget cuts and the departments are bare bones. Upper level bio courses have a single section offered once a year or every other year, and this semester, the 4 classes she needed were offered all in the same 2 class periods. She can't even take any classes towards her comp Sci minor because they completely changed the catalog and that obsoleted one of the classes she had already taken and created new class that's a prerequisite for every other comp Sci class she needs, but it isn't even offered in spring. So she's stuck!  This semester she is paying full tuition to take 3 classes because her general Eds are fulfilled and she literally can not find a single class to take that would help her progress toward graduation.
It's been stressful and frustrating, and I wouldn't wish this on any young student...so I'm posting here to try and warn you so you don't make the same mistake.
The campus is nice. The food is good. The professors are great.  But if you can't get a degree, what's the point?", 'Beautiful campus, friendly greeters modern facilities quality every where you look.']

name: Central Lakes College-Brainerd
reviews:
['Not exactly the most optimal college in Minnesota. Staff isn't effective in problem-solving abilities, as well as directory. You're treated as a customer in a business rather than a student attaining an education.

Staff are quite condescending to students, and still treat students like children regardless of competence and representation. This is also because most students in class are of high school age, and maturity is far and few. "Professors" claim students write papers with Artificial Intelligence with zero supporting evidence. If work is exceptional; good luck with your appeal. Don't try too hard... you may get a zero.

Thousands of dollars of invoices, with little evidence supporting the claimed amounts. You're better off actually going to a university to attain a real education, than this cookie-cutter facility.', 'Visited the Chalberg Theatre to see the show "The Cottage".  Very funny!!', 'Great environment for learning for people from all cultural backgrounds. Instructors are welcoming. Teaching style is great. People here don’t see your color. I love ,love this school and the staff. Academic and non-academic staff are doing a good job. They take their time to assist you in every way possible. The food shelf is fantastic. You can’t be hungry if you are in the school building. I can go on and on. Most importantly, the nursing program. For anyone looking for a 2yrs nursing program. This is the school. The teaching style, how the topics are placed in each semesters help you connect all the dots. They use all the learning style to get their students on the right track (bingo games,flash cards , who am I game,audio ppts, one on one with the instructors, review before test. Great program.
I am proud to be a student here and will definitely miss this school after May 15th .
God bless Central lakes College!', "I went here im 2105 as part of the PSEO program.  I was bullied my ethics professor and when I went to the advisor and guidance counselor they basically said I was lying because I thought I'd get a bad grade ( I got a B plus my whole time though thr class) the advisor was beyond rude and I even tried to show her proof that my professor was bullying me and she didn't care to hear one word. I didn't feel she truly cared at all qnd just wanted me to leave her office. I only went one year because of this experience.  If you want a school that cares about its students and doesn't allow bullying find a different school!", 'The is one of the best college located in a small beautiful community of Brainerd. The faculty and staff is very caring and fun loving. If you are a foreigner and living in MN especially studying in this college, you feel honored guest of whole community. A college worth for studying and a community worth living.']

name: Carleton College
reviews: ['Pretty generic liberal arts undergrad school. Science and art programs are top notch. The campus itself could really use some work, aging structures and safety hazards are littered across the campus. Parking is limited and the easiest way to navigate campus is by foot, on a bicycle or a scooter. Upper management is sub par; Carleton would benefit from fresh faces with new ideas to bring the campus into the 21st century. The buildings are kept neat and tidy and the food service is pretty good but a lot of their equipment looks like it could be replaced. Tuition is expensive, even for a private LAC.', "Beautiful campus and location. Plus there is the arboretum for outdoor activities. Definitely one of the most bucolic campuses you'll come across. And the academics are among the best in the country. Kind of wish I knew about places like this when I was a student.", 'Recreation Center was a nice facility for youth basketball', '_|_|.|Number of Macaws sponsoring the highway by Olaf|8|The year Schiller was dangled from a helicopter devided by 1962|Pedestrian Zone by Goodhue ___ MPH|five minus the  number of times the Dayman shoots the troll in the IASIP (content warning, its a messed up show)|5|\n\n|-|9|3|.|1|3|Number of letters in the name for the place which used to be “a receptor of rubbish, tin cans, junk, and last year’s hats” (Headley and Jarchow 1966, 36)|0|Number of UFOs seen flying in a train formation in Northfield MN on May 20th, 1991|The number in the name of the group that organized the Great Schiller Exchange minus 81|', "I don't about the college but trying to work with Kari Scheurer, in their office, was a great disappointment. Nothing is possible, won't even try, does not seem to care."]

name: Concordia College at Moorhead
reviews: ['I am a 2003 graduate. I loved my experience and highly recommend it. I was a biology major and got into dental school right after graduation. The professors in the science department were top notch!', 'Would give 0 stars if I could.\nWould not recommend this place! The professors push leftist ideologies down your throat and if you actively disagree with them they publicly humiliate you in front of the entire class. The entire college pushed for leftist ideologies and do not take into account for the right wing students on campus.', "As a former student it's a great college. The campus is very homely feeling and is catered to the undergrad experience. There is always events and speakers to attend. The music recitals are also a lot of fun. The classes outside freshmen year were normally no larger then about 20 people. The professors and staff in general were always very accommodating. The gym and pool are really nice if you go here. The dinning hall has good food, but can be a bit expensive even with meal plans.", "Forget this scam of a disgusting university. I have asked for help and for things.Time after time.Have been blown off and disrespected numerous times. I left this place and I would advise for anybody to really take a step back and think about going to this college because they are just very low quality at what they do. The staff don't do their jobs right. You can hardly get any help or any tutoring and then I had asked for things numerous times and kept receiving the wrong information , even though it was a bold faced lie.", 'Class of 2008. I cherish my time at Concordia. We made friends for life and the athletic and academic quality is exceptional for such a small college. The cobber community punches above its weight class. Great school!']

name: Concordia University-Saint Paul
reviews: ['I did one semester here. The counselors and financial office are no help. I felt like I was reaching out and it was a burden for them to respond with something useful. When in need of help it was so stressful not being able to ask questions. The professors are amazing though!', 'Picked up my school grades process was easy.', "I loved watching the girls LaCrosse game and I felt very safe (covid wise). I went to watch my niece's daughters team (Makenzie Jenner's) team play and enjoyed the experience.", 'Great space and great game!', 'They made me take two more upper class elective courses right before graduation because of the new director of education and would not grandfather me in. Unfortunately more time and money but otherwise it’s a decent school to attend.']

name: Dakota County Technical College
reviews: ['My girlfriend goes here for the nursing program. I have so many good things to say about their programs and I think this kind of schooling will be the way of the future.', 'Modern, clean, nice classrooms. Nice venue for business conferences.', "I just wrapped up my first year and am halfway done with my associates degree in software development. I can say that especially if you are wanting to pursue education in an IT related department, this is an amazing school to start! All of the tech teachers (Betty, Rocky, Scott, Jeff, ect.) have been amazing professors. Very intelligent and know what they are teaching about! If you TRY, they will help you succeed! You can tell that they truly care about their students and their success, and so do many of the other staff I've worked with at this school! The school is smaller which makes it a lot less overwhelming if you're like me and dread the idea of huge lecture rooms... my classes typically had around 15-25 people which made it easier to ask questions and understand content better. They also have the trio program which can be helpful for those with learning disabilities, and a school therapist available as well. It's summer now and i can honestly say I MISS MY CLASSES! Excited to be back in the fall :)", 'Poor communication.  I had questions about admissions, left several voicemails and never got a response.  Today I have been trying to contact the business office all day about an issue with my 3rd party payment and all I get is a generic voicemail saying "no is available to take your call".  I am not on campus because I am doing an online program and live an hour away.  Now I will have to drive down there and see if I can talk to an actual person.', 'This school has been a godsend over the past 7 months. Genuine teachers that make the classes engaging, nice environment, and great culture. Support to students has been incredible for me so far. Being current military, it was tough to find a school that would transfer my CCAF credits that I earned while in tech school. DCTC made things silky smooth when transferring them over. Do not hesitate to check this place out.']

name: Martin Luther College
reviews:
['It has been an exquisite afternoon.  My friend and I went to Martin Luther College to watch the production of Alice in Wonderland.  The experience fueled my desire to return for the next theatrical performance.

The actors/actresses were amazing (loved the turtle and the Queen of hearts).  The team really knew how to engage the audience and keep us at the edge of our seats!  The auditorium was very spacious with comfortable seating.  Best part……the cost of admission was only $3.

If you visit New Ulm, be sure to take a small detour to MLK.  The school is known for a value priced and delicious lunch/dinner buffet that is open to the public.  It’s a petite campus across from the famous Herman the German Park.  A beautiful setting for an afternoon stroll.', "Wonderful school! It's an amazing community of caring people and there is a lot of attention going toward campus improvements too. Don't miss the disc golf course!", 'Had a blast MLC…
Ted Thank you for the respect and love that is shown to my family continually! We appreciate it…', "Great college to educate our future WELS Pastors, Teachers and Missionaries! Just hope the WELS doesn't burn them out years down the road. Anyway, I LOVED competing-in/watching the yearly grade school basketball tournament in their awesome gym! I will return soon one day for another visit. God Bless!", "I attended this college and graduated in 2008. I was given many opportunities to travel abroad and work before graduation. The school and professors are truly God-fearing and amazing. Just don't let them know you attended public school your whole life! :) Great school...but call system is flawed."]

name: Lake Superior College
reviews: ['The buildings look good, most of them are connected.  Everything seems to be handicapped accessible.  The cafe seems to have decent prices and my son seems to enjoy attending the school.', "I managed to take my physics class here since rumor had it that the Nun who taught physics at St Scholastica was a very harsh professor who rarely gave out Bs or As to students. So I took physics here and had a professor from India who didn't speak the best English but her TA was really helpful and awesome.", 'I came up here to tour the college and I must say this is such a beautiful campus. The drive up here is amazing especially if you take the scenic route. You can see the entire city  Lake Superior is stunning from this view.', "As of Sep 1 2025 the campus will no longer have professional security on campus.  More budget cuts that can't be blamed on the federal administration but on the LSC administration and board of governors for mismanagement of funds and personnel.  Long term staff being dismissed after years of service with not so much as a 'word'.  Legitimate lawsuits covered up by shady back room politics and bureaucracy.  Protect yourself and use that device in your pocket for something other than mindless socializing...", 'I had the outstanding opportunity to tour Lake Superior College on September 1st 2021. The staff were very friendly, and the student that joined in on the tour was friendly as well. It was a really great campus tour, and I enjoyed every second of it. there are great class options, and also great club options! At the end of the tour, they offered me a snack and a soda! It was an awesome experience.']

name: Minnesota State Community and Technical College
reviews: ["Went to nursing school here a few years ago. The nursing instructors were on a power trip the whole time. Barely learned much from them, ATI was my teacher. Don't recommend this nursing program, especially if diane is still there. Go to the Detroit Lakes campus, all the students I talked to there loved their program and instructors.", 'Worst school to ever go. I regretted  ever choosing that school for nursing. I do not know what other departments  are like. Please do not do your nursing in this school. There are highly discriminatory.  This instructor  (Diane) in the nursing department chooses students she likes and shows a clear line between  those she dislikes for no reason. She and Sue create fear and anxiety for students  during clinical  and do all they can to fail those they dislike. Please black nursing students, do not do your nursing in this institution.  They will frustrate and finally fail you. A Word to the wise is sufficient.', 'I studied nursing and anatomy until 2016!\nTo this day I am personally  still  thankful for good teachers like Mathew Borcherding.\nOpen minded living medical studies and practice ! - Jacob G', "Terrible school! The teachers are not that good! You could honestly get an better education somewhere else like at Central Lakes College which isn't too far away! Plus if you have an problem the staff like hang up on you! They literally need to get their act together! I don't even know how they are still running!", 'the first time i went to m state college was ok but there security is really strick like when i took  a world history test in a quite room in the library , to my surprise there were like four cameras in there , plus when i took my note book out , to use it for a test the, school staff got mad and i failed my test, so i quite goin to m state  after that , cause i didnt think it was fare cause , in high school we had no problem using notes for our test.']

name: Minnesota West Community and Technical College
reviews:
['Bookstaff are EXTREMELY rude!!!!!
They will try to hold back your supplies for classes until “you actually need them” even AFTER you have paid and AFTER the semester has started. Mine were kept for almost two weeks before I was able to get everything. Had to stand around arguing for 10+ minutes trying to get the books & supplies I paid multiple hundreds of dollars for while the older lady there insisted she did not think I “actually” needed them yet.
Trying to buy a book, pick up a rental, or return a rental is all met with incredible hostility and if you don’t know how to rent or buy a book DO NOT GO HERE FOR HELP. You are better off finding another student to help you. She is very rude and will be passive aggressive with you (sighing, walking away mid conversation, rolling eyes) every interaction. Been going here for 3 years and it only gets worse. Honestly think she should be transferred, fired, or at least reprimanded in some way.
They also like to accuse students of late rentals and wont back down even after concrete evidence of the rental being returned. Honestly unbelievable that the campus allows this to continue to happen.', "Poor staff/program- 1/3 of class was spent playing pool or making kahoots. You'd have better luck learning what they have to teach on YouTube. Staff aren't very helpful other then 1 or 2 of the administration lady's. For the most part the rate of teaching was just to slow. I felt like I wasted my money. They give you a ton of free food the first week to get you to ignore the thousands you are giving them for next to nothing.                     I went to the pipestone campus", 'I went there August 2016-December 2017. The general classes are good, but if you want to go into the nursing program, prepare to not have any help, no homework to prepare you for the exams you have to average 80% on, and feeling stupid when asking questions. The 17-18 nursing program started with over 160 students and now has less than 50 that were able to move on. The program is the same throughout all of Mnwest. It was a waste of my time and tuition.', 'Great people only slight problem is I am 36 years old and of course not computer smart lol so been a slow/bad start due to communication so praying for a great finish! Thanks Beth and Salome! You both helped me understand and filed in the gaps. Thanks again. Off to my road to success!', 'Baseball field parking at Minnesota West is super inconvenient....for students only, even for evening games.']

name: Gustavus Adolphus College
reviews: ['For what I understand students pay for tuition at this College, the dormitories have never been updated and no A/C in summer- they really suck!  They are the type of dorms I remember from nearly four decades ago- the institutionalized look and feel. Campus buildings not so impressive.  Grounds are kept up nice.', 'We attended Christiin Christ Chapel, which was very good! Awesome orchestral and vocal music! We were seated way in the back but could still see and hear quite well. It was pretty chilly, however. Alas, it is Winter! Highly recommend this Christmas Concert!', "This campus is awesome! I am very pleased with my daughter's choice to continue her education here.", 'Beautiful blossom bloom around May 15th', 'Great college! It has been an excellent experience for my daughter She has had wonderful professors who have time for their students to help with finding career-building opportunities, answer questions and counsel on academic pathways. There are lots of opportunities to get involved on campus.']

name: Hamline University
reviews: ['Amazing Campus', 'Nice campus... Didn\'t like the fact they were trying to push a critical race theory book in orientation also pushing the use of pronouns. dorm rooms are very small the one dorm building we took a tour of did not have AC. Also not in the best neighborhood. Seems like they\'re trying to push a "woke "agenda.. needless to say after the $400 deposit  they require and spending about $700 to come down 9 hour drive for my son to sign up and attend the school....they changed our mind and we won\'t let our son attend. Save your time and go to a state college or tech', 'Hamline was cool. My wife conducted a seminar there and it is a really nice facility. Her company ordered too much food so we gave the box lunches that were left to a few kids and the campus police. All were really nice and again the facility was pretty cool.', "A great school if you are going into the education field. All of my professors have been excellent. Very nicely kept campus and facilities. Location is good. Close to restaurants and shops. Downsides are the price (it is a private school) and the fact there have been more than a few crimes that have happened on campus since I've been there, such as robberies later at night.", 'I attended Hamline online but came last year for my graduation ceremony. I had an excellent experience as I found my teachers to be really invested in me and my learning. They were passionate about the subjects they were teaching.']

name: Hennepin Technical College
reviews:
['Unfortunately, my experience was not satisfactory. The support I received was limited to being given general links and being told to search for jobs and upload applications on my own. I did not receive hands-on guidance or meaningful follow-up.
At the time of enrollment, I was told that I would receive help with job placement and support after completing the program. However, after I finished and earned my certificate, I felt passed from one person to another without clear assistance. I specifically asked for help with applying for jobs and was told I would be contacted, but I never received a call or email.
Overall, I did not feel supported in the job search process as promised, and this was disappointing after completing my program at Hennepin Technical College.', 'If you want to feel completely unsupported, have an advisor who doesn’t even reach out to you, and be bullied for mental health accommodations; then this is the college for you!', 'We had the opportunity to attend a five course meal event prepared by my son. Great opportunity for students to showcase their talents.', 'I am an alumni that visited the welding departmentband and was extremely disappointed in the quality of the shop and the professionalism of the staff.   The shop looked like a junkyard and when I asked instructor Chris H a question about different types of welding shops he went into this political rant about his beliefs
I WOULD NOT RECOMMEND THIS SCHOOL.
Instructors have become to political to be effective educators.', 'Decent school but tough naborhood, dirty inside and outside, and unsafe for your vehicle.']

name: Minnesota North College
reviews:
["I don't go to school there but I try to get there every Wednesday during the school year for Burger Day! High quality lunch for a great price.", "Definitely not a good community college for ambitious students. The admissions staff are pretty oblivious to the needs of the students and is too focused on themselves. They also like offering classes that are flawed. There are some nice staff but I recommend looking for any other college. One class I was in we had spent most of the semester talking about random stuff not related to our curriculum. The material is pretty simple too. It is unfortunate students don't learn this until it's too late. This college will set you up for failure and that is unfortunate.", 'Idk where to begin with this school!! The admission staff are really rude, the Trio program is trash!! Let not talk about the nursing program. I love Mary, she is a great professor with a Doctorate degree and just the best professor ever !! Be cautious of Christina Liesmaki, horrible professor and is very unprofessional roles her eyes when student ask her questions in class. They say they have a high standard for their nursing student yet they are unprofessional themselves!! Everything about this school is absolutely money wasted!!', 'As a returning student after 2 years of academic failure, my goal was to uproot the issues this college has, from within the Student Senate.

I’m unfortunately quite disappointed to see that many faculty members have retired, or up and quit and that many have given up on what needs fixing.

After a 2 year renovation and now the MN North merger, the focus is most definitely not on the students when it should be.

Hibbing as a town has a distasteful attitude towards newcomers, BIPOC, LGBT folk, And other minorities.

When interacting with the vast majority of college staff, their willingness to help or provide additional support is determined by who your family is or by your surname.

For any prospective students: get involved with senate and do your best to make this place better. Without the student input and engagement, it is impossible to modify some of these unfair practices, behaviors, and attitudes. I will do everything in my power before I graduate to get the teachers/staff/admin to do their jobs correctly, ethically, and to shift the focus back onto “student life” and how to draw in people to this small town college while being inclusive, diverse, and equitable.', "I went to the Dental Clinic in the college. It's a nice place to get your teeth taken care of. Meeting the students is always a pleasure."]

name: Inver Hills Community College
reviews:
["I liked attending this school that was suggested to me by my sister, Carla Gondreau, who doesn't talk to me any longer. She is very angry about several things that occurred over 33 years ago because I didn't attend my father's funeral or lakeside service because I was too poor and unemployed and didn't own my own home nor was I married with children.", 'Extremely difficult to work with . Specifically the financial aid offfice . There’s one guy who always answers the phone . Extremely rude , and gets an attitude when you ask anything . Even denies me when I ask to speak to someone else . My loans were disbursed on Monday . Still not in my account .  The school isn’t giving me any information whatsoever .', 'This my second time attending Inver Hills Community College. The staff and Instructors are friendly, attentive, and helpful. The campus is beautiful and easy to navigate. Lots of student activities and groups to get plugged into. Most importantly, tuition is affordable. Highly recommend IHCC for your college career.', 'This school is great! Classes are refreshing, professors are amazing! Would certainly recommend this school for anyone not sure what they want to go to school for quite yet, or really anyone looking to get a quality education for a third of the price!
EDIT 3/18 - I had some questions regarding classes for the summer and fall semester, gave them a call and they were able to answer all of them promptly and efficiently. Thank you!! (Amy was the gal that helped me, very sweet and helpful)', 'I should have trusted my gut about this school.  It started when I requested information about my program and didn’t get a response.  Then I tried to email an instructor from the program with questions.  Still no response.

I am allergic to a vaccine they required for the program i enrolled in.  I asked about medical exemptions and they didn’t respond to that email.  I was told to get the vaccine or drop out. I asked again about medical exemptions and still no response.  When I said I would drop they responded to my email in about 10 minutes.

I am not an anti vaxxer.  I have all of the other required vaccines.  This was a poor decision on their part. I was paying for everything up front with no loans or financial aid.']

name: Macalester College
reviews: ["My husband's college. He did his undergrad in math and economics in 1992. A gorgeous college in an stunning neighborhood. He walked around just before the sunset as he was sharing with me all his priceless memories.", 'I went here for MITY, Expand Your Mind 2022! The campus is truly beautiful, friendly staff, great facilities, tasty food. Great college.\n-August Gregerson, Session B', "Best college ever, in my opinion! The way the staff thrives to know students beyond their academic performance is legendary! They don't just say it, they apply it. I am fortunate my daughter is a student at Macalester College. 💃", 'Excellent turf field.  Very clean.', "I can't even articulate how wonderful my 4 years at this college were"]

name: South Central College
reviews:
['A graduation rate of less than 30%...? If that is true (see their website) then this is a very poor school. This is a community college in small town Minnesota, not some elite school with complicated and advanced courses of study. They should be able to do better than a 7 in 10 drop out/non-graduation/transfer to another (better) school. A graduation rate that low (less than 3 in 10) indicates the school is not even trying. If I were a student, I would find a school that can provide a higher grad rate than their drop out rate (currently at more than 70% or 7 of 10 students who enter their programs). This low graduation rate most likely is because students left to attend a better school prior to completing their relatively poor course of study at this school. It is tough to find a school with a lower grad rate or higher drop-out rate. I am very surprised at those numbers they reported as I post this message.  Wow...but at least they are cheap, right? You get what you pay for, in this case a cheap education if you stick around to graduate when most leave.', "I am extremely glad that I'm almost finished. Before this last semester everything went fine, but then I was told that i was taking too many credits and that they would only give me enough money for 11/14 credits I was told I needed.

3 classes! That's how many classes I was told I needed, then was told yesterday that I didn't need. I am extremely upset with them. The lady I talked to about this was not helpful, rude, and never fully answered my questions. They are money hungry. I met with two different advisers to create a schedule and made sure that they knew which classes I was taking so that nothing would get messed up, unfortunately, they still managed to mess it up. Now I owe hundreds of dollars for a class I actually need, while they paid for a class I didn't need/want. Tech colleges are nice, but there are a lot of people who will say that they will not tell you certain information so that they can get more money.

The teachers are great (the ones that I've had). They are really helpful and understanding.", 'Went to the website made an appointment and within a day or two they got back to me. I talked with Rhonda wake about their automotive program that I am very interested in and he was the most helpful ever. He went above and beyond to help me with all my questions and concerns about their school. I feel at peace and will be making another appointment for a tour of the school. I hope that I can join and become a student at South Central College. 👨‍🔧🧰⚙️', 'First, I want to start this by saying I already had a Bachelors Degree and a Masters Degree when I enrolled at SCC.
There are to many positives to list without turning this into a novel. The instructors are some of the nicest and helpful people I have ever met. The knowledge, and commitment to helping students succeed is top notch.
If there is one thing I like the most it is the programs willingness to get students placed in good quality careers. This school literally changed my life. This is hands down my most valuable degree.', 'I would highly recommend NOT going here! I had help signing up for my classes by advisors, only to find out that they were not covered by financial aide! Then i tried to appeal and drop my classes since they were the ones that helped me enroll for the coursrs and was told they lost my appeal! Tried setting up a payment plan and was not responded back to! I would rate them ZERO stars if possible!']

name: Minnesota State University-Mankato
reviews:
["If I could give this college along with their partnered flight school  north star aviation zero stars I would. No care for students. They rake money out of you any chance they get. Dishonest CFIs (majority see you as a time builder), this flight school was said to have been recently audited, no transparency in grading, scheduling and costs. High turn over rate in students. CFIs are recent graduates that have no real world flight training experience in actually training. Just because you take a CFI course it doesn't mean you can actually teach skills. CFIs mostly memorize the books and do not provide resources and skills needed to be successful.

The university does not back you up and when they time comes to them doing anything, the flight staff treats you differently. They retaliate.

There is an assistant instructor or professor at the university that hates when students are late and will go on a tangent about why it is important to be on time but he would never let students leave on time either. The Irony. He also refused to let students step out for water or use the bathroom during the 1.5 hour class. He later brought politics into the classroom and made remarks that he retires in a couple of years so he didn't care.

Staff at the airport are useless. They don't follow their own policies and no one knows how to do anything. Half the staff are students.

A lot of international students. Many state resident students left after their first semester.

Save your money and time. Run and fly somewhere else.", 'This post is regarding our son who attended Mn St. University Mankato. He made a life decision to continue his further education at University of Madison who offered the courses aligning with his field. We had plenty of time to plan his exit strategy as he was first year living in the dorms, i called to specifically get the final payment amount due to include room and meal plan. They informed me our son is notifying them in the window allowed meaning no additional tuition was due, i then specifically called the dorm/meal office and requested any amounts due for room and board. Again they stated everything was paid and he needed to have his dorm cleared by a certain date which we complied with, (he was coming off the holiday break) well over a year later i get a letter from Mn Dept of Revenue trying to collect a balance? My son and i immediately called the University and literally got played between the 2 offices, the first is student assistance with class enrollment- the second deals with dorm and meal service. We were told the student service side office was so short handed they were unable to send notifications of this sort for almost a year and were just doing so. When we were informed the small balance was for room and board we were transferred to this office, evening thou they know he was no longer on campus with dorm emptied they billed him for 1 final week to include meals. They need full accountability for their lack of communication between the 2 offices, they made it extremely clear their computer systems are not set-up to notify each other what takes place with students. Again we called both offices when we knew he was moving on, this is a learning lesson for my Son that even a University can be broken with its processes! shame on them.', 'Linda (Student Advising Director) is the best ever and she will actually go out of her way to help you. These stars are because of her, not the school.', "MSU Mankato is a terrible University that showed no respect towards my time and money. I originally started as an Aviation Major only for this university to force me into a different degree that was a complete scam. When I lived on-campus for a semester, I was told within the end of the semester that I had to move out and had no other choice because they had limited space and wanted to bring in new students. Hello? I am a new student here! Most professors in the uni. are sub-par in their teaching ability and only here to work their job and not teach. There was a professor in the aviation dept. that ranted more about politics than to teach the class itself. We are forced to take his class because of the program requirement. This is a waste of money! The aviation program is also a waste of money because you are paying far more than you would to a flight training center. Not only you're paying Northstar Aviation their share, you also have to pay the university their royalties. This school is party school and a high school at the same time, only difference is you're being defrauded. There is absolute no integrity nor respect at all and lack of professionalism at this university. The dorms are overpriced, disgusting, old, rundown, and make your skin crawl because of the amount of filth, human slime, and mold that ended up giving me health complications and multiple visits to the hospital. Every roommate I've lived with never flushed, cleaned up after themselves, and expected someone else to look after them as if they were living with their parents. Any complaint I've sent to Reslife went unnoticed and they simply don't care. This University mismanages and wastefully spends the students money on things that it baffles my mind how they didn't grab the attention of the federal government for waste, fraud, and abuse. Don't attend this university! With the 18% tuition hike they're going to implement soon. Your money and time is spent better elsewhere. You will not get a quality education.", 'Wish I could give zero stars. Worst college In Minnesota. No care for there students and they make it terribly difficult to get resources for help.']

name: Metropolitan State University
reviews: ['SHAME ON METRO STATE. Specifically the College of Nursing and Health Sciences, which refuses to offer online learning to accommodate students who fear for their lives during the ongoing metro ICE surge. To be clear, the infrastructure from COVID still exists and remains an option for pregnant students. Metropolitan State University\'s mission statement is: "Metro State University empowers learners to transform their lives and communities through relevant, student-centered education in an inclusive, anti-racist, and supportive learning environment." I beg to differ. Now, more than ever, Metro State, it is time to walk the walk.', 'Honestly an amazing school. I love this school, it has been so beneficial to my life and my families life.', 'Unhelpful staff. Ive requested 1 on 1 help with financial aid on multiple occasions without success.', 'Great school! In my anecdotal experience the teachers were respectful and considerate of me as a working adult. Lots of night classes', 'Great school. Very welcoming and a great community.']

name: University of Minnesota-Twin Cities
reviews:
['The practice fields are just okay. Parking is horrible just need to make sure you give yourself time to get there to park. For indoor soccer the fields are smaller but wide, and the goals are very small. Good to work on your low shots. I gave 3 stars due to parking.', "I went to the University of Minnesota as well as many of my family members. It's a great place to get an education. However, because it's so big and they have so many commuting students, one really has to take an effort to get involved in activities that you like and get to know people, don't just go to classes. The University of Minnesota is a great research university including research in medicine, as well as many other fields. Many great things have been developed there through the years, also many breakthroughs in science and other areas. Also, it's a great place to attend sporting events. Don't just go to the major ones like football, basketball, hockey and volleyball. Check out the other lesser-known events. There are many good sports to see, many great sports venues. A challenge that the University has is a lack of space. Because it's in the middle of a big city, it's hard to expand when they need more space. The St. Paul campus has many other areas of study that they don't have at the Minneapolis campus, such as veterinary science. Also, there are other branches of the University, such as Duluth and Morris. There are options if you want a University education, but want it  in a smaller city.", 'I have been attending the UofM Dentistry for a number of years,
For a couple reasons. 1. To save money on expensive procedures,  and 2. To help students learn on real people.
I have had a couple bad experiences. But all in all it has been good and had many opportunities to help guide young people on their paths of their future careers with integrity and self assurance.
You generally have more appointments but save hundreds or thousands of dollars 💸.
I highly recommend this opportunity.', 'Beautiful campus good mix of old and new buildings. Coffman is amazing. Student paintings on the Washington Ave Bridge make campus more beautiful ! Uplifting universal message !', 'Nice campus. Plenty of public transit options, but limited parking for personal vehicles. Bike racks abound. Several diverse and lower cost eating options in higher traffic areas.']

name: University of Minnesota-Crookston
reviews: ['Absolutely immaculate and beautiful campus. People are awesome!', 'the perfect university for students who start to study in US. You can get both best care and reputation of University of Minnesota.', 'We had a great move in day and feel very good about his decision to attend Crookston.', 'We had a wonderful time at the Alumni Baseball game!  Thank you UMC!', 'Had the best time while attending camp there']

name: Minneapolis College of Art and Design
reviews: ['I attended the Pre-College Summer Session in 2017 here at MCAD and I love every minute of it. The campus is perfect for all of our needs. The Art Cellar here is top notch and have everything from paints to pens to paper. Anything an art student would need at an affordable price. The Service Bearau here is also very good. The people there are super helpful in assisting me with my final project. The College Center here has a ping pong table as well a pool table & arcade machine. The campus is also very close to Nicollet Ave. so there is easy access to a bunch of restaurants and cafes.', 'I\'ve had the opportunity to visit museums the world over. MIA has a couple of things going for it: a superb collection of interesting portraiture and landscapes by early American artists, and a really superb collection of Chinese porcelain and tapastries -- some of it quite ancient, beautiful, and in superb condition. The building is big, but not overwhelming -- you can see everything comfortably in an afternoon and not wear yourself out doing so. HINT: The Gift Shop is a great place to purchase Christmas and high end "special someone" gifts. And it\'s free!!!', "A great place to see amazing work from unknown, little known, and well known artists. Also a great place to take adult continuing education classes in any visual arts discipline you could imagine, including things like furniture design and grant writing. Their instructors are second to none. Classes are a little spendy but well worth the money. It's safe to say that if you take a continuing education class here you will get significantly more than you pay for.", "As other institutions slowly climb out of the pandemic, this one took a hit its going to flourish from. The very tactile in-person classes, the awesome professors, and the wonderful atmosphere make this a great college. If it goes back to online its line two stars, most of the classes literally don't work online.", 'The campus; the studios, the faculty, the students, the Art, are all first rate!  And then the is the location.  Adjacent to the Minneapolis institute of Art or MIA which is a wonderful art museum, right down down the street from the Walker Art Center which is an excellent contemporary Art Museum/resource complete with the late great Siah Armajani’s fantastic poetry bridge that takes one over and or back from the lovely Lorring Park where there is much to see and do.']

name: Minneapolis Community and Technical College
reviews:
["This review is only for the weight room. The music is horrible. I don't want to listen to jazz music when I'm working out. The attendant on duty said they don't have access to the music... I doubt that.

The equipment is a bit old but usable and has a good variety. It's missing some machines like leg extension and some specialized benches. But overall a good selection for a free-for-students gym and convenient if you're already on campus.", 'I took the advice of my nieces, the directors of The Family Partnership Organization, & Most of  it was rewarding to Myself thinking I was never this smart.
Funny this I got a G.E.D. when I was 17 yrs, I enrolled in MCTC College after passing the college entry level testing that you must take &  pass all the requirements.', "I think Minneapolis College is the place to go if you want a quality Two-Year degree, and its a great starting point if you have plans to pursue a four year program in the future, this college will prepare you for what to expect before you move on to get that Bachelors degree. With lots of  programs to get involved in, there is something for everyone here, and friendly staff will make getting signed up a breeze! Stop by campus, located right on the edge of downtown Minneapolis (across the street from the Basilica of St. Mary's) @ 1501 Hennepin Ave. S.", 'Freshman student loving my classes and the resources the school provides for a n independent parent like myself and so many student clubs to join!', "If you have a learning disability, you will not get the help you need at this college. The Welding instructor by the name Todd Bridigum, had no interest or patients in helping disabled students. He seamed to discriminate disabled students. He would just sit in his office and eat candy. MCTC I have reached out countless times to the special needs department. As far as I'm concerned you have incompetent staff in that department. The Trade Class professors discriminate against disabled students. I am not an idiot, I may be learning disabled. You care more about money, than the students."]

name: Herzing University-Minneapolis
reviews:
['My nursing journey at Herzing University has been nothing short of transformational. From the very beginning, I was met with a learning environment that was supportive, structured, and deeply invested in my success not just as a student, but as a future nurse.
The curriculum challenged me to think critically, grow clinically, and develop confidence in my skills. The instructors were knowledgeable, approachable, and genuinely cared about my progress. They encouraged resilience during difficult moments and celebrated every milestone along the way, reminding me that perseverance is just as important as knowledge in nursing.
