name: South Piedmont Community College
reviews:
['I’m extremely disappointed with South Piedmont Community College and how unprofessional they are. It takes forever to get someone on the phone, and when you finally do, the customer service is terrible, especially toward military veterans.

I called simply to get my unofficial transcripts, and because I haven’t attended in over a year, I was told I would have to pay just to access them. To be clear, I do not owe this school any money, and I have no past-due balance, dues, or debt with them at all. The only reason they gave me was that they wanted me to pay for official transcripts, even though I clearly stated I only needed my unofficial transcripts.

I’ve never experienced that before. I recently requested unofficial transcripts from another school I attended in Florida, and I hadn’t been there in over two years, they gave me my login information with no issue so I could view my transcript.

This school feels like it’s run by people who only care about money, not students, not education, and definitely not respect. You would think they would have more dignity and appreciation for people who served this country, but that’s clearly not the case.

To my fellow veterans and anyone who supports veterans: I do not recommend this school. They care more about taking your money than helping you succeed. (15JAN26)', 'We loved the Banquet Room at the Early College for our NAACP Freedom Fund Banquet.', 'I have been going to SPCC for a year this time having attended classes there in 2013. I have not had any negative experiences that were not addressed to my satisfaction. The administration are professional and friendly. The teaching staff are friendly and have helped me when I needed assistance. I look forward to seeing the new buildings finished and opened. Go Alligators!', "For a month, my son and I have been trying to reach out to someone about a particular program we're interested in. We've also went up to the school, received information about the person over the program where we left several messages and sent emails and we still haven't received a call back. My son went up there a 2nd time and was told to just apply to the school and apply for financial aid. I've never dealt with such unprofessionalism from a school. I see why some are leaving a bad review. If I could give 0 stars, I would. This school needs major reorganization and upgrade their communication skills.", "Before you buy something  call the company's customer service number and see how you're treated.  It will usually save you some heartache.  Same applies with this school.   If you can't get someone to answer any of the phones any time it let's you know what you're probably going to experience when you truly need help."]

name: Appalachian State University
reviews: ['I am a business owner in Boone. I grew up in Boone. I have been here for over 40 years. I have seen nothing from this college, but pure destruction of the land. There is nowhere for the locals to even find housing. You’re letting in so many students just to make money that you’re having to build an apartment complex out of a parking lot that used to be student parking. Simply because you don’t even have housing for teachers to come up here and live to teach the amount of students you’re letting in. You have incresed the acceptance rate tremendously and droped the gpa standards. You do not tell the students that they will not have housing after their first year. You do not tell the students about the parking or living problems. You have students living in hotels. Sleeping in lounges. You’re destroying our town. I will be going to every measure. I can even to the state of North Carolina to stop what is happening in our town. I highly recommend not sending your kids to this college anymore. I used to like upstate university. Their standard used to be great. Now all they care about is money.', 'Cool area, but post pandemic society and over engineered "learning software" means you\'ll be paying five grand a month in just tuition alone to sit in front of a computer 10 hours a day every day teaching yourself everything. Why even have a campus besides gyms and dining halls?', "This college doesn't ever tell the students how there is no housing up here, not for student or locals because they continue adding students and now are sleeping out of hotels. When you do find an apartment its 2500 rented 8 or 9 hundred a room individually so landlords can tax your parents. No parking, cars getting towed every day because of sanctioned parking and now they wanna add more to get the football team to a higher division,  dropped GPA to higher acceptance rate this place can't get teachers because no housing. Money, money, money.. Don't let them take yours next.", 'Relatively good school. App State is outgrowing Boone, and therefore has a parking and housing problem (App State is accepting more students than it should). That being said, App State is in a beautiful location and easy to navigate. The roads can be busy at times and the weather can be precarious, but once you live there, you get used to it.', 'The college has let in so many students this year and can’t even place them in proper housing. There are students living in hotels and hallways. There’s no parking for them to do anything. The parking lots that are here are being destroyed for apartments that are so over priced no student could afford to stay there. Dropping the GPA qualifications has been a horrible thing']

name: Asheville-Buncombe Technical Community College
reviews: ["I'm not too thrilled!  I took a pottery class and they didn't fire one of my pieces for no good reason, other than the person who was supposed to fire not paying attention.  I've e-mailed back and forth with 2-4 people and no one has gotten to the bottom of this to tell me when or IF my piece is actually even still there!!!!  And now, no one is responding to me!!!!\n\nAfter $170 for a class, this is just not right.  They were supposed to get in touch w/my teacher, Lucy, but she hasn't responded either.  This is such a bummer.  that was supposed to be a Christmas gift for a dear friend!  Never take another course there again!", 'Most frustrating and time wasting experience of my life, i go to schedule an advising appointment and the process is so painstaking and for some reason every single employee doesn’t know what they’re doing. They refuse to tell me where to go and what to do, and when i go to the college website (where they tell me to go) nothing works. I am so incredibly lost and no matter who i ask for help, nobody knows how.', 'I can’t even. Administration and policies are very very poor in comparison to other community colleges in NC. Maybe it’s average for western nc? Subpar staff it’s a train wreck there, the school’s money may go mostly towards making it pretty. It’s a pretty school I’ll say that. I wouldn’t go there for an education, trade certificate or anything though. Maybe if you’re doing the college culinary program or attending the on campus high school that would be fine.', "If streets were safer for alternative transportation, students wouldn't be left with only one option of driving to school!", 'Out of the 4 community colleges I have taken courses at, ABTech has been the worst by far. I have had the worst experience with advising/registration trying to get scheduled for the classes I want. Everyone I speak to just turns me in circles and no one seems to understand what to do in order to help me go where I need to go. They only give you 48 hours once classes start to switch them around if need be, but you need an advisor to approve before you can register for anything different, but you can’t get in to meet with an advisor till days after the deadline. I feel so defeated. I worked so hard to get the courage to return to school, just to not be able to take any courses this semester. Wasting my time and my financial aide. I would not recommend going here. 😓']

name: Barton College
reviews: ['There are not nearly enough directional signs at all to help a visitor to navigate their route or destination.  The chapel was absolutely beautiful once I found it with the help of a student.  Kudos to the Wilson PD for trying to assist me over the phone to find the chapel.', 'Just did a tour with my sister and niece. Very impressed with the grounds, and the young lady doing the tour. She knew all kinds of interesting facts about how and when the place was built. Some of the architects details and why the buildings are the way they are. This college seems very nice and I’m now looking at other things like sports events or ways to enjoy all this college has to offer the surrounding community.', 'quite literally in the hood, lots of people gotta walk around too cause its impoverish so theres people on campus at all hours. Really weird dichotomy. Im not even a student im just near, when someone told me this college was expensive I couldnt believe it based on the environment. If there education is good then whatever I guess but definitely get on google maps and look around if u wanna go here cause its kinda rough.', 'Wonderful College full of wonderful people!  I was very anxious about my oldest going to College but Barton has eased my fears w/their orientation.  They made us feel like family 💚 which is very important to me!  Many thanks to seniors Malcolm & Erica, they went above & beyond helping us while we were there.   Outstanding young adults!  Exactly the type of people I want around my daughter, who means the world to me.', "So far, I’ve very much enjoyed my experience here. That staff is fantastic and I haven’t had one unfriendly professor. However, I’m not sure why we’re forced to have the temperature of the dorms at 75 degrees and higher. Especially when you’re like me and have a serious heart condition. I find that sometimes the air conditioning works but it usually doesn't."]

name: Beaufort County Community College
reviews: ["Terrible place to go to school,awful faculty and constant problems with. Cengage and mind tap and professors both on and off campus losing grades or not receiving assignments because of the crappy Cengage Online Grading materials not working properly or never receiving submissions when they actually did. Very sorry I chose this place to finish up and complete my studies will definitely be looking for an alternative school after I graduate don't apply or take classes their wether it's online or face to face place has major faults and problems both digitally and on campus ::::::(((((((", 'This is a great place for firefighter classes. We took a heavy vehicle extrication class this weekend and the college did a great job hosting everyone and providing everything we needed.', 'Awful place to go to school almost as bad as Martin Communitty College, very cold unwelcoming staff and fauclty. The Contiueing Education is a Disaster  have taken two face to face Contiueing Education  Courses thier and they have done absolutley nothing job wise or helping me find a decent let alone a job in general. Your better off avoiding this place completly unless your desperate for college courses or near the end or trying to finish up a degree otherwise its a bad choice also was insulted by the finacial aide staff one time in the student services building checking on something. Better off attending elsewhere.', "Went for the NCRC test and couldn't be happier.\nMs. Latham the administrator was super helpful with not only getting through the testing and program but also working out getting a scholarship for the test. She was patient and kind, she made it a pleasant and peaceful environment. She also took time to commend me on my test scores. The testing was straightforward and relatively easy to understand. The other staff i interacted with were all very helpful and took time to offer help and direction. I would highly recommend BCCC for any program or class available. I hope to continue my education with them in the future.", 'I was so nervous coming in to get ready for the CRC test. Being “older” and walking in a “college” is intimidating. I’m so glad I went for it. Deborah Latham made me feel so relaxed and comfortable. She is so professional, kind, caring, attentive, and most of all, so positive and encouraging! Anyone who comes in contact with her is blessed to have met her. Her smile and sweet disposition is infectious and comforting.\nHer teaching approach is creative, and helps to make sure you understand your next steps. I encourage anyone who is thinking about it, to GO FOR IT!']

name: Belmont Abbey College
reviews: ["Full disclosure: i have never studied at this school, but I have attended excellent repertory theater and classical music recitals at the institution. They accomplish a lot on what i'm certain is a modest budget.\n\nOnly downs: not the highest ranked college in the country, but i've heard they are improving. Keep up the good work!", 'Lovely small campus in a quiet wooded area. This is a catholic college. The staff are warm and friendly and they had move-in organized to a T. Most students are athletes.', 'i heard the the theatre program is great! hopefully, i can catch a show next time i’m here in charlotte! oh, the campus is very pretty!', 'It’s my first time at a Lacrosse game here. The game is interesting however it was very difficult to get to the field because there were no paths except through the wet grass from the parking lot.', 'I\'m a student here and it\'s been a great experience. As far as the campus goes, it is absolutely gorgeous. For the school itself, since the school is so small it\'s guaranteed that you will never feel like "just a number" here. They also are very determined to keep their teaching embedded in Catholic Social Thought, but by no means is there any discrimination against others who have different faiths and creeds. Great college!']

name: Bennett College
reviews:
['Bennett was as beautiful as I remember it to be 33 years ago, when I was just a young freshman. It was good to be "home."', 'My experience attending Bennett College in 99-2003 was an experience. Reading most of these comments I guess some things does not change. Majority of all the woman working in the financial aid  and admissions office were rude. I would always wonder to myself  how are these women still employed? The campus (sidewalks) were cracked and I can recall myself spraining my ankle upon moving in because the concrete was severely cracked. Yes, the cafeteria food was nasty and didn't have much of a selection of items to choose from. The tuition was ridiculous high and honestly I'm not sure why.....the dorm rooms that I lived in-Phieffer and Cone hall were okay for the most part but the bathrooms were horrible. But, compared to the other dorms I guess I should have been thrilled to have been in those two dorms.
The positive things attending Bennett was that I met some nice classmates. I was able to hear Corretta Scott King and Maya Angelou speak during an ACES ceremony. I will always appreciate that forever!
My first year going off to college as I think on it now I wish I would have went to a HSBC where I could have truly experienced college life.  On a closing thought if Bennett is still performing in the same manner from when I attended 18 years ago then that is very sad! Overtime, people should grow/advance, do, and become better. That is what Bennett expectations are for their students. However, if Bennett own staff aren't exemplifying and walking into these various things. They should not be employed at this school because they will contribute to it's value going down and if you have no students or not enough then there will be no "Bennett".
Although, this was my personal experience it may have been different for others. If anyone choose Bennett College then they will have to experience college life here for themselves...', 'With an ALL GIRL SCHOOL comes the drama and how you handle it. Bennett is actually shaping me into a woman. Seeing the comments about the College is actually crazy. If you ever heard your mother tell you "Its how you make your college experience" then you can tell by some of the reviews the person did not make a good college experience. That person was probably stuck in their ways and did not want to socialize. But that's their choice, and they moved on. I personally say that Bennett Suits me because MAJORITY of colleges don't give you that one on one with your professor and im thankful of that. Yes the staff here at Bennett Has its moment, you just got to be patient, and be mindful. I'M PROUD TO BE A BELLE, but don't trust a lot of these reviews, scout the college for yourself get a feel of the college for yourself.', 'This school is fraud.  They do not practice what the preach.  There is NO SISTERHOOD as promised.  They do not provide activities to promote sisterhood or bonding, all these girls do is fight.  It is extremely difficult to get in contact with admissions and financial aide departments, they hold refund checks without explanation and the school is extremely small with most classes being virtual in which they can complete at home instead of being in dorms.  If you are looking for a real college experience this is not the place.', 'I am a Freshwoman at Bennett College now and I love the academics. Everything is well except the breakfast, which is not appetizing at all. I only eat it because there is not a community stove in the dormitories. The only other problem I have with this school, is that the women in the business office are very disrespectful, unprofessional, and unorganized. Every time I go in there to ask them a question, the women who are employed, always give me a hard time.  All in all, if you are interested in a small liberal college for black women and do not mind the rude business office employers and the bad breakfast then by all means apply to the school.']

name: Bladen Community College
reviews:
['My experience at BCC has been great! I've had a few issues regarding staff and arrogant instructors but that's everywhere. lol.. Majority of the instructors do in fact go out of their way to assist you and make sure you are doing okay.. it works both ways.. If you're a student who's not taking initiative and not applying yourself, you really cannot bash faculty for not "passing you" when you do not deserve it.  Last term I had a few teachers I really didn't like .. lol like one of them really fugged my nerves.. but at the end of the semester she helped me out cos she acknowledged my effort to attend class, turn in assignments on time and notify of concerns or questions.  Out of all the colleges I've attended this is by far one of the best. Perhaps it's due to the size and the location of the college but irregardless why.. BCC is an awesome experience.   Many of the staff/faculty are superbly helpful. The LEC ', "I am a student at BCC and my experience there has been wonderful. I have had great instructors they have been more than willing to help me in any way.I don't have a problem with them not responding back to my emails or even returning a phone call.Whenever I go to their office and it is not a problem at all. In the spring of 2016 I will be graduating with college transfer in science and art. I am  part of the Student Government Association , Upswing the online tutoring that BCC offers to students for free. I am also part of the work study program and I was elected to represent BCC in the Student Leadership Development Program in Raleigh. My GPA is good and I work very hard. I would recommend BCC to anyone. It is all in what you want. What you put in is what you get out. You can't expect special treatment. My experience has been Great and I have already had job offers and I have not even graduated yet. Everybody experience is different but mine has been great.I didn't think that my college experience would be so great, but I made a great decision when I chose BCC they are my extended family.", 'If I could give it less than one star I would. The graduation ceremony tonight was HORRIFIC. Each graduate was given 5 tickets for family or friends to attend, all the while there were not enough seats in the auditorium. Also, multiple staff and people on stage had multiple people in the audience. There were almost 100 people who had tickets but were not allowed to enter, almost 60 of which were PARENTS. Multiple people drove from other states to see their children graduate and were not permitted to do so. Aside from that, the audience that did make it inside was given instructions that if you clapped, whistled, or showed excitement for your graduate you would be escorted out immediately and that it was to remain silent. Additionally, no pictures or videos were allowed to be taken by family or you would be escorted out as well. So not only did a large portion of people not even get to witness graduation for an education that THEY funded, but those who made it inside were not allowed to show excitement or take pictures as memories of the ceremony. I will never recommend anyone to attend this school simply over this. Why work hard for years and pour money and get into debt so that your family can stand outside of your graduation in tears that they have a ticket and cannot attend? And on top of all of this, I witnessed a lady in tears because her son was graduating and she had a ticket, but she was told the seats were full. The response by the ticket-taker at the door? “Oh come on. I don’t have time for this.” Absolutely ridiculous and uncalled for. If you know you have x number of seats and y number of graduates, x/y= the number of tickets each graduate gets. Then everyone with a ticket can actually attend.', 'Well Aaron, You are incorrect. I am a student, not faculty nor staff, and I have had my account for quite some time now. I named my account this because I am proud to be a BCC Student! I'm not trying to defend anything other than my experience here! I'm sure there are other colleges that offer a good education but so does BCC. One thing I know for sure, I definitely learned to capitalize proper nouns and proper writing techniques!

Wow Caleb! I am shocked at your review of Bladen Community College! I am currently a student @ BCC and my experience is the complete opposite of what you have described! Let me tell you about my time here. I am one semester away from graduating and I have had an exceptional experience! I am a student in the Computer Information Technology program and feel I am well equipped to enter the work force! All of my courses have been challenging and most have had hands-on exercises and testing to go with it. I have put in many hours of studying as well as in the Test-out Labs to fulfill the course requirements! I am willing to give my best effort to gain all of the knowledge they have to offer, which is a tremendous amount! Every single instructor I have had has been more than willing to give their time to answer any questions I have had and they all have been quick to respond to any emails I have sent them. They have all gone above and beyond their duties to make sure I, and the other students, have a full understanding of the subject. I do, and will continue to, recommend BCC as an excellent school! They offer many different curriculums and cover these courses with the needed material.
Bladen Community College is a fantastic choice for your educational needs and desires!
P.S. I would say, "You'll get out of it what you put into it"!', "i took college transfer out here for a short while before moving to wilmington and transferring to uncw. most of the teachers don't do much or even try. if all i had to do was get lesson plans, powerpoints, and tests off of a book's website i could be a teacher too. don't believe it? experience it yourself! this is not specific to bladen county though! it is happening in a lot of places! before teachers could share resources and rely on computers, they actually had to know the subject material they were teaching. BCC Student is obviously a staff or faculty member trying to defend the ratings here. sounds to me like an account was created just for that purpose. who has the google name BCC Student? lol. well if you are looking for a better school to go to try cape fear or southeastern community college. the job market is also a lot better here in wilmington so if you are going to move for a job anyway try out cape fear!"]

name: Blue Ridge Community College
reviews: ['I returned for another pedicure today and AGAIN, it was OUTSTANDING. The receptionist was helpful and cordial. The two students who administered our pedicures were patient, thorough, and proficient as well as polite and friendly. The lab is clean, up to date on supplies, equipment and technology. The ambience is soothing and professional-no loud talking or raucous laughter. My husband, Mr. Particular, approved and was impressed enough to suggest that he’d like to return for haircuts and beard trim. The prices are quite reasonable and you’re helping closely monitored students learn and practice for success in their chosen career. Oh. And we always tip our providers!', 'The instructors and Success Coach are amazing. They are happy to answer any of your questions and concerns, And they made registering and figuring everything out a lot less stressful.', 'Thank you for the information on basic electricity. Sean was a good teacher I just realized that I needed help to make my own electric inside my home.  I can’t do it by myself. So, I’m grateful for you teaching it.  I just don’t have much energy to learn right now. Thank you for the course. God bless!', 'Very nice campus. Really good staff working there. Stacey Hill helped me find a good job in NCWorks and I am very thankful that I met her and Kelli Dodd and it’s sad that they no longer work here. I was in Electronics class with Christopher Peavy. Even though I didn’t do so well. I liked my teachers a lot and to be honest I think a lot of the staff deserve a promotion.', 'The service was great and I had a great hair do by Henisley.']

name: Brevard College
reviews:
['Beautiful, although dated looking campus (they are undergoing major renovations and building new structures).  For the size of the student body, campus is huge.  Everyone is very nice.  Town of Brevard is nice and vibrant.  Surrounding area is beautiful.  They have a steam running through campus.', 'Beautiful college in a beautiful town with tons of quaint shops and restaurants.', 'I graduated from Brevard and was admitted to Furman University. I later went to law school and did very well. Not only did I enjoy my time there, I know my continued success was made possible because of my education at Brevard.', "I do NOT recommend sending your child to this school. The staff does not know what they are doing. They can't answer simple questions and have no idea how to accommodate for medical issues.
The only saving grace is the professors in the criminal justice program. They go out of their way to help their students.
And if you are not left leaning politically, forget it. The entire campus will shune and ridicule you for not believing as they do.
On top of all that, this school costs $42,000 a year!! Ridiculous!!", 'We attended an opera this afternoon. It was The Elixir of Love by Gaetano Donizetti. It was a very enjoyable experience. The orchestra and the opera cast were excellent. They received a much deserved standing ovation.']

name: Cabarrus College of Health Sciences
reviews:
['I was warned about the MOT program and I still did it

What I wish I knew before starting…
- The design is beautiful as it is exclusively for COTAs with experience, yet the whole point seems to be missed that students seek to learn from more knowledgeable people, not teach ourselves from Amazon textbooks and free peer reviewed journal articles online
- Expect 16-20h of class time monthly/every 3wks (about 5 weekends per sem), and x10 1hr nightly synchronous lecture zoom classes per sem (varies).
- You will be completing up to 13 assignments on the weekends in class for which are due that Saturday/Sunday night (some unrelated to weekend class activities, just conveniently due on class days) for which occasionally students are not provided with adequate time to complete and subsequently graded harshly when provided with insufficient resources and time for fair completion- when discussed with faculty, students are quickly dismissed saying they need to learn for “realistic workplace standards” Opinion- Faculty appear to overlook that students have just completed a 40h workweek + 16-20h of weekend class + a 1-6h drive or even a flight home just in time to finish the 12 day crawl with no days off; yet attempt to feed such a standard as remotely beneficial for retaining any input of information long-term.
- Expect to teach yourself up to 15 chapters of textbook material per class, per module, from books you could have simply bought on Amazon while unburdened by copious tuition rates and stress
- The unpaid Level 2 FW is technically 7mo…not 6mo. Cabarrus adds a month between rotations for students to work on their capstone project…

The not so factual stuff:
- Often disregarded is the knowledge we do have as experienced COTAs and therefore the knowledge we crave and paid 44k+ to get…we are so dissatisfied BECAUSE we are so HUNGRY to be taught something of substance so we can GROW.- not be drowned in complex, challenging and yet non-beneficial assignments.
- No matter how much students advocate (in midterm advising, course evaluations, meetings with teachers, verbalizing concerns during class), nothing appears to change- confirmed equal concerns up to 4 years prior to this with no significant change…yet

Key takeaways- Personally, I would have rather driven 4h further AND pay more if it meant I would graduate as a better OTP than I was before since surrendering every ounce of brainpower to this program for 2+years.', 'DONT GO HERE. So far I have hated my experience at this college, and all of my classmates have as well. It is so expensive when the money is hardly going back to any of the students. I had a bad experience with a professor and people are being no help, and honestly so many of the staff here are NEVER going to be on your side. If you have classes at the plaza building good luck because they expect you to park at the main campus and walk all the way to the plaza crossing main roads and sometimes without a sidewalk. They care more about your grades and money than they care about you, if they even care abt you at all.', "Very capable and hard working students AND staff. Extremely happy with our child's/familys experience. Literally can't say enough good things about CCHI!", 'DO NOT GO HERE!!!!
Gigi springs continuously lies. It messes with peoples finances and futures, but for the price point of this school I expected at a minimum respect and honesty from people.

The teachers do not teach. You must go to class 4 hours a week just to go home and teach yourself. It makes absolutely no sense that this school costs as much as it does. They change policies all the time. It feels like they punish us students for the lacking of their staff. They are very short staffed too and it is noticeable.
And do NOT get me started on parking or the immense lack thereof. They want to celebrate having more students come in each semester but there is literally nowhere to put them. They blame being short staffed on so much, but we pay a good amount of money to go here. And the quality is not at all worth it so WHERE is all that money going??
More and more nursing graduates are failing the NCLEX from this school also. I don’t understand why anyone would recommend this college. Community college is definitely a better option maybe unless you’re ABSN.
Instructors will literally talk badly about students in front of other students, act incredibly unprofessional but the utmost professionalism is expected of students. It’s gotta be an actual joke. 12K this semester alone for what? A joke. It is too late for me but telling you all-

DO NOT ATTEND.', 'Highly expensive private school who has very little parking for their students. They are more concerned with how their students dress than if they have the parking they need and a safe walk to class. If you’re not a nursing student and have class in the Plaza Building, you are expected to park at the school and walk next to the road without a sidewalk to get to the building. It will take you about 20 mins. Per their email, students are just expected to “be safe.” They’ve also recently expanded to high school students (which makes studying on campus difficult as there is one student pavilion and the high school students are apparently not required to use their inside voices). This has removed an entire student parking lot due to the trailers it now houses for those students. They also do not work with other atrium hospitals such as cmc main. So if you’re hoping you may go to clinicals closer to home, you won’t. I would not recommend this school to anyone. Especially knowing they are more concerned with dress code and if you’re parking in the correct place than if you’re safe. To force students to walk alongside a main road with no sidewalk is the most horrific thing I’ve ever seen from a school. And then to charge us $10k a semester for the privilege? It should be illegal.']

name: Caldwell Community College and Technical Institute
reviews: ["Attention all new students taking English: Mr. Matt Williams is the ONLY REASON this school gets 5 stars. Yeah, they're great with helping you get started, however Mr. Williams in the English department is the best instructor I've ever had. He is the only reason why I haven't given up this semester. Each week when getting ready for my classes, I'm prepared to smile just looking at his feedback. He aims to actually educate you, he focuses on how you can better yourself and does not ridicule you like some instructors I have and have had. He understands- we are human! About the school, I take my classes online now, and it's been a while since I've actually took any on campus, but typically l never had any issues navigating the campus nor had any issues with my other instructors. Overall, if you're in it to win it here your dreams are achievable! They have a great transfer program too. I most definitely prefer CCCTl over CVCC if you're looking for community colleges in our area!", 'I love being a full time student here. I should have started sooner and I am a very late bloomer. It is still possible to achieve your dreams at any age. I am 40 I have been out of school for 20 years and I am passing all of my classes here! I enjoy this school and school is so important to me!', 'A nice institution. Property is well kept and organized.', 'Incredible instructors and a lovely environment. More people should know about Caldwell’s biomedical program, it’s a rapidly growing field that not a lot of schools offer.', "For a technical school, their programs are laughable. They seem to hire anyone, regardless of qualifications. I've seen countless people express concerns about specific instructors and the programs not teaching anything useful for the real world. Leadership does nothing but make excuses. Advisors are unresponsive, causing students to take unnecessary classes or extend their enrollment. It genuinely feels like no one cares. If you're considering this school, take your money elsewhere."]

name: Campbell University
reviews:
["Nice campus.  Never experienced it as a student.  We bring our church kids here for camp.  Some dorms require you to share a bathroom with the entire floor, others have suites. Food in the Cafe was good.  We also just went to watch a play in the theater on campus. The production of was great. Seating was comfortable (I'm a big guy).", "Campus is nice, very well maintained.....
I'd give a zero if possible...
But this campus should not be advertising themselves as a Christian school, they are far from it. They were founded on Baptist roots, but they've long since fled from those roots...

We've had young adults tell us that the teachers of bible classes teach heretical views, even young adults from different religions have said their teachings are way off from the Christian views.
Students are fleeing this school for good reason, stay away if you want sound biblical teachings", "This University is beautiful. The Staff and employees is always giving their 200% to make sure everything is in order and verifying if curriculum/academics are up-to-date within the present and preparing the students for the future. I have met some of these Staff & employees and they're very respectful and professional in what they do,... Campbell University, thank you for your dedication and hard work!", 'We are a Campbell family! Eldest son met his wife while attending here and now our youngest son and daughter are enrolled. The campus is well kept and clearly the university has a vision for the future. The financial aid has been excellent; if your GPA is strong, there is a path to an affordable education. Camels! 😃🐪', "This school is only here to take your student loans. They kicked my daughter out after failing one subject. Chemistry as if they wasnt enough pill makers in the world today anyway. But she passed everything thing else. Took the student loan money as well as the money for the dorm the next semester. Cant get that back. Said that this makes their school look bad. What looks bad is you claim to be a Christian school but are a bunch of thieves. Really guess that's what Christianity is about anyway stealing people lives from them. So I guess that fits the school. Becareful trusting your future to this school."]

name: Cape Fear Community College
reviews:
['Was just walking around downtown & wanted to share some photos I took of the college I do know several folks who are students here & they really enjoy the school', 'I attended the New Hanover County Diversity and Equity Summit at Cape Fear Community College hosted by the YWCA. What an experience! Phenomenal thought provoking, engaging presentations that left you educated and uplifted. It was a beautiful time of networking and life building. Looking forward to attending more life changing engagements!', 'I took the three class Yamaha outboard certification program at Cape Fear Community College.
It is a great program that has all the tools, training and methods necessary to become successful.
The new outboard engines are there to work with and train on to become an entry level mechanic.
The need for employees with this skill is currently very high.', "I'm a transfer student from two other community colleges in our state and this BY FAR my absolute favorite. The professors honestly go above and beyond to make sure each individual student succeeds. I have never had to wait longer than 7-10 minutes to meet with an advisor or counselor. Plus, the location is BEAUTIFUL. Enjoy a view of the Cape Fear River/Historic Downtown as you learn!! There is also a Port City Java on campus for a pick me up!", 'Love my class, the instructor is great.  Convenient time too so I can work and go to school']

name: Carteret Community College
reviews: ["Out of all the experiences I have had with furthering my education. Carteret has been the absolute easiest process of enrollment, speaking with student services, financial aid information. I have went to two other community colleges in the area and did not have the best experiences. With Carteret I can't say 1 bad thing! Everyone is SO SO HELPFUL, and SO Thorough! I look forward to doing my school work, and having to go to class in person! Not many can say that!", "I visited the college and was pleasantly surprised at how clean it was! The grounds are well maintained and the faculty were all very helpful in giving directions to different locations on campus. Also, I'm happy to report the prices of the vending machines were reasonable.", 'I was shocked to see so many negative reviews on here. If you’re looking for a cheap school with high quality teachers, go here!! I’ve been here 4 semesters and I have learned so much from all of the classes I have taken. I’ve been so impressed with the teachers and how much they want to help you succeed. I’ve only had one bad teacher in my experience, it wasn’t that I didn’t learn from their class, but merely our personalities clashed. Other than that, I have nothing but good things to say about this school.', 'I was there for the Empty Bowls charity event. Very nice, the soups I chose were yummy and the high school band was marvelous.  Many, many bowls and cups to choose from. Lovely worthwhile event to attend.', 'Graduation day ceremonies were held here on Friday, May 13, 2022, and the ceremony itself was wonderful. However, parking was absolutely ridiculous! It seems that the Civic Center allowed half of the parking lot for a carnival that was being held the same day. Therefore, it was horrendous trying to find a parking spot, and some families were late because they had to park elsewhere. Why in the world would they hold this graduation ceremony and a carnival at the same time?']

name: Catawba College
reviews: ['We received an invitation for a basketball camp held during memorial day weekend. Beautiful campus. My son enjoyed the camp & stated he took a lot from it.', 'Came here on a college visit with my son and I absolutely love this college. I love how small the school is and its family orientated. The tour guide was awesome along with the young man who did the orientation! Lovely school!', 'The grounds look better than the inside of these dorms. They have mold, huge rats, asbestos, and paint chipping off walls. They got granted twice millions of dollars and already have no funding to fix up the dorms. The show room of a dorm is just a cover up of what these dorm rooms', "Catawba College is a small private liberal art college with a small professor to student ratio and a large portion of student athletes. The professors take personal interest in the students and there are a lot of student activities and club's to be a part of. The location is North of Salisbury. Most of the college experience at Catawba is what the individual student chooses to get involved in. There are a lot of opportunities to be successful and involved in many activities if you apply yourself but the college experience is some of what you make it yourself. The education is top quality and prepares many students for graduate studies. The athletic programs are treated like top quality programs and are a great experience.", 'I love Catawba, it’s a great school that cherishes the knowledge of their students. But with being only 3 weeks into the second 2021 semester, I find it very uncomfortable to be on campus. Most of the students take off their mask as soon as they walk out of the classroom, even if they are still in the building! Others will walk around and sit in the sitting areas around campus (Admin!) with no mask what so ever! I see big groups walking around to get to classes with no mask on. I have seen more non-mask students than the ones that are actually wearing them. I believe that multiple other students are starting to feel this way too, and as a commuter the last thing I would want to do is bring Covid back to my house where my family (who all has various health issues) live. Especially with the overwhelming rate of people in quarantine currently. If the students aren’t going to take this seriously for the sake of people other than themselves then I think it’s dangerous for us all to be back on campus and I would prefer not to be as uncomfortable as I already am with just trying to move around to my classes to avoid the non-maskers. And the thing is you don’t know who to trust to be around with this virus and the professors are making it dangerously close to overstepping Covid boundaries within the classrooms and assigned group work outside of class. It is a very overwhelming experience to be back on campus this semester, especially when we don’t have a voice to tell others what is completely going wrong here, because most of them don’t care about the virus or see that they can harm more people than what they may think.']

name: Catawba Valley Community College
reviews: ["DO NOT ATTEND THIS COMMUNITY COLLEGE! If you're a transfer student that need to complete the last remaining credits for a degree program please enroll at another NC community college. This college is scamming new students that doesn't reside in the county. They're stealing refund checks and unsure of what happened with the ach transfer. A third party is used to distribute the refunds via direct deposit to a bank account or you can select a prepaid card offered through the website. Last option is to receive a check via mail, you can't pick the check up at the business office like other community colleges. The wild part is, the lady working in the financial aid department will tell you a full 20 minute story about how a lot of students have been scammed out of their refund check and NEVER GOT THE MONEY BACK because they opened a text message or email asking for bank account and student info. FAKE!!! Someone employed with the college is stealing refunds. If you try contacting the college via phone they NEVER EVER take calls daily, MAJOR red flag #1. RED FLAG #2, BIO-111  is offered online and requires a lab kit that can't be utilized because it doesn't contain a microscope, burner or stands. The crazy part is, the ***VIRTUAL LAB KIT*** IS ACTUALLY ACCESSIBLE THROUGH THE COURSE. Yes, $300 wasted on a unreturnable lab kit that the ADVISOR SUGGEST you purchase to be successful in the course. Red flag #3, The online courses that requires the use of external programs to complete additional assignments contains numerous errors, maybe hacked. The instructors will not assist with the issue and will suggest contacting support. After contacting support the instructor WILL NOT OFFER to extend the due date or a grade correction even if you have PROOF that something is wrong with the program. I'm not sure how this college became an accredited community college BUT IT'S A SCAM COLLEGE. Please call every extension and visit this community college before enrolling or adding it on your FAFSA application. Most likely you will have to physically visit the college to have all your questions answered.", "I am so thankful that this school is my local community college. You'll save a ton of money, without sacrificing educational standards. Beautiful up to date campus, that offers certificate programs, 2 year applied degrees, and transfer associate degrees. Online, in person, and hybrid class opportunities. They took the pandemic seriously, and did their best to keep things moving, while putting safety first. Everyone I've encountered has been helpful and encouraging. I'll be moving to a four year school soon, and they've also been more than helpful in helping me make that transition. I'll never regret being a CVCC graduate.", "If you're interested in quality education,  equivalent to a DI or DII school but at a fraction of the cost,  CVCC is your answer.  With the newly built Workforce Solution Complex,  you get world -class, top of the line,  instruction and equipment to train and learn on. CVCC rivals the to schools around. This is a great school to have in our community.", "My class was great. I gained a lot of knowledge with this class to use in my line of work. It's been 6 weeks and administration has given me the run around about getting my certificate. They are costing me money. My job is reimbursing me for my class and giving me a raise. It only takes a few weeks to get a certificate. The day class got there certificates after 3 weeks. We all agreed to take the mssc exam on a date and administration canceled that on us. Great class, poor administration.", "Soo I called to find out about trade classes and my question was treated as if I had three heads transferred three times and none of them seemed to know what i was talking about finally explained what trades are they told me to go to a web site so when it comes to trades got the feeling this isn't the school for me"]

name: Central Carolina Community College
reviews: ["A great place to take college classes if you live in the area. There's a lot of nice teachers, and the variety of classes isn't too bad. The campus is very easy to navigate, too, and the library is definitely a highlight of the place!", 'I signed up for a motorcycle course and was sent home. I never crashed or fell off my bike. I could tell the instructor did not like me because I was slower and a beginner. Everyone had some experience with the bike when the class said beginner. DO NOT TAKE YOUR MSF COURSE here if you are a beginner. The instructor also treats women and people of color differently. I finished the three hour class and now I have to argue for a refund. I drove an hour for the class and wasted $200 as well as my time on a Saturday. The instructor at the beginning of the class was like “We’ll get you to your goal.” He was reassuring me in the beginning and was like we can get you to your goal. I also didn’t think I was doing terrible for my first time. There was no warning. He rejected me from the class with people nearby. It was extremely unprofessional. There are other classes I have heard that are much nicer and actually take their time to teach you. He said to ask the front desk for a refund. The vibes was very much like a scammer.', 'Aweful! Night classes also require day work! What if you work day, that\'s the whole point of NIGHT CLASSES!!! Also, first week of classes and the LMS not functioning. No access to work assignments, because they are are labeled as ZEROS from the previous semester!!! Yet expect students to "figure it out" and turn in assigned work the very next day, even though instructor stated LMS would MAYBE be functioning by Friday.  Thats a whole week of classes inaccessible!!! Out of 16 weeks! Already starting out failing!!!Talk about being set up for failure!!! I\'d give a negative 10 if I could.DO NOT ATTEND THIS SCHOOL!!!', "This school is not for working adults. The lack of online options is absymal. The only positive i have is my amazing Chem teacher, Reid Haslup. I pray everyone gets to experience her. However shift to online it's 2026. Also some courses were unnecessarily hard, like professors wanted to be adjunct professors so bad- like relax. Happy that I was able to transfer wish I wouldve went to UNCG in the first place as a lot of CCCC credits didnt transfer.", 'If a road is closed block it off completely, not half way. No need to nearly jump in front of my truck. Bad attitude and bad communication.']

name: Central Piedmont Community College
reviews: ["CPCC needs some help in the IT department. It took me several days to get access to my account and each time had to wait at least several hours. Then today I can't login again. I decided to take classes from another NC community college - much easier process and HALF the cost!", 'Someone hit my vehicle in the parking deck while I was in class. Now there is a big dent in my vehicle and the school is saying they can’t do anything about it even though there are cameras that recorded the incident. Very frustrating.', 'Amazing school! Completing classes was easy, and I was very impressed with the modern campus and friendly instructors. As an adult student, working while completing the online programs was manageable. I recommend attending here before pursuing a four-year degree! This school helped me get my foot in the door with local companies looking to hire and made the transfer to UNCC very smooth.\n\nHowever, my academic advisor was nonexistent, and my financial aid advisor was rude and unhelpful. Also, some professors are better than others, but you can get all As in every class if you try.', 'Cpcc does not care about its students at all. After being here for almost two months I have run into so many issues already. I was trying to transfer schools and they were extremely unhelpful and had me pay for several documents that were of no use for my applications. I also have learning disabilities, and haven’t been able to get my needed accommodations even after two months of waiting, due to many careless issues with the cpcc system and disability team. Their help system here is a complete joke. I personally wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone especially if you plan on transferring from here or getting accommodations.', 'Need better student drop off and pick up, my mom picked me up from campus at the Elizabeth campus and some crazy lady tried to cuss me and my mother out just bc she had to wait a second for me to get in the car, where is campus police for these situations? I went through this twice and absolutely no consequences for others who chose to cuss and get angry at students while trying to safety get home not to mention cars will drive around cars waiting for pickup and I seen a car almost directly hit a student and had to slam on the breaks.']

name: Chowan University
reviews: ['This was a big school, the travel there was long, but beautiful. We past plenty of cotton fields. The basket game between Chowan vs Converse was a good game. One thing I was happy to see in their gym was the folded chairs option rather then your standard bleachers.', 'I went here for all of my four years of college. I graduated with a B.S. in mathematics. Although my program was cut, due to funding my sophomore year, my caring professors made it possible for me to take all of my senior classes my junior year to finish out the math part of my degree. I know Chowan is a small school, but I don’t think anyone will ever regret going there. The friends you make there are made for a lifetime. I could not think of a school that would suit me better.', 'My daughter graduated from Chowan. I like how nice and clean the campus normally is. The school has a good spiritual lifting ambiance about it.  I enjoyed visiting the campus.', 'DO NOT go here. Enrolled, was accepted, attended the soar event signed up for classes, was about to start in a week. Went up to the school to find my classes and get some information as communication had been non-existent. Was told when I arrived that my program had been completely cut without any notice and I had to change my major. They opted to try to change me to the graphic design major which is NOT at all the same as studio arts. No warning or anything about this. Nearly all the staff know nothing about any of this. Half of them are wondering around aimlessly not a clue in the world as to what’s going on. Was promised an on campus counselor as well and then was told today that they haven’t had an on Campus counselor in several years. If I could go here simply for the handful of lovely staff I would. I’m not paying thousands for a degree that I don’t want. The admissions staff seem to not care at all about any of the students either. Seems more like they care about money then anything. Down lots of money from admissions and medical notes they needed just to now not have an option for school this semester. Extremely disappointed.', 'Chowan University is an awesome school I love it. I am a member of Zeta Phi Beta Sorority incorporated. This is my senior year here at Chowan I will graduate May 2016. It going to bitter sweet when I graduate I have met a lot of awesome people. I especially enjoyed working in admission it was awesome experience. Go CU Hawks']

name: Cleveland Community College
reviews:
["I went through 2 semesters (4.0 and 3.7 GPA; deans list) of in-person prerequisite classes, a TEAS exam, and a semester of online classes (4.0 GPA) before finally getting into the x-ray/radiography program in August of 2021.  Dealing with the stress and anxiety of learning all the new information, going to clinicals multiple days a week, and eventually scratching and clawing my way out of the 1st semester and passing it, only to be told halfway through the 2nd semester that I should either restart the entire program again or withdraw and change majors.  All that effort and energy and time and dedication for what?

According to the clinical coordinator/instructor, I wasn't where I needed to be by that point in the program (2nd semester).  Her and the other 2 teachers in her office told me my best options would be to restart the entire program again by redoing the 1st semester with the incoming juniors, or withdraw and change majors.  I already passed the 1st semester, why would I want to retake the whole thing?

I was struggling with x-raying the abdomen area and tried to get my comp on it countless times.  There were other areas I was struggling with too.  Apparently I wasn't learning/retaining the information as well as some of my classmates.  How did I make it into the 2nd semester then?  I just don't know what to say about how my experience in the program turned out.  It did not go well in the end, and memories of that frankly depress me.

The clinical coordinator/instructor showed a lot of favoritism too.  A couple other classmates of mine in the program pointed this out as well.  That favoritism definitely impacted my performance and possibly those of others.

(2 * rating is for my experience in the program, not the college itself.)", "Had a great time visiting the welding school a Cleveland Tech College. Their welding course is superb and they teach the students everything they could possibly need to know about breaking in the welding career. The head instructor Tim Wisher is a personal friend and his associate Dana is a great place to visit and talk shop. I'm a retired pipeline welder I have known Tim for probably close to fifteen years now. he really cares about his students and wants them to progress to have a bright future. Mark Scott Shelby North Carolina", 'I have mixed feelings about my time at Cleveland Community College. The student services and enrollment center is outstanding. The go out of their way to get students the help they need with little to no hassle. I was able to receive all of my learning accommodations and register for classes with ease.

I would like to say thank you to Dr. Willis. He was the best part about my college experience at Cleveland and is what every professor should strive to be.

However, the most dissatisfactory experience was that of the quality of healthcare department. I expected a little more passion and respect from my advisor and professors in the Bailey building. They have an attitude comparable to that of the any DMV. The education is of low quality because the just cram material and expect you to get it quickly (85 pages of anatomy in four days), I had to battle with them to use my laptop in class, and they are the type of professors that like to give pop quizzes just to add to our suffering. Also, if you are a radiography student and live in Gaston County, be prepared to drive 90min to a clinical site and leave at 9:00pm, while coming back to CCC the following morning at 8:00am. The amount of stress they inflict on students is insane! This is coming from someone who has achieved nearly 130 college credit hours and is typically a straight A student.', "I'm currently taking the Pharmacy Technician class at night in the Legrand Ctr. I seriously and honestly can say more security cameras need to be put in the parking lot. A car was broken into on June 27 and now I'm more vigilant about looking at my surroundings now more than before. The Security Officers need to be patroling more often. Other than that incident I love going to class at CCC Continuing Education Department.", "As an IT student, I've had a very mediocre experience studying for my double major (IT Networking and Systems Security). Just recently, however, I've gone through one of the most infuriating and stressful experiences I've had in years brought on by their NET-125 instructor. This instructor does not clearly list their standards for submitting work, and I've been given several zeroes for completed work that was submitted in their entirety, or missing one or so minor parts (such as leaving a comment saying you did the work). After several attempts to contact this instructor with no response, I've given up trying to talk with them about these grades.

For this reason and several others, I'm led to believe that this instructor does not care about the success of their students, contradictory to what they like to advertise. Their habit of giving zeroes for missing small portions of assignments that never actually pertain to furthering the students' education or demonstrate a student's competency with the material they've learned is a pointless and detestable practice. Would an instructor with a good work ethic and a genuine desire to teach and cultivate learning in their students give out the absolute worst grades possible to the pupils who are actively learning and submitting nearly completed work, but miss out on a few small details?"]

name: Coastal Carolina Community College
reviews: ['I would recommend CCCC to anyone that is wanting to move into a trade quicker than a two or 4 year degree. Use it as a stepping stone to get to work sooner, then pursue higher education. The faculty really care about the students.', "Using the Dental Clinic for teeth cleaning.  The first appointment is screening and paperwork with an exam.  Need to actually schedule  an additional appointment for the cleaning portion.  It's yet to be determined whether it's cost effective with an hour drive.  The staff is great and friendly,  the tech students appear to enjoy what they are doing.  I wish them a successful career 🙏", "This college is the worst college! The staff doesn't care about the students! When I say staff, I mean admissions and trying to get you help!!! I would not have graduated if it wasn't for my clinical coordinator which has changed now.bDo not to in the MLT program. I wished I had stayed at Beaufort but so glad to have the one's I did at that time. Beaufort was going to give me a full ride and they are very new with a great facility! Nothing like I endured! And if you do clinicals at Onslow we'll wishes!", 'Spent $75 on a class to get cpr Certified couldn’t make the class, but some of the ladies at the college had told me that I could get refunded. I called to get refunded and they told me that I wouldn’t be getting refunded because I didn’t tell them the day of that I wouldn’t be able to make it even though that was never told to me. Tried to explain my situation they did not care. They were very rude over the phone and the ladies who had told me I could get a refund blocked and ignored my emails. Very unprofessional.', 'I did not know what to expect when I started at CCCC as a 50 year old college student. Now I know it was the best decision I could have made. Coastal is making it possible for me to attain my associates degree while preparing to transfer to a university. Every professor/instructor I have had is a true professional who gives you the resources for success. How bad do you want it and what are you waiting for? A better future is in your hands.']

name: Craven Community College
reviews: ["Great place to study! Instructors are great, tutors are phenomenal & super helpful, & their Daycare Financial Aid Scholarship made it possible for me to get my Associates Degree, & I'm married with 4 kids! The classes weren't easy, but if you work hard, you'll reach your goal!", 'Great campus w/ excellent staff! My oldest goes here for early college and loves it!', "So distraught by this college. I signed up 2 months ago for a Motorcycle Safety Course. They gave me an email 3 days before the day of the class to take a 3 hour course that needs to be done before the class or 'no refund'. That was the 1st strike; people have kids and work full time. A bit long than 3 days would have been great. Then the day BEFORE the class at 5:15pm I get a phone call telling me they cancelled the class and I can't reschedule for 2+ months. I was told over the phone to come down on Monday to get my refund as I paid with cash. I get to the Workforce Development office to be treated like a crazy person by all the people working then I'm told I have to wait 2-3 weeks for it to be mailed like I'm supposed to just know this already. I would not recommend this college to anyone even as a last resort. Very unprofessional and very unfriendly.", 'I always enjoy the classes held at the Small Business center at Craven Community College.  The classes they offer with Martin Brossman are priceless.  The facilities are kept clean and the learning environment is comfortable for adult learners.  Highly recommend their programs for new and existing business owners.', 'The Small Business Center here at the college is fantastic! Great FREE classes, workshops, guest speakers and resources. It has helped me and my business, New Bern Paperless Marketing, tremendously! Rebecca is the best! Take advantage of it today. :)']

name: Davidson-Davie Community College
reviews: ['Awful experience. I was just trying to get information on classes and apprenticeship programs and I was given the biggest run around. The only reason its a two star is because of the beautiful woman who answered the phone at the davie campus. She gave me the most help and actually send me via phone to a person. I was told to go to Jenny Ferguson which was a bit of a hassle. I told her what I needed and instead of explaining anything and why she wasn\'t the one to go to, she told me to go to Continuing education to help me with registration which confused me even more because I didn\'t want help registering, I wanted information om a specific thing. On top of the fact that I was asking about a class and they said last week I could still register. So I\'ve spent a week trying to get ahold of people and get information on a program just to be told today when I finally got to the right people "the class has been full for weeks" and I\'d have to wait until the fall semester. I would have been putting my energy into other schools if I had been told that originally. This was an awful situation when I have already never wanted to go back to school. Don\'t make them make you feel stupid if anything like this happens to you, it\'s not you it\'s them.', 'The Davidson campus is harder to get ahold of than the white house. If you went here and need transcripts or have questions about…anything…good luck! I’ve called at multiple separate times on different days and even tried many different extensions and not once did someone answer the phone. I had to call the Davie campus and they picked up right away. This campus also has good professors, but the office sucks.', 'A Great Place Where You Can Do Anything You Want Because You Can Get A Degree For Anything You Want Like Being A Doctor What Ever You Want To Do Go To Davidson Community College And Sign Up And Start A New Beginning For Yourself And Your Family It Is Only What Ever You Want To Become', "I couldn't be happier with my experience at Davidson Davie Community College! From the professors to the maintenance guys. Friendly and helpful. The professors want to see you succeed and it shows through there commitment to students.", 'Mr. William Pass, Mr. Ronaldinho, Ms. Newcomb and Ms.Nickens are all absolutely wonderful! They took time out of their busy schedules of meetings and lunches to help my daughter. Thank you to this great group of people ❤️']

name: Davidson College
reviews:
['Beautiful campus that I got to visit. The buildings are historic and are all brick buildings.

I would’ve loved to see it in the late fall time. I can imagine it is more beautiful than what it was on a hot spring day.

I had the pleasure of going into the basketball stadium where I got to see some cool historic artifacts.', 'We are fortunate to have Davidson College.   It offers the public sports, music, lectures and plays.  This Dean Rusk International event was an  informative lecture on the Ukraine and Russian war, history,  culture, and worldwide support.', 'Stepping onto the campus of Davidson College is like stepping back in time. There is a peacefulness here. We’re locals. Live right here in town. And anytime my husband says would you like to walk for a bit on campus, the answer is always yes!', 'Wonderful campus, amazing faculty and top-notch academics. Davidson is truly the whole package. Highly recommend!', "Stephen curry went here

I'm gonna go to Davidson as well in 4 years

well maybe"]

name: Duke University
reviews: ['The Campus is extremely beautiful. Very old school look with very moderate feel on the inside of the buildings. Lots of space to walk, and enjoy a day. The one negative id there is no free parking. I get it, but still would be nice.', "Big hospital! Parking deck is expensive! Surgery was delayed so was at hospital 10 hours and bill was $14. They wanted us to get new badges when we went to ICU. NAVAGATION OF HOSPITAL is little confusing. They didn't have a selection of places to eat, which really surprised me.\nSurgeon and team was awesome!!", "I am a member of the Duke Alumni Pep Band and we get to play for a few home basketball games while the students are away on break. It's always a fun time!", 'Duke University is a beautiful campus with lots to see and do. The Duke employees and staff are absolutely incredible and so helpful. The Chapel is a stand out and of course Cameron Indoor Stadium', 'Be careful if your black , I had an awful experience with a Duke police officer . The racial discrimination is crazy and he saw me as a threat when I was scared of him. He already had his hand on his gun as if he was going to shoot me.']

name: Durham Technical Community College
reviews:
["So far I've only attended for some Spanish classes. The campus is fairly easy to navigate and students and staff alike are usually keen to help if you're turned around. The library is AWESOME, tons of resources in book, DVD/Blu-ray, CD, graphic novel, etc formats, and small spaces you can reserve for study groups.", 'It’s fine. No social scene though so not like a normal college if you want the college experience don’t go here but it’s good if you just want to take a few classes and go home.
Also, be kind to the resident geese or they will hiss at you.', 'Good school, watch out for phone theft. My phone went missing a year ago. Yesterday the find my iPhone app said my phone was found in china. So good school but if you drop your phone on the ground, someone will steal it and ship it to China', 'I had a wonderful experience. The staff was very professional and kind. When they speak you can tell they really want you to be successful in whatever career you choose. I made a good decision on selecting this school to continue my education.', 'Horrible horrible office staff. Very little capabilities in assisting students, especially within the VA department. Incorrect contact information ALL across the website. Was forced to drive 3 hours to be able to speak to someone in person, since phone calls and emails are not answered. To get there and be spoken to like a child. Sorry ma’am….do your job right and be pleasant or find another job.  Students depend on you for your guidance so be helpful and smile.

Luckily I’m only a summer student and attend Chapel Hill full time.']

name: East Carolina University
reviews:
['I love the school but not living on campus. Always have to deal with something there and the staff is lackluster. Had a fire in my dorm and while helping me move out they lost at least 600 dollars worth or clothes and act like they can’t do anything. The staff has done nothing but ignore my requests and waste my time. “Should’ve got dorm insurance” 🤓 like someone has bought that. Terrible courtesy, I love the campus but can’t wait to leave the terrible dorms.', 'The dorm is small and far walking distance to campus. So tired to walk but this is a good school. Long wait for the bus. 5th street is the good street to go.', "If you are a teacher doing a residency program to get your licensure, you should seek other options; particularly if you are on the special education pathway.

I am a teacher with a degree in a non-educational major so I have to complete a residency to get my teaching license. Despite having years in the educational field, I accepted this as fair. Everyone has an opportunity to grow and learn in their craft. Initially, I was excited at the prospect of becoming a better teacher. However, I wasn't taught before being thrown into the furnace.

My first class is a residency class. My colleagues who are further in the program than myself questioned this. I questioned it as well because why would I start with a residency course (grading what you teach and how) when I haven't been taught HOW to teach at all yet. I haven't been taught anything about education. I am treading water on experience alone in a very sink or swim style course.

ECU has set me up for failure this term. This hasn't been an experience where I feel myself growing in my field, but a tremendous source of stress with little guidance. My instructional coach who has nothing to do with ECU has been a bigger source of assistance than anything that has come from this university.

I think everyday what my experience would have been like if I had enrolled in Campbell instead. Before you enroll, ask what the pacing will be. If you are staying with a residency course, do NOT do it.", "My son attends.  Every experience I've had in this campus has been great.  Very helpful people each time I've been.", 'Specifically Fletcher Music Center. Spring Fest concerts.  I went to several of the six presented. Great acoustics. Well organized. Great place for all but the largest orchestras. Many events take place here during the year. Many are very low cost or free. Highly revommended.']

name: Edgecombe Community College
reviews: ["Usually a great place to attend.  I guess that all depends on the program and advisor you have.  The advisor for Medical Office Coding dropped the ball big time with no remorse at all.  Now I'm stuck waiting another whole year to take 1 class to graduate.   2 years for a 1 year program, smh.  Edgecombe needs to do better.", 'I was there to get my hair wash and set and a manicure. As I was checking in I ask the student who is doing my hair. She points to  some student. I replied I know each student is learning but prefer a black student do my hair. The student said there are no black students taking the class. I clearly saw several students my color. Soon I sit to wait to be called. Then rude a instructor comes over  telling me I had no right to ask for a black student. This white women  would not stop talking. I think she was trying to educate me on racial justice. I was offened by her rude attitude. So I left. This instructor fail to understand I have a right to request a particular person I feel comfortable with doing my hair. I will neve rsupport Edgecombe community  school', 'Such a joke. Coming from such a great school to moving and pretty much having no options besides Edgecombe to attend school, I’m disappointed. I haven’t had a problem with my professors, but the administration and financial aid is an absolute joke. I would never recommend anybody to go here.
