name: The Modern College of Design
reviews: ["One of my first jobs was a forensic photographer/pathology assistant. Considering I had two different teachers within the two years I went to SAA who did not know advanced Photoshop techniques and one did not teach how to shoot in manual, I was entirely self-taught. The school posted online, which could be googled with my name, that I was going to crime scenes with a completely bogus description (they did not ask me, or even contact me, for one). I only ever worked in the autopsy room. This reflects the level of professionalism I experienced during my two years, which is now the same cost as a four year degree. It felt like a high school clique with how they dealt with criticism and favoritism (one teacher was fired because of her own personal Facebook posts - she was a teacher who actually taught from a detailed, specific syllabus). Get the syllabi and ask EXACTLY what lectures they have and what is covered. Compare to another four year school. I'd choose Sinclair if I could go back.", 'This is a fantastic college for those interested in any time of career in the field of design. If you prefer hands-on learning, this is the place for you! With smaller class sizes, not only do the professors know you by name, but they have the time to meet your individual needs as well. 10/10, highly recommend!', 'Very interesting school and great yearly plans nice people great education-work blending', "Great school. They prepare you for the real world and it's a personal school where you know all of your classmates after your first year. If you consider yourself a creative and question graphic design, web, environmental design, or any art as a career, definitely submit your application.", "Poor experience from before they changed names multiple times. name: Sinclair Community College
reviews:
['I’m entering my second year at Sinclair Community College’s Dayton campus and I’ve been extremely impressed with my experience. Even though many of my classes are online, I regularly visit campus for the bookstore, advising, and student services, and every visit has been positive.
The connected buildings and sky-bridge walkways between them make the campus unique and easy to navigate. I love the architecture and layout. My professors have been supportive, responsive, and genuinely helpful whenever I’ve needed assistance.
Sinclair has exceeded my expectations, and I’m very glad I chose to start my college journey here. I also appreciate how welcoming the campus feels for families — I sometimes bring my five-year-old with me to the bookstore, and I’ve noticed other parents on campus too. It’s a comfortable, inclusive environment.', "I must say, I am extremely impressed with Sinclair. I attended as a student for about three years total, both in high school as College Credit Plus (CCP), and as a community college student. There is a lot to like: affordable costs, a clean and spacious building, wonderful instructors, wide selection of classes, easy integration for university transfers, a great Learning Management System (eLearn), online/in-person flexibility, and above all else, a great quality education. As I now attend Miami University, I see what I took for granted at Sinclair. This community college simply gets it right; if they had a Bachelor's in Business, I'd have no motive to go elsewhere. Thank you!", 'One of the greatest college in Ohio. Wayyyy better than other 4 year universities. Extremely helpful admissions office, teachers are willing to help you out throughout your school time and even after you graduate. Their library was my favorite place to study when I wanted to study in a quiet place.', 'Last time I visited Sinclair was in 2013! So much have changed! Nature, technology, library has changed so much, atmosphere is great ! Best of all, tuition is affordable for both residents and non residents!
Recommended', 'Black Box Theater is very quaint and perfect for small cast shows. Just saw a production of "Anthology". Can't imagine seeing it anywhere else.  Great job ladies!']

name: Stark State College
reviews: ['I was enrolled here a few years back. Life happened and I had to withdraw. I was in good standing and had a high GPA. I was fully covered with my FASFA and I left before the deadline to do so. I never received a refund but somehow they are claiming I owe them over $1200. For what? My tuition was covered and I left within the timeframe to do so. This is theft. They sent it to the Ohio Attorney General which is now an even bigger headache. I now have to pay them to come back. I know this charge is fraudulent.', 'I was super excited to start school here. I had a lot of questions about my application and wanted to be enrolled as soon as possible. I called the number that was given to me to call about admissions. Everyone who had spoken to me was RUDE and seemed as if they knew NOTHING about their job. Safe to say I will be applying elsewhere.', 'I went through their accelerated EMT course and they helped me get my certs within a summer. Also, with their emphasis  to prepare for NREMT, passed on the first try. I would say I woulda appreciated more of an emphasis on every day patient care vs. just getting through and passing the test…but that’s also up to the individual provider as well.', 'I drove all the way to Stark State College to drop off my high school transcript, only to be told they wouldn’t accept it because the envelope wasn’t sealed. Nowhere in the email did it say the transcript had to be in a sealed envelope. On top of that, I was told if it isn’t sealed, it “isn’t official”, which makes absolutely zero sense. How would you know if you don’t even take a look at it? Policies are one thing, but clear communication is just as important. This lack of transparency wasted my time and left a very frustrating first impression.', 'I attended Stark State College a number of years ago when it was Stark Technical College.  I am surprised by the negative reviews, because I had a great experience at the school.  I graduate with a degree in Computer Technology, and the courses were challenging and taught me a lot.  I still remember some of the great instructors like Mrs. McBride in my math classes.  I even worked there part-time for about a year doing LAN Administration.  They have provided me with a foundation for a very successful career in IT. I later completed my Bachelor degree at Kent State. I am currently completing my MBA.  I was able to get a copy of my transcripts, even after graduating 25 years ago, by faxing in a request.  I did this for two different Universities, and they arrived within a week.  In this age there should be a way to do it electronically like Kent State, but at least they do not charge you for them. Overall I had an excellent experience and they prepared me for a very rewarding career in Computer Technology.  I absolutely have no regrets about this school, and I enjoyed my time there.']

name: Stautzenberger College-Maumee
reviews:
['I attended about 10 years ago & according to the reviews, nothing much has changed.

They had me start with 3 classes. A business, with the nicest teacher. Then, Math & a science class with the same teacher. She was horrible! She only gave us tests in science class because she didnt want to grade a lot of work.  (maybe dont take on more than 1 class then).

I had several girls in my science class that this was their 2nd & 3rd time taking this same class because you need to pass it in order to proceed. I can only hope she isnt still there so people actually have a chance to pass that class without taking it 3x, only earning more money for the school & more debt on students that dont need it.', 'Mislead people into their college. Told me in the very beginning I qualified for 2 grants. AFTER finishing they said one of my grants was not accepted...mind you I would never have signed a contract with them if I knew how financially they were going to screw me over ...I repeat  AT THE END of all my courses they said i owed!!!! They deserve to be sued for fraud.', 'I went here for a year and it was hands down the worst decision I made as an adult. The actual program I attended was garbage and I barely learned anything. I doubled my student loan debt in a year for absolutely nothing. For-profit schools are absolute scams, you will be teaching yourself everything, and most programs are not properly accredited so getting an actual job with your degree after graduation is near impossible.', "Medical Assistant , overall great experience and even better teachers/instructors. Everyone on campus all the peers etc were always hands on and ready to help. Always letting you know there's no need to fear call on a Stautzenberger peer!! lol no seriously they're that Goodt! I loved my teacher Mr. Ellis he didn't hold me up at all this semester. Neither did my online instructor Ms. Judie Alessi. I love both Brittany's as you will too. great inspirational woman who encourages other women into being they better selves. No its not hard but by a long shot easy. Yes you have to study study study for best results. Academically amazing school program and teachers. IF I CAN DO IT YOU CAN DO IT , IF I DID IT ANYBODY CAN IPY ", 'As a student who is FINALLY graduated I can honestly say the staff here at Stautzenberger in Maumee always has my back. You guys are amazing. The PN teachers, nursing school is never easy but you guys are so dedicated to your jobs. An the way you guys took care of my mom. Our Dean, through all the chaos of graduation still made time to go and introduce himself to my mom and made sure she was ok ❤️
You guys are really amazing and I appreciate you all!']

name: Franciscan University of Steubenville
reviews:
['!! I am not saying any of this in any way to put the school in a bad light, I am just saying this so you will not be blindsided when you attend. !!

I'm being realistic: religious life? Great! Student activity life? Pretty good too. But the student community was less than average. Unless you're a "rad-trad" (radical traditional), you will be mocked verbally by most of the students who are. My family and friends who graduated from here, and heard my stories about it, were shocked to hear how downhill the student life became. The drama, rumors, sexism (from the male students), racism from said rad-trads, and secularism (from the students not the school) is crazy.
PARENTS: please note that your kids will not be sheltered at all (the homeschooled ones are usually the ones who were seen wilding out the most). The freshmans and juniors are the highest influenced / influencers here to the non-school affiliated party scene (and everything that that entails). I'm not saying in any way however that the school supports this. It's Steubenville, Ohio...your kids will get / are bored.
Froehlich's Classic Corner is the main bar students go to, then there's also the sketchy one in the woods about an hour away that upperclassmen go to, and not to mention your... calm... bonfire parties. If you look at their Life360 at night on ANY day of the week, you will see your student at one of these establishments, or at the nearest AMDG party (your traditional frat boys). In addition to this, the cooks food was TERRIBLE. They had a "breakfast casserole" on repeat that was literally a soggy mix of breakfast foods mixed in one tin. If you have any tastebud with flavor, the most flavor they had here at the school was pepper or Louisiana hot sauce. However, the burgers that were not on the student food plan and had to pay out-of-pocket for were really good.
Overall, besides the cliques here, I have made / kept amazing friends who I found shared the same beliefs as me. The school masses, chapel, and faculty religious life was great. School-held functions were great as well and there were many! As long as you find the right crowd, and not the one Pope Francis had to ban Latin masses from multiple down to 1 at the Vatican due to piousness, you will have an overall good time.', 'Welcome home! Amazing place and professors! I am so grateful to be a student at a place like this! True Catholic education with strong academics. I have been a student for three years so far. I have met some my best friends here. At Franciscan, you will grow in your education, faith, and ambitions.', 'My expirience last week at Fransiscan University was better than the time I got solicited for prostitution at a Barnes and Noble. During the winter break when most of the students and faculty were enjoying the break, I went to check out the campus. It was absolutely beautiful! A serene and kindly calmness came over me when foot was stepped on the property. One particular highlight of FU was the hill from the bluff going down towards the road below. I took some shopping carts from a popular store based in Arkansas and released them down the driveway to the streets below. All and all would greatly reccomend this campus to check out and go to study.', 'Outstanding faculty. Beautiful campus. Worth every penny invested. -UPDATE- They have put in a huge parking lot where the old soccer field use to be. New field up the hill is much better and has a track. New bathrooms have also been built up there too. All that money from parking tickets has paid off!', 'beautiful Catholic college in Ohio ! students come from all over the country to study here in and they offer a semester abroad in Austria as well. Reasonably-priced compared to some more well known private schools. My son is absolutely loving it!']

name: Southern State Community College
reviews: ['LarderRoom...I pick up and drop off my daughter from Southern State a few times per week. She seems happy with her classes and teachers. There is also a great track on campus for getting in that cardio. The track is outdoors, so dress according! The school always looks clean and well maintained.', 'Very nice school.  The instructors are helpful and willing to make sure that the students are successful in their endeavors.', 'SSCC employs administrators that call for the assassination of American Citizens whose opinion they do not agree with. Isn\'t that nice?As of at least a few weeks ago, James Pierce called, at length and in detail, for the cold blooded murder of NRA officials. He also called for an orchestrated attack on more than one NRA office. I wonder what else he has in mind.\n\nIt\'s quite ironic. This "educator" that claims to be worried about the safety of others is recommending murder. Is this the type of person you want your children being lead by?', "I really enjoyed my time here at southern state, it's just like most other colleges. You'll have your hang ups but when it comes down to it, you are in control of your time here. With that being said however, it was hard to get some classes taken due to students not wanting to take a particular class at a given time. That can easily be avoided however if you just do an independent study.", 'Nice place to walk.']

name: Terra State Community College
reviews:
['Terra as a school is wonderful. Staff and Administration are helpful and wonderful to work with on day to day duties. The motorcycle program is great. Larry does a nice job working with students and the program. The maintenance department is always willing to help.  Thanks again Terra for keeping the professional standard so high. Keep up the grand work.

Respectfully,
Rob', 'It is a great community college with wonderful teachers and helpful people.  If you are driving there are signs on front of the buildings to tell which building it is', 'The only thing I can say is good about the school is the close proximity of it to where I live. Other than that, they only offer class times for certain subjects on a limited basis making it very difficult to try to accomplish getting your degree in a timely manner if you are working full time. Also, if they cancel/drop one of your classes due to "not enough participants" and you have already started paying for that class you will be waiting for months to receive a refund of what you paid, but they definitely cash your check the very next day.  They are trying to hard to be a University and not focusing on what made the school what it is.', "Awesome place to go for truck driveing school. I got my CDL Training here through Trainco Trucking. It's a short 3 week program. Job and family services paid for everything", "I am a student that went to this college because they promised transferring credits, but upon filling out and being accepted to a 4 year college I found out that all but 1 of my classes are below standards and will not be transferring therefore I say if you are going to go to a 4 year college, do not go to terra it will be cheap but inefficient use of your time as the classes will amount to a GPA but not into college credit.

Otherwise it is a beautiful campus, and the teachers are hit and miss between amazing and really into their job and well the exact opposite, where you are treated more like a part on a factory line they call a classroom, not that they are mean just go below and beyond the call of duty. But then again this college is cheap so the teachers aren't paid well and I don't blame them for their attitudes toward the job."]

name: Tiffin University
reviews:
['The IT department is the worst I have ever seen in my life. They constantly reboot email servers via either changing them (gmail to outlook) or otherwise lock you out of your email account by changing security settings (2FA then needed to download a new app, etc.). People might say that's a thing with colleges in general, but I strongly disagree. It's something unique to TU. The town itself is your average small college town, very little in terms of jobs or internships, so you'll def. need a car or a few plane tickets if you want to get hired somewhere (unless you end up working remotely).

About the professors: some are def. better than others. Some have no business teaching, others are pretty good. That's standard fare across universities and colleges, but here I've probably seen more who are just "by the book" types rather than able to adapt to changing situations. Some seemed to have a hard time understanding that not every student fits neatly into a little box.

Do I regret attending? Sort of.', 'Money Hungry school. Administration has terrible communication. And Dean isn’t much help to any of the situations we needed help with. Do not go here, it’s a MASSIVE waste of money.', 'I would not recommend this school simply for the administration itself. This school is TERRIBLE at communication, they never answer the phone. There have been many times this school has just stolen money from me because of THEIR OWN MISTAKES.', 'I was very comfortable because its a small school so you really get to know the other students and the professors who get to know your name too. The online classes are different but they did the best they could and the graduate admissions program coordinator helped connect students even though we were all across the states.', 'I was planning on attending this college to work on my Masters in Film Studies, they claim that none of the credits was transferable. It does not make sense. All courses from my undergraduate school are transferable. It is such a waste and I would advise anyone who is getting a degree in film to go somewhere else. I am glad I am not going to this loser school. I am getting my degree somewhere else better.']

name: University of Toledo
reviews: ['We had an awful experience with the speech clinic after trying to arrange speech services for my son.  I expressed my concerns/frustrations to the supervising professor, who took over a month to reply to multiple calls/emails.  Front desk secretary is rude and provides inaccurate information to potential patients about the process.  I requested a refund of the assessment fee, but never received the refund.', 'Best decision other than marrying my wife was to transfer from UT to UT. Univiof Toledo to University of Tampa. Enough said. Never looked back. Retired FL educator who made best decision 51 years ago. Winter in Ohio sucks!!', 'They only care about money, and not even about making YOUR money worth the time and effort. You will end up paying tens of thousands of dollars for classes that are outdated by over a decade and ones that are not even relevant to your major!', 'Pay nearly $200 per semester for parking, on top of a $900 “general fee” but they still can’t afford to make parking accessible, or even usable. Walk 15 minutes in the cold rain to class.', 'Awesome achievement by the Grace of God Almighty 💯\nNo wonder this place is a great place of learning in most fields of learning..\nNo wonder the School leaders told Lourdes College students to reapply and complete their education at the UT']

name: Ursuline College
reviews: ["Beautifully landscaped in suburban Cleveland, this Catholic college offers degrees with a distinguished reputation. Recommend the dorms be renovated; however, all other buildings on the college campus are utilized efficiently or re-purposed. The Ursuline Sisters of Cleveland reside on the grounds in their Mother House. A tour is a must to really appreciate this collegiate gem in the realm of women's higher education.", 'Love the professors and the classes are interesting and engaging, the staff is beyond nice and even the strangers too! However, some of the girls there are catty which really clouds the great experience of this fine establishment, such a shame but nonetheless there is potential for success here!', 'Great Sports fields/facilities. Fun Afternoon of Softball.', 'whent too this coledge a few years ago. didnt learn too much, but i did learn that drinking really is what i needed to calm down from the stress of all the work that they gave me. drinking works in real life to. i am drinking as i go about the taskses of righting this revew. great colledge, taut me a life lesson to drink when stressed.', 'If you are looking for a friendly and cooperative college Ursuline is the best. It provides you with one on one care and help. You can talk easily with professors and there is no rush. Food in cafetaria is also good.']

name: Walsh University
reviews:
["Our daughter played soccer and waa in the honors program at WU,  Graduate in May 2025.  Currentlyl attends Ohio State's Dental College in the fall of 2025.

I have been very impressed with this university from our first visit, student/parent orientation, and all the interactions with faculty and staff.

Still 100% impressed with faculty, President Collins, and the excellent education.

Less impressed with the sports programs....mediocre to fair at best...

The women's soccer program is under new coaching since Spring of 2022. There is no emphasis for the team to condition or lift weights during the season. The coaching staff has degraded, and if you're a recruit or parent of a recruit, I would suggest another DII school until the coaching staff changes.

The coach labeled my daughter as privileged and completely discounted her as a person. She is not privileged. Her parents are from a blue collar background, and their families suffered during the 80's recessions...

The coach never acknowledged my daughter for her academic achievements and never congratulated her for earning admission to OSU.

The women's soccer coach is a bad human!

If your daughter wants to play soccer in the GMAC consider Ashland, Cedarville, Northwoods, Malone, or  Findlay. Until a coaching change happens at Walsh, go somewhere else!", "If the students' actions represent this university, this is a sad institution. Flicking off cars and yelling because you sprinted into an intersection with active traffic, failing to follow common sense is a new way of displaying school pride.", "Your education is a significant investment.  You owe it to yourself and your future to fully investigate any and all information you can find about a school you are considering.

Our family made a terrible to decision to trust Walsh.  We were prompt and deliberate when it came to denying student loans.  The university ignored our intent to decline them and repeatedly including loans in the aid amount.

In total we have faced countless hours of frustration with the Board of Regents, the Better Business Bureau, and now the Attorney General.  The university president even acknowledged to us that there are flaws in their system that cause errant communications like this.  Yet the university feels that it more important to threaten collections over a disputed tuition amount just days after one of their former students loses her job due to COVID-19.

Further, we have offered to make payments under dispute to them.  They agreed to accept those payments and not impact her credit history.  However, they will not tell us how much to pay.  I've been trying to get an answer for some acceptable periodic amount and no one will respond.  The department is incredibly mismanaged and I urge you to consider a higher quality product for your education decision.", 'A very great campus to send a young one, very clean, lighting is great. The Rooms are a
little tight but what you expect its a collage. I love the Location away from a lot of distraction. A strong christian base school. Lot of help when the kids needed it. The staff know their stuff and they keep the parents well inform with all the going on. Greatschool,
great programs , great professors.', 'Walsh University has been the worst experience. When you go in as a freshman, they promise to help you get your degree in 4 years and to help you as you strive towards a professional career. This is a lie. They try to keep you at the university as long as they possibly can. They do not have your best interest in mind, rather, they are concerned with money. This is not a religious-centered school, it is a greed-centered school. The staff has a few good professors, but outside of that everyone is incompetent. As someone who has dumped thousands of dollars into this university only to be told they cannot graduate, I can advise you to not waste your time or money here. Strive for a better university and a better future for yourself. This place is not your stepping stone.']

name: Washington State College of Ohio
reviews:
['Very disappointing experience. Communication is unclear, and important information is often missing. There are constant inconsistencies, poor guidance, and an overall unsupportive environment. From all of my teachers I only have had two which I would not recommend (of which I will not name names).

name: Wilmington College
reviews:
['I have been so blessed and filled with gratitude by Wilmington College. Wilmington created the framework for success, life-changing relationships, and personal formation during a pivotal time in my young adult life in finding myself and establishing my career goals. Wilmington gave me four of the greatest years of my life, and its education set me up for success in Doctorate school, as a healthcare provider and beyond.

While Wilmington is a small institution, it is rich in opportunity and connection if you choose to harness those resources.

Academically, professors were very accessible and friendly. I was able to forge life long friendships with multiple faculty members who were always encouraging in my academic pursuits, and pursuits outside of the classroom. I was taught how to play squash, and regularly played with my algebra 3 professor. I spent time fishing with another one of my professors and as well as one of my coaches. Truly some of the greatest men I’ve ever met; men who loved their faiths, families and students.

I will say, some of my classmates who did not take advantage of campus involvement, and one on one academic relationships, missed out on a huge portion of the Wilmington College experience: it’s feeling of family and connectedness.

At a college like Wilmington, or any other small college for that matter, your experience will be very much dependent on your desire to connect, get outside of your comfort zone and grow. It would have been very easy to miss out by being shut in, reserved, and just going to class to fulfill academic requirements to get a degree, instead of truly getting to know your classmates, and those teaching you.

The opportunity to excel in life after undergraduate studies is thriving at Wilmington college if you are prepared to take advantage of its most special qualities.', "I really, like Wilmington College. I coached football as a volunteer assistant some years ago,  I think I have always just liked this place. It's quiet and serene, and yet during the season it can be bustling. Carry on,  GO QUAKERS!", 'Great campus! The whole college is family friendly', 'Some of the best years of my life. After going to a large high school where I had teachers that never knew my name, Wilmington was the perfect choice. Great education and, just as importantly, self confidence and a superb vision of myself as an adult - forming concrete goals for my future.', "Great food and coffee as always. Incredibly friendly service.  I wish it was closer to id my home ... I'd absolutely be a regular!!"]

name: Wittenberg University
reviews:
['Everyone has a unique experience. Everything must change! Graduated when the school's ranking was #6 liberal arts institution in the US (USNews). During my years, I received a very good education and it did not come easy as the standards were very high. Political Science majors had to write a Master's level thesis and defend it as well as pass National Board exam at 20 pts above the national average to obtain their B.A. with major. Alternatively, they received a Liberal Arts degree. Today, "Wittenberg University is currently facing financial challenges and was placed on probation by the Higher Learning Commission in November 2025."..

During my tenure, all but one pre-law program student was accepted to law school with nearly 20% obtaining acceptance to the school of their choice. Pre-med acceptance was 65%. CPA passage on the first attempt was in the top 5. Football WAS a NCAA champ and runner-up. Same with basketball. Tennis and golf made the NCAA tourney.

Today, Witt has fallen, significantly fallen out of the top 100, even the top 150 for that matter (#164 USNews). Fiscal mismanagement to say the least. Faculty provided a vote of no-confidence. All of the ratings dropped. Even the campus radio station, a place where students learned valuable production, speaking, and technical skills is gone. Sold for 94K. Appears another valuable asset sold to make up for mismanagement.

Two coaches, former standout alumni athletes, attained Witt's Hall of Fame. When a couple of serious issues arose, the university did nothing. Tennis coach Dave B. was known to "stack the draw". The paramount issue of integrity is cheating or allowing such. In 1976, during Fall tryouts (held next to my dorm) several watched a student Dave liked cheat (call in balls out repeatedly) during a tryout match. An adult bystander asked Coach B. and asked, "Are you going to do anything?" His response, "No need. They aren't gonna make the team anyway."

Ironically, four or five of those playing made it to the Pros including the kid that got cheated. Guess he was not good enough. Some suspect the coach did no longer wanted him as he did not come to Witt as a Freshman as expected. He transferred into Witt as a sophomore. He played #1 the prior year at another school.

Another time, the Asst AD stated the rules for intramural competition were those accepted and utilized by the NCAA. When one competitor appealed an issue, but well after the time period provided to do so, the AD did not uphold the rules and stated, "rematch". When questioned about the reversal, he said he had the authority. The authority to have it both ways at the same time does not exist, yet, his decision was final.

Ironically, Wittenberg approached one affected alumnus for donations after realizing their visible achievements and successes post graduation. After reading the two letters the President, there was no reason for me to endorse the school as everything has changed. The allegations were substantiated in documents from the time (they kept and provided all communication) and from witnesses to the events. In short, the note said, if you really care about history being accurate, the image of Witt and/or simply desire a large donation to help right the ship, remove them from the HoF based on the documented evidence. Sadly, as expected, no action was taken. Somethings do not change regardless.

IMO, Witts cultural issues were systemic, yet, not noticed due to the successes. Often the "goods" officiate the "undesired". My belief is that those issues festered and grew larger over time, eroding the core values that made Witt a top-tier school, which in turn, led to a host of issues including alumni no longer wishing to donate, let alone be associated with the institution. Sad, but not unforeseen, avoidable. Given my experience beyond the education, if I had it to do over again, I would!', 'Great school and friendly environment.', "Went here for a lacrosse camp it was okay dorms we're a bit old bit a lot of space for your baggage. The cafeteria is a lot like school food enjoy. :)", "Wittenberg to the uninformed looks like a snobby little rich school where girls get there daddies to pay for everything and every guy you run into is a jock. This is a false image. Sure there are rich people, it is an expensive school, but there are also people who have to work to go there. It is expensive because the quality of education that you can receive there is above others. Almost every other student at Wittenberg is receiving financial assistance. People at Wittenberg are welcoming and kind, ask any new student. Ask anyone who has gone there without a prepossessed prejudice. I toured Wittenberg after being accepted, without knowing the cost, and what I found was a nice community of people. I attend this school. I work hard every day to pay for it, when I could have easily gone somewhere less expensive and paid not a dime. I chose Wittenberg because it felt welcoming, and I wouldn't want to study anywhere else. The professors care about the students, the campus is beautiful, and the people are friendly. Everyone is not a stuck up little rich kid who owns a BENZ, but there are so many people who care about others more than you can find at any big name school. Wittenberg is a great place to be educated.", "As my experience this is a great school. The professors care about their students. There are many resources on campus that are free and provide all students with help. Also, it's not just a school for the rich. I'm poor yet was still able to attend with many scholarships they offered me. There may be people who complain about upstuck kids here but we also have generous students who care. You're going to find upstuck and rude kids anywhere in the US, but there's also great kids that exist too."]

name: The College of Wooster
reviews: ["I hate it here. The cost of the college is so expensive, I receive financial aid for 40k a year and I'm an RA and I can still barely afford it. They don't take care of international students, they don't take care of POC (The president claimed she felt she was threatened when BSA peacefully protested her killing off scholarships for black students). The professors are the only thing I like about this school, but even they are leaving bc the board of trustees is protecting the president at all costs (they keep cutting funds despite a 600 million endowment). In sum, stop donating to this school. Its not going to students, its going to Anne McCall's 700K a year salary.", "The school is going more downhill each day. The dining locations are understaffed, students are surprised with more closings and less options for campus engagement, and yet tuition is going to be over $80,000 next year. Wooster should consider actually putting effort into the school instead of attempting to show off for alumnus, trustees, and potential students. Know that if you go here, financial aid and all other related offices won't be concerned with helping you as soon as you submit that deposit and get on campus.", 'Attended another stimulating and well-presented lecture through the Great Decisions series which is scheduled every Feb-Mar.  This year\'s topic is "The U.S. in a Multi-polar World."', "The President is awful and money from endowments is clearly being diverted away from the intended purposes while the Board is asleep at the wheel. It is a very real possibility the next incoming freshmen class wont graduate from the school because it will have been shutdown. Don't take my word for it, ask around the campus. Its quickly going from bad to worse!", 'I graduated from the college of wooster in 1998. I had a wonderful experience. After I graduated, I missed it so much that I often dreamt that was back and I was so happy in my dreams. When I was there, my tuition was $25,000 a year. Now tuition is $79,000 a year. This is ridiculous. If I was just starting college, the college of wooster wouldn’t be a consideration which would be sad because I had a lot of amazing growth there that I don’t believe would have happened anywhere else.']

name: Wright State University-Main Campus
reviews: ['My friend and I were touring WSU with our school and our final stop was the gift shop. I saw a nail clippers bottle opener key chain which I thought was interesting so I showed it to my friend. I was talking kind of loudly (I have trouble with voice volume) then my friend informed me a cashier was watching me. I dismissed it as a cashier casually watching over the gift shop and continued looking around the gift shop. When it was time for my class to leave, she walked up to me and asked to pat down my pockets and turn them inside out. I complied and when she found nothing she turned to my best friend and said "Can I Pat you down. " in a very assertive tone in front of my peers and teachers. My friend is very non-confrontational so she agreed. After the pat down, the cashier found nothing and so we walked away. After this event, I am no longer considering WSU as an option because of how I was treated. I typically wear baggy clothes so I feel as if I was treated poorly because of the way I looked. I definitely would not recommend WSU for people who dress and appear differently than the norm.', "This is a place i frequently go to. The staff is amazing and always here to help. If you get lost stop and ask someone where your going and they will guide you. They could have addresses to all the buildings that would be a tremendous help. Until then it's really not that hard to get it figured out. Amazing school and amazing venues as well.", 'Great for graduation, but the Career Guidance Department doesn’t really help with finding a job. They invite companies that don’t sponsor visas or aren’t hiring at all. They also don’t seem to have strong placement connections like other universities do.\n\nWhenever you ask them for support, they just say they don’t know anyone. Honestly, it feels like I wasted my time. I didn’t get a job, not even an internship. Even on-campus jobs were very limited, and most of those went to undergrads only.', 'Posting here because the wright state police took down reviews on their google page. Do not send your kids here, the police don’t take sexual assault seriously. Will lie to the victims about needing to scan their phones to get a warrant for the predators phone & lose your test kit. Whole department needs to be investigated by the state and prosecuted to the fullest extent of the law. It won’t happen but it should.', 'WSU is a great university to pursue your degree. But, move-in 2025 was not a smooth process like it has been in the past!😵\u200d💫 Those in charge of move-in need to go back to the drawing board & regroup with a much better plan!']

name: Wright State University-Lake Campus
reviews:
['Excellent school! Their nursing program is top-notch! We are so fortunate to have a nursing program like this in our area! Lynn Franck runs the nursing program at the Lake Campus. She goes above and beyond to help her students. I couldn’t have asked for a better person and program to help my daughter realize her dream of becoming an RN. If you want to be a nurse, then the Lake Campus program is the way to go. Excellent NCLEX passing rates, affordable and a great program to get the skills you need to be prepared to work as an RN. I am so happy that my daughter chose Wright State Lake Campus! She is now a Registered Nurse with a job!', '"Wright" Choice! The college is pretty cool and has an excellent view of the lake. Some of their classes are only taken during set semesters, so it's easy to fall behind if you're a transfer student. Their Education degree is a lot better than other Colleges.. Their Masters Program (6 years) can be done in only 5 years.  Their field experience is a wonderful experience and allows you to see if you enjoy teaching in your first year!

The only issue was if you transferred from a different college. I already completed a degree in Social Work and my math credits already completed. Even with advance statistics completed and algebra, they force you to take the basic math class or force your to PAY to pass out of math. This causes some people a lot of frustration, especially when they clearly have the courses completed. The remedial math courses they want you to take has some rude teachers and an awful concept of teaching.

The education course also teaches concept math, which is basically is the remedial classes.

Other than that, Wright State Lake Campus is a great place to get a quality education without breaking the pocketbook.

The boathouse is an awesome addition! Chris and Zach are very friendly and show great customer service!', 'Just dropped my daughter off for her freshman year. The villas are so nice!', "It's a good school if you start there as a freshman, but if you are a transfer student, be ready to throw your planned graduation date out the window because they have set schedules for when they even offer their classes.", 'There isn’t much to do, and it is not diverse at all. I’d recommend the Dayton campus more, as it has something for everyone.']

name: Xavier University
reviews:
['Great place for an education and tons of stuff to do in the area! Excellent place for school spirit and athletics!', 'A fine Jesuit institution.  Beautiful campus and grounds.  Students are polite, respectful and very intelligent.   It comes at a price, however.
As a Saint Ignatius grad, it would have been a privilege to attend college here.', 'Looks like a great facility. I think my cousin will be very happy there!', 'As a former student in Cincinnati and from Dayton, it’s very disappointing to see Xavier allow the arrest of 2 peaceful student protestors.

You can have free speech if it’s for their people. It’s funny that a catholic school is so hell bent on standing with Israel (whom they don’t even share beliefs).', '2022 Graduate here that has nothing but High Praise for this fine University. I highly recommend it for future students!']

name: Youngstown State University
reviews: ['We were on campus anyways eith our son so we walked some laps around the campus, reminiscing about our days here', 'Great local, affordable, quality, blue collar university. Would recommend 👍', 'I went here over 40 years ago. It has grown a bunch since then. I hope it is as good now as it was then. My experience there was pretty good.', "This is a great university for certain majors and average for others. The engineering program and work placement is excellent. However, while Youngstown is growing, don't expect a lot happening around town. For a heavily commuter college, the parking could be better organized. Positive changes are being made and definitely check it out though if your program has a good school and you want a good value for your degree.", 'YSU is such a quiet and peaceful place to go to school at. Sometimes I liked to just sit on the grass under a tree and listen to the birds and the wind as life just passed me by. The buildings are a complex maze of twists and turns that will leave your head feeling like you just entered the twilight zone, and while some students are rather rude the majority of them are extremely kind hearted. I personally feel that the school could use with a better organization system, slightly more thought out staff and faculty, but other than that it is a very amazing place to learn.']

name: Oklahoma Wesleyan University
reviews:
["If I could give this university zero stars, I would. While many professors truly cared and want students to succeed, the institution itself was extremely disappointing.

This is an expensive school with very limited resources, which makes you question where tuition money is actually going. Athletics are not treated equally—smaller sports are pushed aside, and achievements often go unrecognized. Scholarships are also handed unfairly, with international athletes frequently receiving more money than U.S. athletes with similar skill levels.

If you are considering this school for athletics and your sport isn't soccer, men's basketball, or volleyball, I strongly suggest looking elsewhere. Don't fall for the trap!!!!!!!!!!!!!", 'I attended my freshman year in 1978 here and the ultra conservative regulations for students made it prohibitive for me to return.  Was sited for wearing a  3 inch wide shoulder strap full length gown showing zero cleavage. Such an environment would work for those who fit that mold.  I came back to California where I fit much better.  Yes and  we have many wonderfully liberal wesleyans here😀', "I'm a freshman here and it has been a great experience. The staff is great, the school focuses on the truth of the Bible, and the primacy of Christ is the number one priority. I wouldn't go to any other college, especially if going into the ministry.", 'After spending my undergraduate career here, I believe this was the best school that I could have ever chose to enhance my education and prepare myself for the future. I received my BS in Marketing Summer 2012 and began my MBA degree at another university within months. I have never felt more prepared for the course load. My business professors at OKWU were an inspiration for me during my undergraduate career, and still remain a part of my life as mentors after I graduated.', "I graduated from the Adult and Graduate Studies Program in 2010.  This program is a joke.  I took better classes at TCC!  I feel like I paid for my straight A's.  The classes were not challenging, most of the teachers I had did not take the class serious.  Plus, since the University does not promote their program with an local businesses, good luck getting that higher paying job after college.  I have kept in touch with my cohort, everyone else is in the same boat.  To the point where most of them have gone on to OSU graduate program so maybe that will make a difference.

In short, save your money, go to TCC and OSU."]

name: Southern Nazarene University
reviews: ["I'm enrolled in the online MBA program, and overall, it has been a great experience. The program is very low-pressure, which was a pleasant surprise compared to what I initially expected. The classes are straightforward, and the instructors are knowledgeable and supportive. I really appreciate that assignments are done at your own pace, with a weekly deadline rather than having to show up to a physical classroom. This makes it so much easier to have a work-life-school balance. I’ve gotten to know the people in my group well and it’s nice to have a sense of community, even though the program is online.", 'I attended SNU for my undergraduate studies and the faculty were so helpful as I chose (and changed) my major to fit my unique desires for a degree plan. The professors truly care about you and stay in communication even after graduation. I am currently enrolled in the Counseling Graduate Program and I love it! The faculty is extremely knowledgeable and works hard to ensure that students get the best experience out of their education. Renew Counseling Center is a fantastic campus partner and helps to care for everyone on campus well!', 'I am a proud Graduate of SNU for both my undergraduate degree & my MBA. The faculty & staff truly cared for me in some really difficult moments as well as the celebrations over those years & have continued to stay connected to this day. Some of the friends that I made in my time at SNU years ago continue to be close family friends and it has been a blessing to walk through all seasons of life together! I have the privilege of serving and working with students at SNU in Student Life and am grateful to walk alongside them in a purposefully different way! God has used this university powerfully in my life personally and continues to work in and through students as we prepare them to go and change the world!', 'SNU is a great place to be a student at! I attended all 4 years of my undergrad here for Graphic Design and loved it. Professors are intentional, helpful, and caring. Class sizes are typical fairly small so getting to know your classmates and professor is so easy. Not to mention more 1-1 time with your professors. I also just received my Masters in Leadership degree from SNU. This was a nearly 2 year degree all online. Class structures were clear and concise which was super important for an all-online structure. The professors for these classes were just as amazing and helpful as the in-person professors. This is a great place that challenges you as a student and also strives for students to learn more about Christ. I recommend checking SNU out for undergrad or PGS!', 'The faculty and community surrounding SNU is very embracing. I have enjoyed my time studying at SNU, met so many close friends and built many fruitful relationships thanks to this wonderful place! Everyone is so caring and true to what the university intends to achieve.']

name: Cameron University
reviews: ["Great environment. Easy to find your way around and locate whatever facility, field, or building that you're looking for.", 'I have only visited for band competitions. But I have always had a good experience with the staff and students who host the competition. They have a nice stadium where we compete for regionals each year. Thank you for hosting this event!', 'This is a beautiful school sweet people that works here My sister goes to college here I like it', 'People in the parking lot were very rude.  Would not move their car so we could leave.  Cussed us out.', 'I visited my alma mater yesterday and noticed that the communications department has relocated. The small house I once lived in across the street from campus has been torn down. Since my time there, the city of Lawton has experienced explosive growth—so much so that I hardly recognized anything. Still, it was a meaningful experience to reminisce and explore the city with my grandson.']

name: Carl Albert State College
reviews: ["Your transcript will cost $10 for each place you send it afterwards. If you want to apply to 5 universities when you finish your associates, it'll cost you $50 in just transcript fees. If you go to any other college, it normally costs $3-$8 for 5 recipients.", 'The campus matches the employees personality beautifully Everyone is here  to help you better yourself not only through your education but in your life. The employees are amazing and are willing to help you at any time (exp. the Enrollment center).   I would recommend to everyone to come and take classes at this beautiful campus and get to enjoy the college life. With all the campus activities you will never have a down moment.', "CASC has been an amazing adventure for me. I highly recommend it as a first step out of high school! Friendly, helpful staff and amazing programs, clubs, and just overall experience! I'm proudly a Viking for life!", 'Love CASC. I received an amazing education at Carl Albert that allowed me to pursue my professional goals. A great school to get involved with the community as well. Highly recommend!', "So I recently bought books from the CASC bookstore for my classes that I thought I needed. After going to all my classes most informed me that we could get by without them if we took notes during lecture. My thought okay, I'll just take the ones I don't need back being that they are still in the plastic package not even open yet. BUT to my surprise you can't take books back unless you drop a class. So not only was the lady completely rude, she took it upon herself to look up my Pell and said you've got more than enough for the books there is no reason to bring them back, I can't help you!! So 2 day old books still in the plastic they won't take back, and they don't tell you when you buy them this either!!! Nor did I get a receipt for 1,197.00 worth of books.. Completely displeased with this, it's ridiculous. Won't be back!"]

name: University of Central Oklahoma
reviews: ['The campus is beautiful. There is a separate building for each department or major. The school has welcoming and positive environment. The professors are amazing with experience and knowledge.', 'Came for a state championship high school football game while I understand the security protocols my husband has a prosthetic leg and he basically had to strip down just to get through the gates.  Very unprofessional.', "Came on a football tour college visit for my son's 7v7 football team 5P from St. Louis, MO. Very nice facilities and enjoyed watching their football team practice!", 'When you schedule a small band to play months ago, let them set up, and then canceling them because of sensitive feelings...', 'they want us to go to class with black ice on the roads soo if that doesn’t say everything about this school then wow, and also anyone and everyone: 20 credit hours at osu-okc is around 3000-4000 range and i’ve spent 4000+ on a 12 hour semester soo please don’t give this trash college your money']

name: Connors State College
reviews:
['I went here to play the disc golf course that they have in the middle of the campus. It is a really cool place to play. It literally is in the center court of the school in waves in and out of the student housing.', "Went to school here in the mid 1990's.  Enjoyed my time here. Small student to instructor ratio. College seemed to actually care about you. Minus one bad humanities instructor that hated men, had a nice, productive time here. The Warner campus is very nice, clean and inviting.", 'Food is very good went here for a field trip the people there are also nice', "It's a good place to start if you want to continue your education.
It's cheaper than most two year schools. They offer concurrent enrollment.
They work with you on cost and payment plans.
There are so many different scholarships available to reduce the cost.
They're offering more classes as the years go on.
They have so many on campus activities for the students that it makes it fun to live in the dorms here.
They have so many clubs, it's alot of fun to be involved.
I enjoyed my time as a student there
One thing I wish they'd do is offer photography classes.", "I attended Upward Bound at Connors when I was in it high school. I then enrolled at Connors after graduation. I'm a proud 🎓 alumni from  2005. I hope that when my kids are older they will attend as well. Today we took one of our daughters to visit the campus and play pokemon go. The campus is beautiful and growing. It was a lovely site to see the Agricultural Camps still going on."]

name: East Central University
reviews: ['I transferred here as an online student after getting an associates at OCCC. The communication ability of the people who work at this school is bizarre to me. I’ve been given like four different advisors. I’ve sent my official transcript two separate times which I have to pay for every time it’s sent. Somehow they still don’t have my official transcript and I just had to send another one through. All of this and I just finished my first semester and my transfer is still not completed. Every time I send an email I either don’t receive a response or I receive a response multiple days after the fact and most of the time it seems like they have some sort of weird condescending attitude in the emails. There’s been multiple instances where I’ve called to try to get things resolved and nobody answers the phone in the specific departments so I’m leaving messages. Nobody’s returning my calls. All this being said I would not choose this school again. It’s incredibly frustrating given that I’m an online student paying for a bunch of university fees, never having even stepped foot on campus and I can hardly even receive communication back whenever I have questions.', "My daughter just graduated from here and I would recommend it to anyone looking for a higher education. They offer just about everything here and the staff is wonderful. My other daughter went to a different school for a while and I, myself, didn't like the way they managed things and the staff was like talking to the wall. But here at ECU, it was so different. Everyone, staff included has been great. Thanks for giving her a great education and a tuff, but wonderful experience to go with it.", 'The people here are great but the school is terrible. The campus is comprised of old buildings and sidewalks. The housing and meal plans seem unfair compared to the quality (overpriced). Seriously, there was mold in my dorm AC and in my shower. I heard from others that this was not uncommon. I don’t think my room was cleaned before I moved in, as there was trash everywhere. There are little to no diet accommodations. The upside was that it’s cheap but they have recently raised the price of housing, meals, and tuition.', 'The professors are great for the SW program. However be aware about transfer credits. They will say they take it and when they do the graduation audit all their errors come up. Im suppose to graduate in May and they are now telling me the credits they used for substitution were an error and I need to take 2 more classes. Also make sure if you have multiple transcripts make sure they have all be reviewed and uploaded so you wont take classes u already taken! That happened to me as well. That registration and admissions office have no idea what they are doing!', 'Love everything about it except they need to pray at the graduation....\nThis country was built on Christian Values.\nEvery school should still be teaching this....']
